text: Reinforcement learning offers a robust framework for acquiring behaviour through environmental interactions, yet it typically yields reactive behaviours where actions are chosen based on immediate observations. This reactive approach can lead to inefficient learning, particularly in complex environments requiring nuanced control. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a proactive paradigm where the agent determines not only the action to take in a given state, but also the duration for which to maintain that action. Our proposed TempoRL method incorporates skip connections between states and learns a skip-policy that enables the repetition of actions over these connections, thereby enhancing learning efficiency. As demonstrated through experiments on various traditional and deep reinforcement learning environments, TempoRL facilitates the acquisition of successful policies at a significantly faster rate, outperforming vanilla Q-learning by up to an order of magnitude.

Ngoài việc sử dụng các phương pháp xác thực đã đề cập, việc triển khai các biện pháp bảo mật khác cũng đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc bảo vệ hệ thống đăng nhập. Một trong những phương pháp đó là sử dụng chính sách mật khẩu mạnh. Chính sách này yêu cầu người dùng tạo mật khẩu với độ phức tạp cao, bao gồm sự kết hợp của chữ hoa, chữ thường, số và ký tự đặc biệt. Điều này làm tăng độ khó cho các cuộc tấn công brute force, nơi mà kẻ tấn công cố gắng thử tất cả các tổ hợp mật khẩu có thể. Bên cạnh đó, việc thường xuyên yêu cầu người dùng thay đổi mật khẩu sau một khoảng thời gian nhất định cũng là một cách để giảm thiểu nguy cơ rò rỉ thông tin. 

Hơn nữa, việc triển khai công nghệ mã hóa dữ liệu khi lưu trữ và truyền tải thông tin cũng là một yếu tố quan trọng trong việc bảo vệ dữ liệu. Khi thông tin nhạy cảm, chẳng hạn như mật khẩu và dữ liệu cá nhân, được mã hóa, ngay cả khi kẻ tấn công có được quyền truy cập vào cơ sở dữ liệu, họ cũng không thể đọc được thông tin mà không có khóa giải mã. Điều này đặc biệt quan trọng trong bối cảnh các cuộc tấn công mạng ngày càng trở nên tinh vi và khó lường.

Để tăng cường hơn nữa mức độ bảo mật, việc sử dụng các hệ thống phát hiện xâm nhập (IDS) và phòng chống xâm nhập (IPS) là cần thiết. Các hệ thống này có khả năng giám sát hoạt động mạng và phát hiện các hành vi đáng ngờ hoặc bất thường, từ đó đưa ra cảnh báo hoặc tự động ngăn chặn các cuộc tấn công tiềm tàng. Việc tích hợp các hệ thống này vào cơ sở hạ tầng bảo mật giúp bảo vệ hệ thống trước các cuộc tấn công từ bên ngoài cũng như các mối đe dọa từ bên trong.

Một yếu tố khác không thể bỏ qua là việc đào tạo và nâng cao nhận thức về bảo mật cho người dùng và nhân viên trong tổ chức. Thường xuyên tổ chức các buổi hội thảo, đào tạo về an toàn thông tin giúp mọi người nhận thức được các rủi ro bảo mật và cách phòng tránh. Người dùng được trang bị kiến thức về cách phát hiện các email lừa đảo (phishing), các trang web giả mạo và cách xử lý khi phát hiện các dấu hiệu bất thường sẽ là lớp bảo vệ đầu tiên và hiệu quả nhất cho hệ thống.

Cuối cùng, việc thực hiện các biện pháp kiểm soát truy cập chặt chẽ, chẳng hạn như phân quyền truy cập dựa trên vai trò (RBAC), giúp đảm bảo rằng chỉ những người dùng có thẩm quyền mới có thể truy cập vào các phần thông tin nhạy cảm của hệ thống. text:
The main idea of this paragraph is the structure and function of the encoder component within a neural network model, focusing on its repetitive nature and the multi-head attention mechanism. The encoder is composed of a feed-forward section and a multi-head attention segment, with residual connections facilitating gradient flow during training. The multi-head attention mechanism processes inputs as queries, keys, and values, allowing the model to assess information relevance and similarity. This mechanism is multi-headed, permitting division into parallel chunks for diverse perspectives in mapping. The multi-head attention blocks are subsequently combined and layer normalized with the residual input.

In the context of this thesis, the encoder component is an integral part of neural network models, characterized by its ability to be identically repeated and stacked N times, with each repetition refining the encoding's precision. This component is comprised of a feed-forward section and a multi-head attention segment. Notably, residual connections—such as those that transfer the original input to the output like in the Add Norm aspect—enhance training performance by facilitating the free flow of gradients during backpropagation. The multi-head attention segment is pivotal as it allows the division of inputs into queries, keys, and values, akin to an "information retrieval" system. For each token in the input sequence, a query is generated and compared to a set of keys that represent the values of interest. The retrieval of information from each value for a given query is contingent on the similarity between the keys and the query. This process is executed using self-attention, especially in encoding specific words within phrases. The term "multi-headed" refers to the ability to divide the combination of queries, keys, and values into N parallel chunks, thus enabling the model to consider multiple perspectives regarding the mappings being constructed. Ultimately, the multi-head attention blocks are amalgamated and layer normalized alongside the residual input.

text: Unsupervised multi-object scene decomposition is a rapidly developing problem in representation learning. Although notable progress has been made in static scenes, existing models are limited in their ability to utilize crucial dynamic cues present in video. We introduce a novel spatio-temporal iterative inference framework capable of jointly modeling complex multi-object representations and explicitly capturing temporal dependencies between latent variables across frames. This is accomplished by integrating 2D-LSTM, temporally conditioned inference, and generation within iterative amortized inference for posterior refinement. Our approach enhances the overall quality of decompositions, effectively encodes information about object dynamics, and enables trajectory prediction for each object individually. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our model maintains high accuracy even in the absence of color information. We showcase the decomposition, segmentation, and prediction capabilities of our model, and provide evidence that it surpasses state-of-the-art performance on several benchmark datasets, including one specifically curated for this work and to be made publicly available.

text:
**Tóm tắt ý chính:**
Đoạn văn nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng của các yêu cầu về tính bảo trì (maintainability), khả năng nâng cấp (upgradability), khả năng thích ứng (adaptability) và khả năng mở rộng (scalability/extensibility) đối với hệ thống web. Các yếu tố này đảm bảo hệ thống có thể dễ dàng sửa lỗi, cập nhật, thích nghi với thay đổi và mở rộng khi có nhu cầu. Công trình trích dẫn (ví dụ: Pressman & Maxim, 2020; Bass, Clements, & Kazman, 2012; ISO/IEC 25010:2011) khẳng định sự cần thiết của các thuộc tính này. Nghiên cứu hiện tại đóng góp bằng cách đề xuất một kiến trúc/phương pháp luận tập trung vào việc tối ưu hóa các khía cạnh này, đảm bảo hệ thống có thể phát triển bền vững.

**Đoạn văn viết lại:**
Trong bối cảnh các hệ thống web ngày càng phức tạp và yêu cầu nghiệp vụ thay đổi nhanh chóng, các thuộc tính chất lượng phi chức năng như tính bảo trì (maintainability) và khả năng nâng cấp (upgradability) đóng vai trò then chốt trong việc đảm bảo vòng đời và sự phát triển bền vững của ứng dụng (Pressman & Maxim, 2020). Một hệ thống được thiết kế tốt phải cho phép việc sửa lỗi, cải tiến hoặc bổ sung chức năng được thực hiện một cách hiệu quả, giảm thiểu chi phí và rủi ro. Song hành cùng với đó, khả năng nâng cấp và mở rộng (scalability/extensibility) là yếu tố không thể thiếu, đòi hỏi kiến trúc hệ thống phải đủ linh hoạt để thích ứng (adaptability) với các công nghệ mới, sự gia tăng về khối lượng dữ liệu hoặc lưu lượng người dùng mà không làm ảnh hưởng đến hiệu suất tổng thể (Bass, Clements, & Kazman, 2012). Tiêu chuẩn ISO/IEC 25010:2011 cũng đặc biệt nhấn mạnh các đặc tính này như một phần không thể thiếu của chất lượng phần mềm. Nhận thức rõ tầm quan trọng này, nghiên cứu hiện tại tập trung vào việc đề xuất và áp dụng một kiến trúc hệ thống có khả năng đáp ứng hiệu quả các yêu cầu về bảo trì và nâng cấp, cho phép trang web dễ dàng thích nghi và mở rộng khi có nhu cầu phát sinh, qua đó nâng cao giá trị và tuổi thọ của sản phẩm phần mềm.

text: Adagrad, also known as Adaptive Gradient, is a pivotal optimization algorithm employed in the training of machine learning models. This algorithm dynamically adjusts the learning rate of each parameter by considering the cumulative historical gradients encountered during the training process. Specifically, Adagrad allocates distinct learning rates to individual parameters, such that those parameters exhibiting larger gradients are assigned smaller learning rates, while parameters with smaller gradients are afforded larger learning rates. This adaptive approach facilitates more efficient convergence and can enhance the overall performance of the model, especially in scenarios where the training data exhibits varying degrees of sparsity.

text:
The selection of optimal data sources is a critical challenge in Bayesian learning, as it directly impacts the accuracy and efficiency of inference processes. This paper addresses the problem of near-optimal data source selection to enhance Bayesian learning outcomes. We propose a novel algorithmic framework that leverages probabilistic modeling and optimization techniques to identify the most informative data sources while minimizing computational overhead. Our approach integrates a hybrid sampling strategy with adaptive weighting mechanisms to dynamically prioritize data sources based on their contribution to the learning objective. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves significant improvements in prediction accuracy and computational efficiency compared to traditional selection methods. Furthermore, the framework exhibits robust performance across diverse datasets and learning scenarios, highlighting its versatility. The findings underscore the importance of strategic data source selection in Bayesian learning and provide a scalable solution for real-world applications, such as decision-making systems and predictive analytics. This research contributes to advancing the field by introducing a computationally efficient and theoretically grounded approach to data source optimization.  

**Keywords**: Bayesian learning, data source selection, probabilistic modeling, optimization, adaptive weighting, computational efficiency.

text: Cùng với sự phát triển kinh tế, hệ thống giáo dục Việt Nam đã trải qua những biến đổi đáng kể. Sự hình thành của khu vực tư nhân trong giáo dục đại học đã tạo ra một xu hướng mới, đó là sự cạnh tranh giữa các trường. text: Fully convolutional neural networks (F-CNNs) have established state-of-the-art performance in image segmentation across a wide range of applications. While architectural advancements in F-CNNs have primarily targeted improvements in spatial encoding and network connectivity to enhance gradient flow, this paper investigates an alternative approach: adaptively recalibrating feature maps to amplify salient features and suppress less informative ones. Inspired by the recently introduced squeeze & excitation (SE) module, which facilitates channel-wise recalibration of feature maps for image classification, we propose three novel SE module variants tailored for image segmentation tasks: (i) squeezing spatially and exciting channel-wise (cSE), (ii) squeezing channel-wise and exciting spatially (sSE), and (iii) concurrent spatial and channel squeeze & excitation (scSE). These SE modules are seamlessly integrated into three state-of-the-art F-CNN architectures—DenseNet, SD-Net, and U-Net—resulting in consistent performance improvements across all models with minimal impact on model complexity. Comprehensive evaluations are conducted on two challenging benchmarks: whole brain segmentation using the Multi-Atlas Labelling Challenge Dataset (MRI scans) and organ segmentation using the Visceral Dataset (whole body contrast-enhanced CT scans).

text: Recent years have witnessed a rapid proliferation of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and the concomitant development of accelerators designed to facilitate efficient CNN inference. Within the architecture community, the preponderance of research has focused on CNN inference for image recognition. However, the closely related problem of video recognition has received substantially less attention as an accelerator target. This oversight is particularly striking given that video recognition is demonstrably more computationally intensive than image recognition, and video traffic is projected to constitute the majority of internet traffic in the coming years. This paper addresses this crucial gap by providing a comprehensive design space exploration and a flexible architectural solution for accelerating 3D Convolutional Neural Networks (3D CNNs), which serve as the core computational kernel in modern video understanding. In contrast to the (2D) CNNs predominantly used for image recognition, the efficient acceleration of 3D CNNs presents a significant engineering challenge due to their large and temporally variable memory footprint, coupled with their inherently higher dimensionality. To address these challenges, we design a novel accelerator, named Morph, engineered to adaptively support diverse spatial and temporal tiling strategies, dynamically tailored to the specific requirements of each layer within a target 3D CNN. Furthermore, we co-design a robust software infrastructure alongside the Morph hardware to identify and implement optimal parameters for hardware control. Evaluated on state-of-the-art 3D CNNs, Morph achieves up to 3.4x (2.5x average) reduction in energy consumption and improves performance/watt by up to 5.1x (4x average) compared to a baseline 3D CNN accelerator, with an area overhead of 5%. Moreover, Morph demonstrates a 15.9x average energy reduction on 3D CNNs when compared to Eyeriss.

Background & Motivation: 
The increasing demand for English language proficiency has led to a growing need for innovative and engaging language learning tools. Traditional teaching methods often result in learner boredom and limited retention, highlighting the importance of exploring alternative approaches. This thesis addresses the potential of game-based learning in enhancing English language skills.

Objectives: 
The primary objective of this thesis is to design and develop a top-down action game using Unity, aimed at improving English language proficiency among learners. The game targets specific language skills, such as vocabulary, grammar, and reading comprehension, with the goal of increasing learner engagement and motivation.

Methodology: 
This project employs a mixed-methods approach, combining game development with language learning pedagogy. Unity game engine is utilized to create an immersive and interactive game environment, incorporating various language learning exercises and activities. The game's design and development are informed by theories of game-based learning and language acquisition.

Results & Expected Contributions: 
The developed game demonstrates a novel approach to language learning, offering an engaging and interactive experience for learners. The expected contributions of this research include the creation of a functional game prototype, an evaluation of its effectiveness in improving English language skills, and insights into the potential of game-based learning in language education.

Conclusion: 
This thesis presents a unique application of game development in language learning, highlighting the potential of top-down action games in enhancing English language proficiency. The findings of this research contribute to the growing field of game-based learning, suggesting future directions for the development of innovative language learning tools. Future studies can explore the effectiveness of this approach in various educational settings and its potential for adaptation to other languages and subjects.

text: This paper presents a novel approach to night vision obstacle detection and avoidance using bio-inspired vision sensors. The objective is to develop a robust and efficient system that mimics the exceptional low-light sensitivity of nocturnal animals, enabling safe navigation in poorly lit environments. Our approach utilizes a custom-designed vision sensor that emulates the structure and function of the human retina, combined with advanced image processing algorithms inspired by the visual processing mechanisms of nocturnal creatures. The system is evaluated on a range of nighttime scenarios, demonstrating significant improvements in obstacle detection accuracy and response time compared to traditional computer vision methods. The results show that our bio-inspired system can effectively detect and avoid obstacles in low-light conditions, with potential applications in autonomous vehicles, robotics, and surveillance systems. Key contributions include the development of a unique vision sensor design and the implementation of a novel image processing framework that leverages the principles of biological vision. Relevant keywords: bio-inspired vision, night vision, obstacle detection, autonomous systems, computer vision, image processing.

text:
This paper addresses the challenge of preserving depth perception in arbitrary style transfer, a critical limitation in existing methods that often overlook spatial structure during artistic rendering. We propose a novel depth-aware style transfer framework that integrates instance normalization with depth-aware feature modulation to maintain the spatial coherence of the stylized output. Our approach leverages a pre-trained depth estimation network to extract depth information, which is then used to guide the style transfer process. By incorporating depth-aware constraints into the instance normalization layers, our method ensures that the stylized images retain both the artistic style and the original depth structure. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework outperforms state-of-the-art style transfer methods in preserving depth perception while achieving high-quality artistic rendering. The proposed method is evaluated on diverse datasets, showcasing its robustness and versatility across various styles and content. This work contributes to the field of neural style transfer by introducing a depth-aware mechanism, enabling applications in augmented reality, 3D rendering, and digital art creation.  

**Keywords**: style transfer, instance normalization, depth perception, neural networks, image processing, artistic rendering.

text: Recent advancements in deep neural networks have significantly boosted image super-resolution (SR). Observing that many state-of-the-art deep SR architectures can be reformulated as single-state recurrent neural networks with finite unfoldings, we explore new structures based on this compact RNN view. This leads us to propose the Dual-State Recurrent Network (DSRN). Unlike single-state counterparts that operate at a fixed spatial resolution, DSRN exploits both low-resolution (LR) and high-resolution (HR) signals jointly, exchanging recurrent signals bidirectionally via delayed feedback. Extensive evaluations on benchmark datasets demonstrate DSRN's favorable performance against state-of-the-art algorithms in terms of both memory consumption and predictive accuracy. This novel dual-state design offers a promising direction for developing more efficient and accurate SR models.

text:
Đoạn tóm tắt:  
Đoạn văn trình bày những cải tiến của kiến trúc MT dựa trên Transformer nhằm thay thế CNN truyền thống trong các tác vụ trích xuất đặc trưng hình ảnh, đặc biệt chú trọng đến khả năng xử lý các nhiệm vụ dự đoán ở mức điểm ảnh và mức ảnh. Các đóng góp chính của MT bao gồm: chia ảnh thành các phần nhỏ chồng lấn để học biểu diễn phân giải cao, xây dựng mạng theo cấu trúc tự tháp nhằm giảm chi phí tính toán, thiết kế cơ chế attention hiệu quả, và loại bỏ position encoding (PE) truyền thống bằng mô đun kết hợp convolution và fully connected nhằm đảm bảo khả năng thích ứng với độ phân giải ảnh đầu vào bất kỳ mà không làm giảm hiệu năng.

Đoạn viết lại:  
Nhằm khắc phục các hạn chế còn tồn tại của các hệ thống trích xuất đặc trưng dựa trên CNN truyền thống, kiến trúc MT dựa trên Transformer đã được phát triển như một khung trích xuất đặc trưng tổng quát, phù hợp cho nhiều tác vụ phía sau như dự đoán ở cả mức ảnh và mức điểm ảnh. Đầu tiên, MT tiến hành phân chia ảnh đầu vào thành các phần nhỏ hơn, ví dụ như các ô 4×4 điểm ảnh, cho phép mô hình học được các biểu diễn với độ phân giải cao, điều này đặc biệt quan trọng đối với các nhiệm vụ yêu cầu dự đoán chi tiết ở mức điểm ảnh. Đồng thời, các phần này được thiết kế có sự chồng lấn lên nhau nhằm duy trì tính liên tục cục bộ của thông tin hình ảnh. Bên cạnh đó, cấu trúc mạng được xây dựng theo dạng tự tháp (pyramid), trong đó kích thước không gian của đặc trưng giảm dần ở các tầng sâu hơn, giúp giảm đáng kể chi phí tính toán đồng thời vẫn bảo toàn khả năng trích xuất cả đặc trưng thô ở độ phân giải cao lẫn đặc trưng trừu tượng ở độ phân giải thấp. Ngoài ra, MT còn thiết kế một cơ chế attention hiệu quả nhằm tối ưu hóa chi phí tính toán và độ phức tạp của mô hình. Đặc biệt, thay vì sử dụng cơ chế mã hóa vị trí (position encoding – PE) như trong Transformer truyền thống, MT loại bỏ hoàn toàn thành phần này do PE có kích thước cố định trong quá trình huấn luyện, dẫn đến việc phải nội suy trọng số PE khi kiểm tra với ảnh có độ phân giải khác, từ đó gây suy giảm độ chính xác. Để giải quyết vấn đề này, MT đề xuất một mô đun kết hợp giữa phép tích chập (convolution) và tầng kết nối đầy đủ (fully connected layer), qua đó vừa cung cấp thông tin vị trí cần thiết cho mô hình, vừa đảm bảo khả năng thích nghi với ảnh đầu vào có độ phân giải bất kỳ mà không làm ảnh hưởng đến hiệu năng tổng thể của hệ thống.

text: Despite remarkable advances in image synthesis research, existing works often fail in manipulating images under the context of large geometric transformations. Synthesizing person images conditioned on arbitrary poses is one of the most representative examples where the generation quality largely relies on the capability of identifying and modeling arbitrary transformations on different body parts. Current generative models are often built on local convolutions and overlook the key challenges (e.g. heavy occlusions, different views or dramatic appearance changes) when distinct geometric changes happen for each part, caused by arbitrary pose manipulations. This paper aims to resolve these challenges induced by geometric variability and spatial displacements via a new Soft-Gated Warping Generative Adversarial Network (Warping-GAN), which is composed of two stages: 1) it first synthesizes a target part segmentation map given a target pose, which depicts the region-level spatial layouts for guiding image synthesis with higher-level structure constraints; 2) the Warping-GAN equipped with a soft-gated warping-block learns feature-level mapping to render textures from the original image into the generated segmentation map. Warping-GAN is capable of controlling different transformation degrees given distinct target poses. Moreover, the proposed warping-block is light-weight and flexible enough to be injected into any networks. Human perceptual studies and quantitative evaluations demonstrate the superiority of our Warping-GAN that significantly outperforms all existing methods on two large datasets.

text: Entropic regularization of policies in Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a commonly used heuristic to ensure that the learned policy explores the state-space sufficiently before overfitting to a local optimal policy. The primary motivation for using entropy is for exploration and disambiguating optimal policies; however, the theoretical effects are not entirely understood. In this work, we study the more general regularized RL objective and using Fenchel duality; we derive the dual problem which takes the form of an adversarial reward problem. In particular, we find that the optimal policy found by a regularized objective is precisely an optimal policy of a reinforcement learning problem under a worst-case adversarial reward. Our result allows us to reinterpret the popular entropic regularization scheme as a form of robustification. Furthermore, due to the generality of our results, we apply to other existing regularization schemes. Our results thus give insights into the effects of regularization of policies and deepen our understanding of exploration through robust rewards at large.

text: This paper investigates the CHARME (Conditional Heteroscedastic Autoregressive Mixture of Experts) model, a generalized mixture of nonlinear nonparametric AR-ARCH time series. We establish its stationarity, ergodicity, and \tau-weak dependence under certain Lipschitz-type conditions on the autoregressive and volatility functions, conditions significantly weaker than in existing literature. This result forms the theoretical basis for an asymptotic theory of (non)parametric estimation for this model. As an application, leveraging the universal approximation property of neural networks (NN), we develop a learning theory for NN-based autoregressive functions within CHARME, guaranteeing strong consistency and asymptotic normality for the NN weight and bias estimators under weak conditions.

text: Delay-based netcode represents an evolution of the traditional lockstep model, a foundational approach wherein game progression is halted until all players' inputs are gathered. This model is predominantly employed in turn-based games, where the strategic nature allows players to deliberate over their moves without the disruption of a noticeable delay, even one extending up to half a second. However, adapting the lockstep model to real-time genres such as fighting games necessitates the incorporation of input latency. Input latency introduces a deliberate delay between the input and its corresponding action, ensuring that both players have received each other's inputs before the game simulation advances. This approach guarantees synchronization across all local game versions. The integration of lockstep methodology with input latency is widely recognized as "Delay-Based Networking," a technique that has been utilized for decades in video games, including "Age of Empires." Implementing delay-based networking requires minimal adjustments to the core game loop, offering simplicity in execution. Nonetheless, this simplicity is offset by drawbacks in responsiveness and flexibility. Should there be a spike or variation in latency, often due to suboptimal network conditions, the game may experience prolonged pauses as it awaits the receipt of all necessary inputs.

text:
Graph-structured data plays a pivotal role in various applications, from social network analysis to recommendation systems. However, the vulnerability of graph-based models to adversarial attacks remains a critical concern. This paper investigates the robustness of graph neural networks (GNNs) against adversarial perturbations, focusing on how structured data can be manipulated to degrade model performance. We propose a novel adversarial attack framework that leverages gradient-based optimization to identify and perturb critical edges and nodes in the graph structure. Our approach is designed to minimize detectability while maximizing the impact on model predictions. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that even minor perturbations can significantly reduce the accuracy of state-of-the-art GNNs, highlighting their susceptibility to adversarial attacks. Furthermore, we analyze the transferability of these attacks across different GNN architectures, revealing insights into their generalizability. This study underscores the need for robust defenses in graph-based learning systems and provides a foundation for future research in adversarial robustness for structured data. Key contributions include a scalable attack methodology, empirical validation of GNN vulnerabilities, and a discussion on potential mitigation strategies.  

**Keywords**: Graph Neural Networks, Adversarial Attacks, Robustness, Graph-structured Data, Perturbation, Transferability.
label: deepseek-text

text: An open secret in contemporary machine learning is that many models work beautifully on standard benchmarks but fail to generalize outside the lab. This has been attributed to biased training data, which provide poor coverage over real world events. Generative models are no exception, but recent advances in generative adversarial networks (GANs) suggest otherwise - these models can now synthesize strikingly realistic and diverse images. Is generative modeling of photos a solved problem? We show that although current GANs can fit standard datasets very well, they still fall short of being comprehensive models of the visual manifold. In particular, we study their ability to fit simple transformations such as camera movements and color changes. We find that the models reflect the biases of the datasets on which they are trained (e.g., centered objects), but that they also exhibit some capacity for generalization: by "steering" in latent space, we can shift the distribution while still creating realistic images. We hypothesize that the degree of distributional shift is related to the breadth of the training data distribution. Thus, we conduct experiments to quantify the limits of GAN transformations and introduce techniques to mitigate the problem. Code is released on our project page: https://ali-design.github.io/gan_steerability/

text:
This paper addresses the challenge of improving the efficiency of knowledge transfer in Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) training by leveraging semantic and visual similarities. Traditional CNN training often requires extensive labeled datasets, which are costly and time-consuming to acquire. To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel approach that integrates semantic relationships and visual features to enhance knowledge transfer across related tasks. Our method employs a dual-path architecture, where one path focuses on extracting semantic embeddings from textual data, while the other extracts visual features from images. These embeddings are then aligned using a similarity-based loss function, enabling the model to transfer knowledge more effectively between domains. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance compared to existing methods, reducing the need for large labeled datasets while maintaining high accuracy. The proposed framework not only improves training efficiency but also generalizes well to unseen tasks, making it a valuable tool for applications in computer vision and beyond. This work contributes to the field by introducing a scalable and resource-efficient solution for knowledge transfer in CNNs, with potential applications in areas such as medical imaging, autonomous systems, and multimedia analysis.  

**Keywords**: Convolutional Neural Networks, Knowledge Transfer, Semantic Embeddings, Visual Features, Similarity Learning, Efficient Training.
label: deepseek-text

text: Modular Sparse Distributed Codes (MSDCs) offer a neurally plausible framework for understanding how the brain encodes information in sparse, distributed patterns, particularly within structures such as the neocortex and hippocampus. MSDCs address two fundamental challenges in neuroscience: forming cell assemblies or codes based on single exposures and ensuring that the similarity between inputs is preserved in the similarity of their neural representations. An MSDC coding field is organized into multiple winner-take-all competitive modules, each containing several binary units that resemble principal cells. This architecture enables an unsupervised, single-trial learning process that preserves input similarity and maintains constant computational complexity regardless of the number of stored items. The learning algorithm operates by introducing a controlled amount of noise into the code selection process, with the noise level modulated by the novelty of the input. This mechanism ensures that the overlap between the codes of two inputs is proportional to their similarity, thus embedding similarity relationships into the intersection structure of the stored codes. Additionally, the modular coding scheme allows for efficient fixed-time retrieval and belief updating, making it a promising model for both biological and artificial systems.

text: Flexibility: LSTM networks can be designed with multiple layers and neurons, allowing them to capture intricate patterns and relationships in the data. For instance, a deeper network with more layers might be better suited for capturing highly complex, non-linear dependencies present in high-frequency trading data, whereas a shallower architecture could suffice for longer-term price trend analysis where the underlying patterns are less convoluted. This scalability in model complexity, combined with the inherent ability of LSTMs to handle sequential information through their recurrent connections and memory cells, ensures that they can be fine-tuned to optimize predictive performance across a diverse range of cryptocurrency assets and market conditions, thereby offering a significant advantage over more rigid modeling techniques.

text: This paper addresses the challenge of enhancing the resolution of wavelet-encoded images, a crucial task in various image processing applications. Our objective is to develop an efficient super-resolution technique that can effectively reconstruct high-quality images from their wavelet-encoded counterparts. We propose a novel approach that leverages the properties of wavelet transforms and deep learning-based methods to achieve superior image reconstruction. Our method utilizes a convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture to learn the mapping between wavelet-encoded images and their high-resolution counterparts. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, achieving significant improvements in peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and visual information fidelity (VIF). The proposed technique has important implications for various applications, including image compression, denoising, and reconstruction. Key contributions of this research include the development of a wavelet-encoded image super-resolution framework, the design of a novel CNN architecture, and the demonstration of its effectiveness in reconstructing high-quality images. Relevant keywords: super-resolution, wavelet encoding, deep learning, image reconstruction, CNN architecture.

text: Lực lượng quân đội tham gia sản xuất và xây dựng kinh tế đang là một nguồn lực to lớn của đất nước, mang lại hiệu quả rất lớn về kinh tế - xã hội và quốc phòng - an ninh. Đây là kết quả từ quan điểm xuyên suốt và nhất quán của Chủ tịch Hồ Chí Minh, Trung ương Đảng về quân đội tham gia sản xuất, xây dựng kinh tế. Tham gia sản xuất, xây dựng kinh tế là một trong ba chức năng, nhiệm vụ của quân đội. Bên cạnh nhiệm vụ chiến đấu và sẵn sàng chiến đấu bảo vệ Tổ quốc, giữ vững quốc phòng - an ninh, quân đội đang ngày càng khẳng định vai trò, vị trí trên lĩnh vực kinh tế. Quân đội tham gia xây dựng kinh tế vừa góp phần phát triển kinh tế - xã hội, vừa tăng cường sức chiến đấu cho quân đội, củng cố quốc phòng đất nước. Trong công cuộc công nghiệp hóa, hiện đại hóa đất nước hiện nay, hoạt động tham gia xây dựng kinh tế kết hợp với quốc phòng càng trở nên đa dạng và phong phú hơn. Bên cạnh việc xây dựng các doanh nghiệp quân đội, quân đội còn tham gia xây dựng các khu kinh tế - quốc phòng, các đoàn kinh tế - quốc phòng, cơ sở chính trị - xã hội… ở những vùng sâu, vùng xa, vùng biên giới, hải đảo. Chúng góp phần quan trọng vào việc xây dựng tiềm lực kinh tế và quốc phòng vững mạnh, củng cố thế trận quốc phòng toàn dân và an ninh nhân dân, tạo điều kiện thuận lợi để phát triển kinh tế - xã hội bền vững, đồng thời nâng cao khả năng phòng thủ và bảo vệ Tổ quốc. text:
Scene graphs have emerged as a powerful tool for representing the structural and semantic relationships within images, offering a promising approach for image captioning tasks. However, recent studies have questioned their effectiveness, citing limitations in scalability and computational overhead. This paper revisits the role of scene graphs in image captioning, arguing that their potential remains underexplored. We propose a novel framework that leverages scene graphs to enhance caption generation by explicitly modeling object interactions and contextual dependencies. Our approach integrates a graph-based encoder with a transformer-based decoder, enabling the model to capture fine-grained visual relationships while maintaining computational efficiency. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art captioning models, achieving significant improvements in both accuracy and diversity of generated captions. Furthermore, we provide a detailed analysis of how scene graphs contribute to better semantic understanding and context-aware caption generation. This work not only defends the utility of scene graphs in image captioning but also introduces a scalable and effective framework that bridges the gap between structural representation and natural language generation. The findings highlight the importance of structured visual representations in advancing image understanding and captioning systems.  

**Keywords**: scene graphs, image captioning, transformer models, object interactions, semantic relationships, natural language generation.
label: deepseek-text

text: Solving multi-goal reinforcement learning (RL) problems with sparse rewards is generally challenging. Existing approaches have utilized goal relabeling on collected experiences to alleviate issues raised from sparse rewards. However, these methods are still limited in efficiency and cannot make full use of experiences. In this paper, we propose Model-based Hindsight Experience Replay (MHER), which exploits experiences more efficiently by leveraging environmental dynamics to generate virtual achieved goals. Replacing original goals with virtual goals generated from interaction with a trained dynamics model leads to a novel relabeling method,  (MBR). Based on MBR, MHER performs both reinforcement learning and supervised learning for efficient policy improvement. Theoretically, we also prove the supervised part in MHER, i.e., goal-conditioned supervised learning with MBR data, optimizes a lower bound on the multi-goal RL objective. Experimental results in several point-based tasks and simulated robotics environments show that MHER achieves significantly higher sample efficiency than previous state-of-the-art methods.

text: Video super-resolution (VSR) aims to enhance the resolution of low-quality videos, a critical task in applications such as video streaming, surveillance, and medical imaging. However, existing VSR methods often overlook the impact of compression artifacts, which degrade video quality and hinder reconstruction performance. This paper introduces **COMISR**, a novel **Compression-Informed Video Super-Resolution** framework designed to address this challenge. COMISR integrates a compression-aware module into the VSR pipeline, enabling the model to explicitly account for and mitigate compression artifacts during the reconstruction process. Leveraging a hybrid deep learning architecture, the framework combines convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with attention mechanisms to enhance spatial and temporal feature extraction. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that COMISR outperforms state-of-the-art VSR methods in terms of both quantitative metrics (e.g., PSNR and SSIM) and visual quality. The proposed approach achieves significant improvements in artifact reduction and detail preservation, particularly for highly compressed videos. This work highlights the importance of compression-aware modeling in VSR and provides a robust solution for real-world video enhancement tasks. Keywords: video super-resolution, compression artifacts, deep learning, attention mechanisms, video enhancement.
label: deepseek-text

text: Smart contracts  are the core of the blockchain system, responsible for implementing logic and permissions predefined by the developer. Even so, smart contracts are difficult to operate properly. Value storage, transparency, and immutability are key attributes essential for smart contracts to function effectively. However, these properties also make many smart contracts pose security risks and are "prey" that many cybercriminals target. Even when targeted attacks are not carried out, many cases still involve financial resources being tied up and companies losing money due to errors and security vulnerabilities in contracts caused by intelligence.Some smart contract attacks include the DAO attack in June 2016, where the DAO was hacked and 3.6 million Ether (equivalent to 50 million USD) was stolen using the first reentrancy attack. The Ethereum Foundation later issued a significant update to roll back the hack. This led to Ethereum being divided into Ethereum Classic and Ethereum. Another attack can be mentioned as FTX injection. The attacker embedded malicious code into the FTX network system and caused damage of up to 600 million USD, spreading malicious code to users using the FTX application.

text: The payload section of the JWT is where this information, typically referred to as 'claims,' is stored. Claims are statements about an entity, usually the user, and can include standard registered claims such as `iss` (issuer), `exp` (expiration time), and `sub` (subject), alongside custom claims specific to the application’s context, like user roles or permissions. Because these claims are embedded directly within the token, JWTs enable the transmission of user state and authorizations in a compact and self-contained manner, reducing the need for repeated database lookups on the server-side and thereby supporting efficient stateless authentication mechanisms.

text: Quá trình xử lý chiếu xạ cắt mạch đã được công nhận là một phương pháp hiệu quả để phân hủy polysaccharide thành các phân đoạn có kích thước và khối lượng phân tử nhỏ hơn, thậm chí tạo ra oligosaccharide với hoạt tính sinh học được cải thiện. Nghiên cứu này nhằm mục tiêu xác định một số đặc tính của xanthan sau khi được chiếu xạ, hướng đến ứng dụng trong sản xuất phân bón lá. Dung dịch xanthan 2% được chiếu xạ bằng chùm điện tử (EB) với liều lượng 10, 20, 30 và 50 kGy, ở các suất liều 1,5; 3,5 và 7,5 kGy/s. Nghiên cứu tập trung vào ảnh hưởng của liều chiếu xạ và suất liều đến một số đặc tính của xanthan trong trạng thái dung dịch. Kết quả cho thấy độ nhớt và khối lượng phân tử của xanthan giảm khi liều xạ và suất liều tăng. Chiếu xạ EB không thay đổi cấu trúc của xanthan, mặc dù phổ hấp thụ phân tử (UV-Vis) và máy quang phổ hồng ngoại biến đổi Fourier (FT-IR) đều cho thấy đỉnh hấp thụ liên quan đến nhóm carbonyl tăng, do quá trình cắt mạch dẫn đến sự hình thành các liên kết đôi C=O trong phân tử. Những phân đoạn xanthan bị cắt mạch có độ linh động cao hơn, do đó độ kết tinh và nhiệt độ nóng chảy của xanthan chiếu xạ cũng cao hơn.

text: This paper introduces PISE, a novel approach to person image synthesis and editing utilizing a decoupled Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) architecture. The objective is to generate high-quality, photorealistic person images while allowing for flexible editing capabilities. Our method employs a two-stage framework, where the first stage focuses on generating a person's appearance, and the second stage concentrates on pose and shape adjustment. This decoupling enables more precise control over the synthesis process. We evaluate PISE on various benchmarks, demonstrating its superiority over existing methods in terms of image quality, diversity, and editing flexibility. The results show that PISE achieves state-of-the-art performance in person image synthesis, with significant improvements in preserving identity and pose consistency. Our approach has potential applications in fields such as computer vision, robotics, and virtual reality, particularly in areas like character generation, video game development, and social media content creation. Key contributions of this work include the introduction of a decoupled GAN architecture for person image synthesis and editing, and the demonstration of its effectiveness in generating high-quality, editable person images. Relevant keywords: person image synthesis, generative adversarial networks, image editing, computer vision, deep learning.

text: To enhance robust object detection in complex real-world scenarios, particularly where contextual scene understanding and significant layout variations are present, we propose a novel context-aware object detection method. This approach is based on a retrieve-and-transform scene layout model, which first retrieves a coarse scene layout from a codebook of typical layout templates. To effectively handle large layout variations, we utilize a variant of the spatial transformer network to transform and refine the retrieved layout, generating interpretable and semantically meaningful feature maps of object locations and scales. These steps are implemented as a Layout Transfer Network, which is integrated into Faster RCNN to enable joint reasoning of object detection and scene layout estimation. Extensive experiments on three public datasets verified that our approach provides consistent performance improvements to the state-of-the-art object detection baselines on a variety of challenging tasks. These results highlight the potential for more robust and contextually aware detection systems, offering significant implications for applications in the traffic surveillance and the autonomous driving domains by improving their real-world adaptability.

text: In recent years, cross-spectral iris recognition has emerged as a promising biometric approach to establish the identity of individuals. However, matching iris images acquired at different spectral bands (i.e., matching a visible (VIS) iris probe to a gallery of near-infrared (NIR) iris images or vice versa) shows a significant performance degradation when compared to intraband NIR matching. Hence, in this paper, we have investigated a range of deep convolutional generative adversarial network (DCGAN) architectures to further improve the accuracy of cross-spectral iris recognition methods. Moreover, unlike the existing works in the literature, we introduce a resolution difference into the classical cross-spectral matching problem domain. We have developed two different techniques using the conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) as a backbone architecture for cross-spectral iris matching. In the first approach, we simultaneously address the cross-resolution and cross-spectral matching problem by training a cGAN that jointly translates cross-resolution as well as cross-spectral tasks to the same resolution and within the same spectrum. In the second approach, we design a coupled generative adversarial network (cpGAN) architecture consisting of a pair of cGAN modules that project the VIS and NIR iris images into a low-dimensional embedding domain to ensure maximum pairwise similarity between the feature vectors from the two iris modalities of the same subject.

text: Trong bối cảnh an ninh mạng ngày càng phức tạp, việc thiết lập các biện pháp bảo mật mạnh mẽ là vô cùng cần thiết đối với bất kỳ hệ thống phần mềm nào xử lý dữ liệu người dùng. This paper addresses the challenge of efficient dictionary learning in high-dimensional data spaces, a critical task in signal processing and machine learning. Traditional dictionary learning methods often suffer from high computational complexity and memory requirements, limiting their scalability. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel compressed dictionary learning framework that leverages sparse coding and dimensionality reduction techniques. Our approach integrates a compression step into the learning process, significantly reducing storage and computational overhead while maintaining reconstruction accuracy. We evaluate the proposed method on benchmark datasets, comparing it with state-of-the-art dictionary learning algorithms. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework achieves comparable or superior performance in terms of reconstruction quality, while reducing memory usage by up to 40% and computational time by 30%. The proposed method is particularly effective for applications involving large-scale datasets, such as image processing and natural language processing. This work contributes to the field by introducing a scalable and resource-efficient solution for dictionary learning, with potential applications in real-time systems and edge computing environments.  

**Keywords**: dictionary learning, sparse coding, dimensionality reduction, signal processing, machine learning, scalability.

Bài báo này giới thiệu mô hình Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network (LSTM), một dạng đặc biệt của Mạng nơ-ron hồi quy (RNN), để dự báo mực nước sông Cấm tại trạm Cửa Cấm. Mô hình chỉ cần dữ liệu mực nước từ các trạm thủy văn và hải văn, không sử dụng dữ liệu lượng mưa từ các trạm Cao Kênh, Kiến An, Phù Liễn, Cửa Cấm do hệ số tương quan thấp. Đánh giá độ chính xác dự báo sử dụng hệ số Nash, Sai số bình phương trung bình (RMSE), và Sai số tuyệt đối trung bình (MAE) cho thấy kết quả có độ chính xác cao và đủ tin cậy. Mô hình này có thể áp dụng cho sông Cấm và các sông khác ở Hải Phòng.

Cụ thể, bảng này lưu trữ các thông tin thiết yếu như định danh nhân viên, tên và mã hợp đồng, loại hợp đồng (bao gồm hợp đồng thời vụ, hợp đồng có thời hạn và hợp đồng không thời hạn), ngày bắt đầu và kết thúc hiệu lực của hợp đồng, ngày ký kết cũng như trạng thái hiện tại của hợp đồng (bao gồm các trạng thái như chưa có hiệu lực, đang có hiệu lực, hết hạn hoặc đã được thanh lý). Việc xây dựng cấu trúc cơ sở dữ liệu theo mô hình này không chỉ đảm bảo tính nhất quán và đầy đủ cho quá trình quản lý hợp đồng mà còn tạo tiền đề cho việc tích hợp, mở rộng các chức năng quản lý lương, phụ cấp và khen thưởng cho nhân viên như đã minh họa ở Hình 4.5. So với các nghiên cứu trước đây chủ yếu tập trung vào quản lý thông tin hợp đồng ở cấp độ cơ bản (Nguyễn Văn A và cộng sự, 2020; Trần Thị B, 2021), mô hình hiện tại đã bổ sung các trường dữ liệu quan trọng như trạng thái hợp đồng và các mốc thời gian quan trọng, góp phần nâng cao hiệu quả kiểm soát vòng đời hợp đồng lao động trong tổ chức.

text: Vision Transformers (ViTs) and MLPs signal a shift from hand-wired features and inductive biases towards general-purpose neural architectures. These models often require massive data, such as large-scale pretraining and/or repeated strong data augmentations, yet face optimization challenges (e.g., sensitivity to initialization and learning rate). This paper investigates ViTs and MLP-Mixers through their loss geometry to improve training data efficiency and inference generalization. Visualization and Hessian reveal extremely sharp local minima of converged models. Promoting smoothness with a sharpness-aware optimizer substantially improves the accuracy and robustness of ViTs and MLP-Mixers across supervised, adversarial, contrastive, and transfer learning. For instance, this yields +5.3% and +11.0% top-1 ImageNet accuracy for ViT-B/16 and Mixer-B/16, respectively, with simple Inception-style preprocessing. We show this improved smoothness attributes to sparser active neurons in the first few layers. The resultant ViTs outperform ResNets of similar size and throughput when trained from scratch on ImageNet without large-scale pretraining or strong data augmentations, and also possess more perceptive attention maps.
label: human---gemini-text

Việc thực hiện tuyên truyền và áp dụng các biện pháp mang tính thể chế để giảm thiểu và ngăn chặn việc buôn bán lợn chết do bệnh cũng cần được tiến hành nhằm hạn chế sự lây lan dịch bệnh trong đàn lợn địa phương. text: This paper presents a novel self-supervised approach to mapping language and noisy real-world videos, enabling machines to watch and learn from unlabelled video data. The objective is to develop a model that can effectively associate linguistic descriptions with corresponding visual content in videos, despite the presence of noise and irrelevant information. Our method leverages a multimodal fusion framework, combining vision and language models to learn a shared representation space. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the efficacy of our approach in learning robust and generalizable mappings between language and video, outperforming existing supervised and self-supervised methods. Our results show significant improvements in video retrieval and description generation tasks, with applications in areas such as video search, recommendation systems, and human-computer interaction. The key contributions of this work include the introduction of a self-supervised learning paradigm for multimodal video understanding, and the development of a noise-robust video-language mapping model. Our approach has the potential to unlock the vast amounts of unlabelled video data available, enabling machines to learn from real-world videos and improving the state-of-the-art in video understanding and generation. Key keywords: self-supervised learning, multimodal fusion, video-language mapping, noise-robust learning, computer vision, natural language processing.
label: llama-text

text: Smart contracts form the foundational infrastructure of blockchain systems, facilitating the execution of predefined logic and permissions established by developers. Despite their critical role, ensuring their flawless operation remains a significant challenge. Key attributes such as value storage, transparency, and immutability are indispensable for the effective functioning of smart contracts. Nevertheless, these very characteristics concurrently render smart contracts highly susceptible to security risks, making them prime targets for cybercriminals. Even in the absence of direct targeted attacks, numerous instances demonstrate how financial resources can become inaccessible and companies incur substantial losses due to inherent errors and security vulnerabilities. Notable historical incidents illustrate these dangers, including the DAO attack in June 2016, which involved the theft of 3.6 million Ether (equivalent to 50 million USD) through the first recorded reentrancy attack. This pivotal event necessitated a substantial update from the Ethereum Foundation to revert the hack, consequently leading to the split of Ethereum into Ethereum and Ethereum Classic. Another significant event, the FTX injection, saw attackers embed malicious code within the FTX network system, resulting in damages estimated at 600 million USD and the widespread dissemination of malicious code to users leveraging the FTX application. These pervasive and costly incidents highlight the urgent need for sophisticated vulnerability detection mechanisms, a challenge this research aims to address by enhancing multi-label vulnerability detection of smart contracts using language models.
label: gemini-text

text: This paper addresses the challenge of unsupervised domain adaptive object detection, where the goal is to adapt an object detector trained on a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain without access to the source data. Our objective is to develop a novel approach that can effectively bridge the domain gap and improve detection performance on the target domain. We propose a method that leverages pseudo-labeling and self-supervised learning to adapt the detector, eliminating the need for source data. Our approach utilizes a teacher-student framework, where a teacher model generates pseudo-labels for the target domain, and a student model is trained using these labels. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, outperforming state-of-the-art unsupervised domain adaptation techniques. Our findings show that the proposed approach can achieve significant improvements in object detection accuracy on the target domain, with applications in areas such as autonomous driving and surveillance. The key contributions of this work include a novel domain adaptation framework, improved detection performance, and the ability to adapt to new domains without requiring source data, making it a valuable contribution to the field of computer vision and object detection. Keywords: unsupervised domain adaptation, object detection, pseudo-labeling, self-supervised learning, teacher-student framework.

The system leverages advanced computer vision, machine learning, and robotic control algorithms to achieve high-precision object detection, grasping, and placement. A modular architecture integrates real-time sensor data processing, adaptive motion planning, and robust error handling to ensure reliability in diverse scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate the system's ability to achieve a 95% success rate in picking tasks across a variety of object shapes, sizes, and textures, outperforming traditional rule-based approaches. Key innovations include a novel grasp prediction model and a dynamic collision avoidance framework, which significantly enhance operational efficiency and safety. The findings highlight the system's potential for applications in logistics, manufacturing, and warehouse automation, offering a scalable and cost-effective solution for industries seeking to optimize their operations. This research contributes to the growing field of robotic automation by providing a comprehensive framework for developing intelligent picking systems capable of handling real-world complexities.  

**Keywords**: robotic picking, computer vision, machine learning, object manipulation, automation, grasp prediction, collision avoidance.

text: The work by H. Schwenk, titled “Continuous space translation models for phrase-based statistical machine translation,” presented at COLING (Posters) and edited by M. Kay and C. Boitet at the Indian Institute of Technology Bombay in 2012 (pages 1071–1080), provides a foundational approach that is particularly relevant for domain-oriented machine translation between English and Vietnamese. Schwenk’s research introduces continuous space models that enhance phrase-based statistical machine translation by embedding phrases into continuous vector spaces, enabling better generalization and capturing semantic similarities beyond discrete phrase matching. This approach is crucial for domain-specific translation tasks where vocabulary and phrase usage can vary significantly, such as in technical, medical, or legal domains common in Vietnamese translations. By utilizing continuous space representations, the model can more effectively handle rare or unseen phrases, improving translation accuracy and fluency in specialized domains. The methodology outlined in this work complements traditional statistical models by integrating neural network-based representations, which are instrumental in addressing challenges posed by the linguistic differences and syntactic structures unique to English and Vietnamese. Consequently, incorporating Schwenk’s continuous space translation models into domain-oriented machine translation frameworks can substantially improve performance by reducing out-of-vocabulary issues and enhancing contextual understanding, thus providing a robust foundation for developing advanced English-Vietnamese translation systems tailored to specific professional fields.

text: Attention-based scene text recognizers have achieved significant success by utilizing compact intermediate representations and RNN-based encoder-decoder architectures to learn 1d- or 2d-attention, but they are limited by attention-drift due to the high similarity among encoded features and by inefficiencies stemming from poor parallelization. To address these challenges, this paper introduces MASTER, a self-attention based scene text recognizer that encodes both input-output attention and self-attention, thereby learning feature-feature and target-target relationships within the encoder and decoder, produces a more robust intermediate representation to handle spatial distortion, and benefits from enhanced training efficiency and high-speed inference through effective parallelization and a memory-cache mechanism. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks demonstrate that MASTER achieves superior performance on both regular and irregular scene text, supporting its promise for advancing scene text recognition and motivating future research into further optimizing self-attention architectures for robust and efficient text understanding in complex visual environments. Pytorch code can be found at https://github.com/wenwenyu/MASTER-pytorch, and Tensorflow code can be found at https://github.com/jiangxiluning/MASTER-TF.

text: User modeling through the analysis of mobile device photo and video galleries facilitates personalized preference prediction. This research introduces a novel engine employing scene recognition, object detection, and facial analysis for this purpose. The methodology involves initial clustering of faces within the gallery, enabling offline processing of private media containing faces from significant clusters directly on the embedded system. Other images can be optionally processed on a remote server utilizing very deep models for enhanced analysis. Visual features extracted from scene recognition and object detection models are subsequently aggregated into a unified user descriptor using a neural attention block. Implemented for the Android mobile platform, this proposed pipeline demonstrates efficient image processing with minimal degradation in accuracy. Experimental validation on subsets of the Photo Event Collection, Web Image Dataset for Event Recognition, and Amazon Fashion datasets confirms the system's capability to efficiently process images without significant performance compromise, offering a robust solution for on-device user preference inference from visual data. text: We propose a novel estimator of the mutual information between two ordinal vectors x and y. Our approach is inductive (as opposed to deductive) in that it depends on the data generating distribution solely through some nonparametric properties revealing associations in the data, and does not require having enough data to fully characterize the true joint distributions P_. Specifically, our approach consists of (i) noting that I\left(y; x\right) = I\left(u_y; u_x\right) where u_y and u_x are the copula-uniform dual representations of y and x (i.e. their images under the probability integral transform), and (ii) estimating the copula entropies h\left(u_y\right), h\left(u_x\right) and h\left(u_y, u_x\right) by solving a maximum-entropy problem over the space of copula densities under a constraint of the type \alpha_m = E\left[\phi_m(u_y, u_x)\right]. We prove that, so long as the constraint is feasible, this problem admits a unique solution, it is in the exponential family, and it can be learned by solving a convex optimization problem. The resulting estimator, which we denote MIND, is marginal-invariant, always non-negative, unbounded for any sample size n, consistent, has MSE rate O(1/n), and is more data-efficient than competing approaches. Beyond mutual information estimation, we illustrate that our approach may be used to mitigate mode collapse in GANs by maximizing the entropy of the copula of fake samples, a model we refer to as Copula Entropy Regularized GAN (CER-GAN).

text: Definition 7 (Run length limited de Bruijn (RdB) sequence) .A sequence s= (s1, s2, . . . , s n)∈Σnis called a (k, s)-run length limited de Bruijn (RdB) sequence of length nif it is a de Bruijn sequence of order kand a s-RLL sequence of length n. This combination is particularly relevant in quantum communication due to the unique properties each type of sequence offers. A de Bruijn sequence of order k is a cyclic sequence over an alphabet Σ in which every possible k-tuple appears exactly once as a contiguous substring, making it a maximal length sequence (MLS) for its given order and alphabet size. This inherent property of unique substrings is critical for applications requiring precise state identification, synchronization, and addressing within complex quantum protocols, as it allows for unambiguous decoding of information based on short segments. Concurrently, an s-RLL (Run Length Limited) sequence imposes constraints on the number of consecutive identical symbols, typically defined by minimum ($d$) and maximum ($k$) run lengths (e.g., a ($d$, $k$)-RLL sequence limits runs of zeros between ones). In the context of quantum communication, such RLL constraints are crucial for practical implementation by mitigating issues like baseline wander and intersymbol interference (ISI) in optical or microwave channels, ensuring self-clocking capabilities, and managing the physical coherence of quantum states over time. For instance, excessively long runs of a single quantum state (e.g., a continuous stream of $|0\rangle$) could lead to receiver saturation, drift, or decoherence effects in the physical medium. Therefore, an RdB sequence synergistically provides the structural richness of de Bruijn sequences for efficient information encoding and recovery, alongside the physical robustness and synchronization advantages afforded by RLL constraints, thereby enabling more reliable and high-fidelity quantum information transmission in noisy quantum channels.
label: human---gemini-text

text: In the continual learning setting, tasks are encountered sequentially. The goal is to learn whilst i) avoiding catastrophic forgetting, ii) efficiently using model capacity, and iii) employing forward and backward transfer learning. In this paper, we explore how the Variational Continual Learning (VCL) framework achieves these desiderata on two benchmarks in continual learning: split MNIST and permuted MNIST. We first report significantly improved results on what was already a competitive approach. The improvements are achieved by establishing a new best practice approach to mean-field variational Bayesian neural networks. We then look at the solutions in detail. This allows us to obtain an understanding of why VCL performs as it does, and we compare the solution to what an `ideal' continual learning solution might be.

text: Crowdsourcing often faces limitations in scenarios where labelers, lacking full expertise, find it difficult to provide answers to full classification questions. To overcome this, we propose a comprehensive probabilistic model designed for shorter "yes" or "no" queries, significantly easing the discernment burden on labelers. Our model precisely estimates the joint posterior distribution of labeler confusion matrices and the posterior probability of each object's true class, employing an approximate inference approach combining Monte Carlo Sampling and Black Box Variational Inference. Evaluated across two realistic crowdsourcing experiments—irregular astronomical time-series and animal image classification—our model achieved results comparable to traditional full query methods. Crucially, we demonstrate that explicitly modeling labelers' failures plays a vital role in accurately estimating true classes. This contribution includes two novel real datasets obtained from our experiments and publicly available code, fostering further research and development in simplified crowdsourcing paradigms.

text: ADB (Android Debug Bridge) : Enables communication with Android de vices, supporting tasks like app installation, debugging, and runtime behaviormonitoring. This foundational capability makes ADB an indispensable component for the dynamic analysis module within the proposed Android malware scanner framework. Specifically, the scanner leverages ADB to automate the secure installation of suspicious application packages (APKs) onto controlled virtual or physical Android environments, initiating their execution to observe their runtime behavior in isolation. The debugging functionalities offered by ADB are critical for attaching to the executed applications' processes, thereby enabling the interception of system calls, monitoring of network traffic, and inspection of memory, all of which are vital indicators of malicious activity. Furthermore, ADB's support for runtime behavior monitoring allows for the comprehensive collection of logcat outputs, tracking of file system modifications, and observation of inter-process communication, collectively contributing to a detailed behavioral profile of the application under scrutiny. This direct interaction capability is paramount for identifying sophisticated or evasive malware that employs anti-static analysis techniques, as it facilitates the observation of the malware's true operational characteristics in a live environment. Consequently, the robust integration of ADB forms a core pillar of the scanner's dynamic analysis engine, ensuring thorough and accurate detection capabilities by simulating real-world execution scenarios.

text: Probabilistic graphical models are a key tool in machine learning applications. Computing the partition function, i.e., normalizing constant, is a fundamental task of statistical inference but it is generally computationally intractable, leading to extensive study of approximation methods. Iterative variational methods are a popular and successful family of approaches. However, even state of the art variational methods can return poor results or fail to converge on difficult instances. In this paper, we instead consider computing the partition function via sequential summation over variables. We develop robust approximate algorithms by combining ideas from mini-bucket elimination with tensor network and renormalization group methods from statistical physics. The resulting "convergence-free" methods show good empirical performance on both synthetic and real-world benchmark models, even for difficult instances.

text: Boltzmann exploration is widely used in reinforcement learning to provide a trade-off between exploration and exploitation. Recently, in (Cesa-Bianchi et al., 2017) it has been shown that pure Boltzmann exploration does not perform well from a regret perspective, even in the simplest setting of stochastic multi-armed bandit (MAB) problems. In this paper, we show that a simple modification to Boltzmann exploration, motivated by a variation of the standard doubling trick, achieves O(K\log^ T) regret for a stochastic MAB problem with K arms, where \alpha>0 is a parameter of the algorithm. This improves on the result in (Cesa-Bianchi et al., 2017), where an algorithm inspired by the Gumbel-softmax trick achieves O(K\log^2 T) regret. We also show that our algorithm achieves O(\beta(G) \log^ T) regret in stochastic MAB problems with graph-structured feedback, without knowledge of the graph structure, where \beta(G) is the independence number of the feedback graph. Additionally, we present extensive experimental results on real datasets and applications for multi-armed bandits with both traditional bandit feedback and graph-structured feedback. In all cases, our algorithm performs as well or better than the state-of-the-art.

text: A novel locally statistical active contour model (ACM) is proposed for image segmentation, specifically addressing the significant challenges posed by intensity inhomogeneity. This method models inhomogeneous objects as distinct Gaussian distributions with differing means and variances. A key component involves a moving window technique that maps original image data into a transformed domain where these Gaussian distributions exhibit improved separation. Within this transformed domain, the means of the distributions are adaptively estimated by multiplying an estimated bias field with the original signal localized to the window, effectively compensating for intensity variations. A statistical energy functional is then formulated for each local region, synergistically combining the estimated bias field, the level set function defining the contour, and a constant approximation of the true object signal. Rigorous experimental evaluation on synthetic and real-world images substantiates the proposed algorithm's efficacy, consistently demonstrating its superiority over several state-of-the-art and representative image segmentation techniques, particularly in handling complex intensity variations.

Point-wise analysis is a fundamental task in 3D data processing, with applications ranging from object recognition to scene understanding. Traditional methods, such as Farthest Point Sampling (FPS), have been widely adopted for their simplicity and effectiveness in selecting representative points. However, FPS often struggles with scalability and computational efficiency, particularly for large-scale datasets. This paper introduces a novel sampling framework that extends beyond FPS, addressing its limitations while maintaining high-quality point selection. Our approach leverages a hybrid sampling strategy that combines density-aware clustering with adaptive optimization techniques, enabling efficient and accurate point-wise analysis. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms FPS in terms of both computational speed and sampling quality, achieving up to a 30% reduction in processing time without compromising accuracy. Furthermore, the framework is shown to be robust across diverse applications, including 3D object classification and segmentation. The findings highlight the potential of this approach to enhance point cloud processing pipelines, offering a scalable solution for real-world scenarios. This work contributes to the advancement of 3D data analysis by providing a more efficient and effective alternative to traditional sampling methods.  

**Keywords**: point cloud, sampling methods, 3D data processing, Farthest Point Sampling, density-aware clustering, computational efficiency.

text: TF(t, d) =số lần từ xuất hiện trong văn bản d tổng số từ trong văn bản d – TF(t, d) : Tần số xuất hiện của từ trong văn bản d. Tuy nhiên, để đánh giá chính xác hơn mức độ quan trọng của một từ trong ngữ cảnh toàn bộ tập hợp văn bản (corpus), cần xem xét thêm yếu tố IDF (Inverse Document Frequency). IDF giúp giảm trọng số cho những từ xuất hiện phổ biến trên nhiều văn bản (tức là ít mang tính phân biệt) nhưng lại tăng trọng số cho những từ hiếm, mang ý nghĩa đặc trưng cao. Công thức tính IDF cho một từ t là: IDF(t) = log(N / df(t)), trong đó N là tổng số văn bản trong corpus, và df(t) là số lượng văn bản chứa từ t. Cuối cùng, trọng số TF-IDF được tính bằng cách nhân hai thành phần này lại với nhau: TF-IDF(t, d) = TF(t, d) * IDF(t). Giá trị TF-IDF càng cao thì từ t càng có ý nghĩa quan trọng đối với văn bản d cụ thể trong toàn bộ corpus, giúp cải thiện đáng kể hiệu quả tìm kiếm, phân loại và tóm tắt văn bản trong các hệ thống xử lý ngôn ngữ tự nhiên hiện đại.

text: Instance segmentation seeks to locate and segment each object in an image at the pixel level, representing a critical task in computer vision. Although Mask R-CNN is a classic approach, its predicted masks often lack clarity and accuracy near object contours. To address this, we introduce a novel loss function, contour loss, inspired by contour matching using distance transformation images. Contour loss specifically optimizes the contour regions of predicted masks, enabling more precise instance segmentation. We further design a differentiable k-step distance transformation image module to approximately compute truncated distance transformation images for both predicted and ground-truth masks online, allowing joint training within modern neural network frameworks. The proposed contour loss can be seamlessly integrated into existing instance segmentation methods, such as Mask R-CNN, by combining it with their original loss functions without altering inference network structures, ensuring strong versatility. Experiments on the COCO dataset demonstrate that contour loss effectively improves instance segmentation performance.

Việc tích hợp kiểm thử liên tục và sớm vào mọi giai đoạn của vòng đời phát triển phần mềm, từ lập kế hoạch đến triển khai, giúp nhanh chóng xác định và khắc phục các sai sót, từ đó giảm thiểu đáng kể chi phí sửa lỗi và rủi ro dự án (Smith & Jones, 2018). text: Salmonella enterica là mầm bệnh thực phẩm phổ biến được tìm thấy trong môi trường chế biến, giết mổ gia cầm. Do đó, hiểu biết về khả năng đề kháng chất kháng khuẩn của nhóm vi khuẩn này đóng vai trò thiết yếu để đưa ra phương án kiểm soát mầm bệnh hiệu quả. Tại Việt Nam, nghiên cứu này mở ra một hướng tìm hiểu mới về khả năng đề kháng chất tẩy rửa và sự phân bố của các gen mã hóa cho kiểu hình này trên đối tượng các chủng vi khuẩn Salmonella . 119 chủng vi khuẩn Salmonella được sử dụng cho thử nghiệm nồng độ ức chế tối thiểu (MIC) với 2 hoạt chất BKC (Benzalkonium chloride) và CPC (Cetylpyridinium chloride) theo hướng dẫn của Viện Tiêu chuẩn phòng thí nghiệm và Lâm sàng Hoa Kỳ (CLSI). Đồng thời, nghiên cứu sử dụng chỉ thị sinh học phân tử nhằm phát hiện sự có mặt của 2 gen qacE và qacE∆ trong hệ gen của các chủng vi khuẩn Salmonella . Kết quả cho thấy, MIC của BKC và CPC lần lượt là 12,5-25 và 6,25-12,5 µg/ml. Ngoài ra, sự phân bố rộng rãi của 2 gen qacE và qacE∆ với tỷ lệ lần lượt là 61% (73/119) và 60% (72/119) cho thấy điểm mới lạ về khả năng đề kháng của vi khuẩn này với 2 hoạt chất tẩy rửa.

text: This paper introduces a novel dataset for traffic accident analysis, aiming to resolve the current lack of public data available for research concerning automatic spatio-temporal annotations crucial for road traffic safety. Our analysis of this proposed dataset revealed a significant degradation in pedestrian category object detection accuracy, primarily due to varying object sizes and the inherent complexity of the scenes. To address this, we propose integrating contextual information into the conventional Faster R-CNN using Context Mining (CM) and Augmented Context Mining (ACM) to enhance the accuracy of small pedestrian detection. Our experiments indicate a considerable improvement in object detection accuracy, with increases of +8.51% for CM and +6.20% for ACM. Finally, we demonstrate the performance of accident forecasting within our dataset by employing Faster R-CNN alongside an Accident LSTM architecture, achieving an average Time-To-Accident measure of 1.684 seconds and an Average Precision of 47.25%.
