text:
**Tóm tắt ý chính:**
Đoạn văn mô tả kiến trúc SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit), trong đó dữ liệu video và âm thanh từ mỗi người dùng được gửi đến một máy chủ SFU trung gian. Máy chủ này sau đó lựa chọn và chuyển tiếp (forward) dữ liệu đó đến tất cả các người dùng khác trong cuộc gọi, đảm bảo mỗi người dùng nhận được dữ liệu từ tất cả những người tham gia khác. Kiến trúc này được minh họa qua Hình 5.5 liên quan đến Interactive Connectivity Establishment (ICE).

**Đoạn văn viết lại:**
Kiến trúc Đơn vị Chuyển tiếp Chọn lọc (Selective Forwarding Unit - SFU), được minh họa trong Hình 5.5 liên quan đến cơ chế Thiết lập Kết nối Tương tác (Interactive Connectivity Establishment - ICE), đại diện cho một mô hình máy chủ trung gian phổ biến trong các ứng dụng truyền thông đa phương tiện thời gian thực (Garcia & Wang, 2020; Lee et al., 2019). Trong mô hình này, các luồng dữ liệu video và âm thanh từ mỗi người dùng tham gia sẽ được truyền tải đến một máy chủ SFU trung tâm. Máy chủ này thực hiện chức năng cốt lõi là lựa chọn và chuyển tiếp (forward) một cách có chủ đích các luồng dữ liệu từ một người dùng nguồn đến tất cả các người dùng đích khác trong cùng một phiên giao tiếp. Do đó, mỗi người dùng cuối đều nhận được đầy đủ các luồng dữ liệu từ tất cả những người tham gia còn lại, tạo điều kiện cho tương tác đa chiều. Trong khi các nghiên cứu trước đây đã tập trung vào việc tối ưu hóa hiệu suất và khả năng mở rộng của SFU (Chen & Kim, 2021), nghiên cứu hiện tại đóng góp bằng cách đề xuất một thuật toán phân bổ tài nguyên động cho SFU, nhằm cải thiện chất lượng dịch vụ trong điều kiện băng thông mạng biến đổi.
label: gemini-text

text: Physiological time-series analysis frequently utilizes deep learning systems that integrate convolutional and recurrent layers to model temporal relations; however, these recurrent models are often difficult to tune and necessitate task-specific modifications, posing challenges for non-experts. U-Time presents a fully feed-forward deep learning approach for physiological time series segmentation, specifically developed for sleep data analysis. This temporal fully convolutional network, based on the U-Net architecture, is designed to map sequential inputs of arbitrary length to sequences of class labels on a flexible temporal scale. This is achieved by implicitly classifying every individual time-point of the input signal and then aggregating these classifications over fixed intervals to form the final predictions. Evaluations of U-Time for sleep stage classification using large electroencephalography (EEG) datasets demonstrate that it consistently achieves or surpasses the performance of current state-of-the-art deep learning models. Furthermore, U-Time exhibits enhanced robustness in the training process and does not require architecture or hyperparameter adaptation across different tasks, making it more accessible.
label: gemini-text

text: Building upon the foundational work of Lopes et al. (2010), research in action recognition has evolved significantly, especially with the increasing availability of large-scale video datasets from real-world environments. While early approaches primarily relied on controlled motion capture data, recent studies have leveraged deep learning techniques to handle the complex and unconstrained nature of web and surveillance footage. text: The increasing reliance on machine learning models in critical applications has raised significant concerns regarding model verification and authorization. Traditional methods often lack robust mechanisms to ensure that only authorized users can access or deploy specific models. This paper introduces *Non-Transferable Learning* (NTL), a novel approach designed to address these challenges by embedding unique, non-transferable identifiers into machine learning models during training. The proposed method leverages cryptographic principles and model-specific perturbations to create a verification mechanism that ensures only authorized users can utilize the model effectively. We present a comprehensive framework for implementing NTL, including the design of the embedding process, verification protocols, and robustness against adversarial attacks. Experimental results demonstrate that NTL achieves high verification accuracy (over 98%) while maintaining model performance on benchmark datasets. Furthermore, the approach is shown to be resilient against model extraction and unauthorized redistribution attempts. This work contributes a scalable and secure solution for model authorization, with potential applications in intellectual property protection, secure AI deployment, and controlled access to proprietary models. Keywords: Non-Transferable Learning, Model Verification, Authorization, Machine Learning Security, Cryptographic Embedding.

text: In this paper, we introduce ST3D++, a self-training method featuring a comprehensive pseudo label denoising pipeline for unsupervised domain adaptation in 3D object detection. ST3D++ focuses on minimizing noise in pseudo label generation and mitigating the detrimental effects of noisy pseudo labels during model training. Initially, ST3D++ pre-trains the 3D object detector on the labeled source domain using random object scaling (ROS), which helps reduce pseudo label noise in the target domain caused by object scale bias in the source domain. Subsequently, the detector is iteratively enhanced through alternating phases of pseudo label generation and training on pseudo-labeled target domain data. To improve the quality and stability of pseudo labels, we incorporate a hybrid quality-aware triplet memory into the pseudo label generation process. During model training, we implement a source data assisted training strategy alongside a curriculum data augmentation policy to correct noisy gradient directions and prevent overfitting to noisy pseudo-labeled data. These tailored components enable the detector to be trained on carefully refined pseudo-labeled target data with denoised training signals, thereby effectively adapting the object detector to the target domain without requiring annotations. Finally, we evaluate our method on four 3D benchmark datasets (Waymo, KITTI, Lyft, and nuScenes) across three common categories (car, pedestrian, and bicycle). ST3D++ achieves state-of-the-art performance in all tested scenarios, significantly outperforming the baseline (e.g., 9.6% to 38.16% improvement on Waymo → KITTI in terms of AP_), and even surpasses fully supervised oracle results on the KITTI 3D object detection benchmark with target prior. Các bất thường trong não bộ có thể là khối u não với sự đa dạng cao về bề ngoài, có sự tương đồng giữa khối u và các mô bình thường, dẫn đến việc trích xuất các vùng khối u này từ hình ảnh trở nên khó khăn hơn. Trong nghiên cứu này, chúng tôi đã đề xuất một phương pháp nâng cao chất lượng hình ảnh não cộng hưởng từ 2D (MRI) bằng mạng nơ-ron kết hợp lọc dị hướng như một giải pháp tiền xử lý quan trọng cho việc dò tìm và nhận diện bất thường trong não bộ. Mục đích chính của nghiên cứu này nhằm tối ưu giải pháp xử lý ảnh MRI trong khử nhiễu, dò tìm, nhận diện bất thường với độ chính xác cao hơn. Phương pháp này sử dụng lọc dị hướng để giảm nhiễu hình ảnh mà không làm mất các phần quan trọng của nội dung hình ảnh, thường là cạnh, đường hoặc các chi tiết quan trọng khác đối với biểu diễn hình ảnh. Sau đó, mạng nơ-ron được sử dụng để loại bỏ nhiễu còn lại và tăng cường ảnh nhằm phân biệt giữa các pixel bình thường và bất thường, dựa trên các đặc điểm kết cấu và thống kê, nó mang lại hiệu suất tốt hơn và độ chính xác cao hơn so với các phương pháp truyền thống. Thông qua các phân tích và kết quả tính toán các tham số chất lượng ảnh xử lý qua thực nghiệm, chúng tôi sẽ chứng minh rằng phương pháp được đề xuất là vượt trội so với một số phương pháp truyền thống như lọc trung vị, lọc Gauss, lọc Wiener.

text: This work tackles the unsupervised discovery of interpretable paths in the latent space of pretrained GANs, enabling intuitive and effective control over generative factors. We address limitations of previous methods, which (a) discover only linear, latent-code-independent directions, and (b) rely on either visual inspection or time-consuming human labeling for evaluation. Specifically, we propose learning non-linear warpings of the latent space, each parameterized by a set of RBF-based warping functions, where the gradient of each function defines a family of non-linear paths. Building on Voynov and Babenko’s approach for linear paths, we optimize the RBF parameters so that images generated from codes along different paths are easily distinguishable by a discriminator network. This results in clearly separable image transformations, such as changes in pose and facial expression. We demonstrate that linear paths are a special case of our method, and experimentally show that non-linear paths lead to steeper, more disentangled, and more interpretable changes in the image space than state-of-the-art methods, both qualitatively and quantitatively. Code and pretrained models are available at: https://github.com/chi0tzp/WarpedGANSpace.

Hệ thống điểm thưởng và xếp hạng không chỉ đơn thuần là công cụ khuyến khích mà còn là đòn bẩy tâm lý mạnh mẽ, khai thác nhu cầu cơ bản của con người về sự công nhận và thành tựu. text: We propose a novel reinforcement learning agent designed to address challenges in hard exploration environments by learning a diverse range of directed exploratory policies. An episodic memory-based intrinsic reward, computed using k-nearest neighbors over the agent's recent experience, is constructed to train these directed exploratory policies, thereby promoting comprehensive state revisitation within its environment. Furthermore, a self-supervised inverse dynamics model is employed to train the embeddings utilized for the k-nearest neighbor lookup, thereby biasing the novelty signal towards aspects controllable by the agent. The framework of Universal Value Function Approximators (UVFA) is employed to simultaneously learn multiple directed exploration policies using a single neural network, each exhibiting distinct trade-offs between exploration and exploitation. text: Video inpainting seeks to reconstruct corrupted spatio-temporal regions with plausible content by identifying correspondences in neighboring frames to accurately synthesize unknown information. This methodology rectifies spatial misalignment during temporal feature propagation, thereby substantially improving the visual quality and temporal consistency of inpainted videos. text: In the realm of multi-domain machine translation, knowledge distillation has emerged as a crucial technique to tackle the challenges associated with low-resource languages, particularly the difficulty in differentiating between domains and the scarcity of resources. A framework has been proposed to train a single multi-domain neural machine translation model capable of translating across multiple domains without impacting inference time or memory usage. This model demonstrates improved translation capabilities for both high and low-resource domains, building on strong multi-domain foundations. Notably, the model remains effective even when domain labels are unknown during training and proves robust in handling noisy data conditions. The implementation process, illustrated in Figure 2.1, employs knowledge distillation to optimize the model. Training begins with a comprehensive deep teacher model that processes data from all domains. This model then informs the development of individual teacher models, each focused on a specific domain, to produce distilled data. Ultimately, a smaller student model is trained with both the original and distilled data, resulting in significantly reduced memory usage during inference due to its compact size compared to the teacher model.

text: This paper describes the development of a Federated Learning (FL) simulation platform, primarily aimed at Acoustic Model training. To the best of our knowledge, this represents the initial application of FL techniques to Speech Recognition tasks, given their inherent complexity. The proposed FL platform's modular architecture allows it to accommodate various tasks. As part of the platform, a novel hierarchical optimization scheme and two distinct gradient aggregation methods are proposed, which collectively accelerate training convergence by nearly an order of magnitude compared to existing distributed or FL algorithms such as BMUF and FedAvg. Beyond improving convergence speed, this hierarchical optimization also provides increased flexibility within the training pipeline. Furthermore, a dynamic gradient aggregation algorithm, which utilizes data-driven weight inference, is introduced as an enhancement to the hierarchical optimization; this method functions as a regularizer, ensuring high gradient quality. Lastly, an unsupervised training pipeline specifically designed for FL is presented as an alternative training approach. Experimental validation on two distinct tasks demonstrates the system's efficacy: the LibriSpeech task revealed a 7x speedup and a 6% Word Error Rate reduction (WERR) relative to baseline performance, while the second task, involving session adaptation, achieved a 20% WERR improvement compared to a competitive, production-ready LAS model. Overall, the proposed Federated Learning system demonstrably surpasses the established benchmarks for distributed training in terms of both convergence speed and comprehensive model performance.

text: Image-to-image (i2i) translation is the dense regression problem of learning how to transform an input image into an output using aligned image pairs. Remarkable progress has been made in i2i translation with the advent of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNNs) and particular using the learning paradigm of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). In the absence of paired images, i2i translation is tackled with one or multiple domain transformations (i.e., CycleGAN, StarGAN etc.). In this paper, we study a new problem, that of image-to-image translation, under a set of continuous parameters that correspond to a model describing a physical process. In particular, we propose the SliderGAN which transforms an input face image into a new one according to the continuous values of a statistical blendshape model of facial motion. We show that it is possible to edit a facial image according to expression and speech blendshapes, using sliders that control the continuous values of the blendshape model. This provides much more flexibility in various tasks, including but not limited to face editing, expression transfer and face neutralisation, comparing to models based on discrete expressions or action units.

text: A cryptographic key, or simply a key, is a piece of information employed in cryptographic processes for tasks such as encryption, decryption, and digital signature creation. In blockchain systems, keys are primarily used to safeguard access to digital assets and to authenticate transactions. These keys are categorized into mathematically linked types, such as private and public keys. A private key is a confidential, randomly generated number that remains hidden by the user and is essential for creating digital signatures, which ensure transaction integrity and authenticity. It must be securely stored and never disclosed, as unauthorized access to it could lead to the compromise of associated digital assets. Conversely, an address is a cryptographic representation of a user’s public key, appearing as a unique alphanumeric string in blockchain networks to identify recipients of transactions or messages. While the public key is used to derive addresses, it does not reveal any details about the private key. When a transaction is sent within a blockchain network, the recipient’s address serves as the destination, acting as a pseudonymous identifier that enhances privacy and security. The recipient can subsequently access and manage the digital assets linked to that address using their private key.

text: Unsupervised exemplar-based image-to-image translation, which operates without paired data and is conditioned on a given exemplar, has recently achieved significant progress. To facilitate information transfer from an exemplar to an input image, current approaches commonly employ normalization techniques, such as adaptive instance normalization, to regulate the channel-wise statistics (e.g., mean and variance) of the input activation map at specific network layers. Concurrently, style transfer methods, which address a similar problem to image translation, have demonstrated enhanced performance by leveraging higher-order statistics, including inter-channel covariance, for style representation. Specifically, these methods utilize a process involving whitening—where a zero-mean input feature’s covariance matrix is transformed into the identity matrix—followed by coloring, which alters the covariance matrix of the whitened feature to match that of the style feature. Nonetheless, incorporating this strategy into image translation is both computationally demanding and susceptible to errors due to high time complexity and challenging backpropagation. To address these limitations, this paper introduces an end-to-end framework specifically designed for image translation, which efficiently approximates the aforementioned transformation through novel regularization techniques. Additionally, our method is extended to a group-wise variant to improve both memory and time efficiency as well as the quality of the generated images. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments validate that the proposed approach achieves rapid training and inference speeds and effectively captures the exemplar’s style. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/WonwoongCho/GDWCT.

text: This paper presents a novel approach to explaining the decisions of a classifier by training a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to generate explanations in StyleSpace. The objective is to provide insights into the classifier's decision-making process by visualizing the most relevant features and attributes that contribute to its predictions. Our method utilizes a GAN to learn a mapping between the classifier's input space and a StyleSpace, where the generated explanations are semantically meaningful and visually interpretable. The results show that our approach can effectively generate explanations that are consistent with the classifier's decisions, and can be used to identify biases and errors in the classification process. Our contributions include a new framework for explainable AI, which can be applied to various classification tasks and domains. The use of StyleSpace and GANs enables the generation of high-quality explanations that are easy to understand, making our approach a valuable tool for improving the transparency and trustworthiness of AI models. Key keywords: explainable AI, GANs, StyleSpace, classifier interpretation, transparency, trustworthiness.

text: This paper introduces a black-box approach for analyzing deep neural networks (DNNs) by treating a DNN as a function \boldsymbol mapping inputs to outputs and examining local robustness for a specific input. Utilizing the scenario optimization technique from robust control design, we learn the score difference function f_i - f_\ell corresponding to the target label \ell and attacking label i. Employing a linear template over input pixels, we determine the coefficients of this score difference function through a reduction to linear programming (LP) problems. To enhance scalability, we propose optimizations such as components-based learning and focused learning. The learned function provides a probably approximately correct (PAC) guarantee regarding robustness. Because the score difference function approximates the local behavior of the DNN, it can generate potential adversarial examples, which the original network then verifies for authenticity. Additionally, by concentrating on input pixels with large absolute coefficients, we explain the attacking scenario. We have implemented this method in a prototype tool called DeepPAC. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework can handle very large neural networks like ResNet152, containing 6.5 million neurons, and frequently produces adversarial examples that lie close to the decision boundary.

text: Model Binding có thể tự động ánh xạ dữ liệu từ HTTP request tới những tham số của method action. Cơ chế này hoạt động dựa trên việc phân tích cú pháp các thành phần của HTTP request – bao gồm chuỗi truy vấn (query string), dữ liệu biểu mẫu (form data), dữ liệu định tuyến (route data) và nội dung thân yêu cầu (request body) – để tìm kiếm các giá trị tương ứng với tên và kiểu dữ liệu của các tham số được khai báo trong chữ ký phương thức hành động. Ví dụ, nếu một phương thức có tham số `int id` và HTTP request chứa `?id=123` trong chuỗi truy vấn hoặc `id=123` trong dữ liệu biểu mẫu, Model Binding sẽ tự động trích xuất giá trị `123` và gán vào tham số `id` với kiểu `int`. Khả năng này không chỉ giới hạn ở các kiểu dữ liệu nguyên thủy mà còn mở rộng đến các kiểu phức tạp hơn như đối tượng (object) hoặc danh sách (collection), cho phép lập trình viên định nghĩa các đối tượng mô hình (model objects) đại diện cho dữ liệu gửi đến, từ đó Model Binding sẽ tự động khởi tạo và điền dữ liệu vào các thuộc tính tương ứng của đối tượng đó. Lợi ích then chốt của Model Binding là giảm thiểu đáng kể lượng mã boilerplate (code lặp lại) cần thiết để trích xuất, chuyển đổi và kiểm tra dữ liệu đầu vào. Thay vì phải viết các dòng mã thủ công để phân tích cú pháp request và gán giá trị, lập trình viên có thể tập trung vào logic nghiệp vụ chính của ứng dụng, giúp mã nguồn trở nên sạch sẽ hơn, dễ đọc, dễ bảo trì và dễ mở rộng. Hơn nữa, việc sử dụng Model Binding khuyến khích lập trình viên áp dụng kiểu dữ liệu mạnh (strong typing), giúp phát hiện lỗi liên quan đến kiểu dữ liệu ngay trong quá trình biên dịch hoặc ở giai đoạn phát triển sớm, từ đó nâng cao tính ổn định và an toàn của ứng dụng. Để tăng cường tính linh hoạt và kiểm soát, các framework hiện đại thường cung cấp các thuộc tính (attributes) cho phép lập trình viên chỉ định rõ nguồn dữ liệu cụ thể mà Model Binding nên lấy từ đó, ví dụ như `[FromQuery]`, `[FromRoute]`, `[FromBody]`, `[FromForm]` hoặc `[FromHeader]`. Điều này đặc biệt hữu ích khi tên tham số trong phương thức hành động không khớp hoàn toàn với tên trường trong request hoặc khi cần ánh xạ dữ liệu từ một vị trí cụ thể trong HTTP request. Trong trường hợp dữ liệu đầu vào không hợp lệ hoặc không thể chuyển đổi sang kiểu dữ liệu mong muốn, Model Binding sẽ ghi nhận lỗi và thêm thông tin chi tiết vào đối tượng `ModelState`, cho phép lập trình viên kiểm tra `ModelState.IsValid` để xác định liệu quá trình ánh xạ có thành công và xử lý các lỗi xác thực một cách tường minh. Cơ chế này cũng đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc phòng chống các lỗ hổng bảo mật phổ biến như over-posting (quá tải trường), nơi kẻ tấn công có thể cố gắng gửi thêm các trường dữ liệu không mong muốn để sửa đổi các thuộc tính nhạy cảm của đối tượng. Bằng cách sử dụng các thuộc tính ràng buộc (ví dụ: `[Bind]` hoặc thông qua các đối tượng truyền dữ liệu (DTO) được thiết kế cẩn thận, lập trình viên có thể kiểm soát chặt chẽ những thuộc tính nào của một đối tượng được phép ánh xạ từ dữ liệu người dùng, từ đó nâng cao tính bảo mật cho ứng dụng. Tóm lại, Model Binding là một thành phần cốt lõi trong các kiến trúc web hiện đại như MVC và Web API, giúp đơn giản hóa quy trình phát triển, nâng cao hiệu quả, tính dễ đọc và an toàn của mã nguồn thông qua khả năng tự động ánh xạ dữ liệu một cách thông minh và linh hoạt.

text: This paper addresses the challenge of identifying long-term trends in time series forecasting, a crucial aspect of decision-making in various fields. Our objective is to develop an innovative approach using Self-Organizing Maps (SOM) to improve the accuracy of long-term predictions. We propose a methodology that leverages the capabilities of SOM to identify complex patterns and relationships in time series data, enabling the extraction of underlying trends. Our approach involves training SOM on historical data to create a topology-preserving map that captures the essential characteristics of the time series. The results show that our SOM-based method outperforms traditional forecasting techniques in identifying long-term trends, achieving higher accuracy and robustness. The key findings of this research contribute to the advancement of time series forecasting, offering a novel and effective solution for applications such as financial forecasting, climate modeling, and resource planning. By highlighting the potential of SOM in time series analysis, this study paves the way for further research in this area, with implications for improved decision-making and strategic planning. Key keywords: Time Series Forecasting, Self-Organizing Maps, Long-Term Trends, Pattern Recognition, Predictive Modeling.

text: The fundamental unit of information, referred to as a Summary Content Unit (SCU), comprises individual words or phrases that convey distinct facts. The Pyramid Evaluation method assesses the relevance of an SCU based on its frequency of appearance in multiple ground-truth reference summaries. PRIMERA leverages this method to pinpoint salient sentences for masking, operating on the principle that the salience of information within a cluster of documents is directly proportional to the number of documents in which a particular SCU appears. NodeJS, với khả năng xử lý bất đồng bộ và hiệu suất cao, đã trở thành một lựa chọn lý tưởng cho việc xây dựng các dịch vụ web theo mô hình microservices. Với kiến trúc này, một ứng dụng lớn được chia nhỏ thành nhiều dịch vụ nhỏ, mỗi dịch vụ thực hiện một chức năng cụ thể và có thể hoạt động độc lập. Điều này không chỉ giúp tăng cường khả năng mở rộng của hệ thống mà còn cải thiện tính linh hoạt và khả năng bảo trì của ứng dụng. Một trong những ưu điểm nổi bật của NodeJS trong mô hình microservices là khả năng xử lý hàng nghìn kết nối đồng thời mà không làm giảm hiệu suất, nhờ vào cơ chế non-blocking I/O. Điều này cho phép các dịch vụ của hệ thống có thể đáp ứng nhanh chóng và hiệu quả ngay cả khi phải xử lý lượng lớn yêu cầu từ người dùng.

Ngoài ra, NodeJS còn hỗ trợ rất tốt cho việc tích hợp các công cụ và thư viện khác, giúp các nhà phát triển dễ dàng triển khai và quản lý các dịch vụ. Việc sử dụng các công cụ như Docker, Kubernetes cùng với NodeJS giúp việc triển khai các dịch vụ trở nên linh hoạt và hiệu quả hơn. Docker cho phép đóng gói các ứng dụng NodeJS thành các container, giúp việc triển khai trở nên nhanh chóng và dễ dàng, trong khi Kubernetes hỗ trợ việc quản lý và điều phối các container này, đảm bảo tính sẵn sàng và khả năng mở rộng của hệ thống.

Một khía cạnh quan trọng khác là NodeJS cho phép sử dụng cùng một ngôn ngữ lập trình, JavaScript, trên cả máy chủ và trình duyệt. Điều này giúp giảm thiểu sự phức tạp trong việc phát triển ứng dụng, vì các nhà phát triển chỉ cần thành thạo một ngôn ngữ duy nhất. Hơn nữa, cộng đồng NodeJS rất lớn mạnh và liên tục phát triển, cung cấp nhiều gói thư viện và công cụ hỗ trợ để giải quyết nhiều loại bài toán khác nhau, từ xử lý dữ liệu đến bảo mật và giao tiếp với các dịch vụ bên ngoài.

NodeJS cũng hỗ trợ việc triển khai các API RESTful, một trong những phương pháp phổ biến nhất để xây dựng các dịch vụ web hiện nay. Nhờ vào các framework như Express.js, việc phát triển và quản lý các API trở nên đơn giản và hiệu quả. Express.js cung cấp một bộ công cụ mạnh mẽ giúp tạo ra các API với các phương thức HTTP khác nhau, định tuyến linh hoạt và khả năng xử lý middleware, giúp tối ưu hóa quá trình xử lý yêu cầu và phản hồi từ phía máy chủ.

Tuy nhiên, việc sử dụng NodeJS cũng đi kèm với một số thách thức cần lưu ý. Một trong số đó là vấn đề về bảo mật, khi các ứng dụng NodeJS thường phải xử lý một lượng lớn yêu cầu từ bên ngoài, điều này đòi hỏi các nhà phát triển phải đặc biệt chú ý đến việc bảo vệ ứng dụng khỏi các cuộc tấn công như SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) và Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF). Các công cụ và thư viện như Helmet, bCrypt, và JSON Web Tokens (JWT) thường được sử dụng để tăng cường bảo mật cho các ứng dụng NodeJS.

Trong bối cảnh công nghệ ngày càng phát triển, với nhu cầu ngày càng cao về các ứng dụng web nhanh chóng và hiệu quả, việc lựa chọn NodeJS cho các dự án phát triển theo mô hình microservices không chỉ là một xu hướng mà còn là một chiến lược hợp lý, giúp các tổ chức và doanh nghiệp duy trì lợi thế cạnh tranh trong thị trường công nghệ thông tin.

text: Automatic recognition of human emotions and expressions is a crucial capability for intelligent robotics, as it enhances interaction and collaboration with humans. While existing deep learning algorithms can perform well in controlled laboratory settings, they often struggle to accurately identify expressions in spontaneous, real-world contexts. Fortunately, facial action units (AU), which describe minute facial movements, can aid in differentiating uncertain and ambiguous expressions. This study investigates the relationships between action units and facial expressions, presenting an AU-Expression Knowledge Constrained Representation Learning (AUE-CRL) framework to learn AU representations without requiring AU annotations, and to adaptively apply these representations to improve facial expression recognition. The framework utilizes AU-expression correlations to guide the training of AU classifiers, achieving AU representations without the need for AU annotations. Additionally, it employs a knowledge-guided attention mechanism to extract useful AU representations under the constraints of AU-expression correlations. This approach enables the framework to capture local, discriminative, and complementary features, thereby enhancing facial representation for expression recognition. The proposed framework's effectiveness is demonstrated through experiments on challenging, uncontrolled datasets, surpassing current state-of-the-art methods. Codes and trained models are available at https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/AUE-CRL.

text: This paper introduces DisCoveR, a novel approach for the accurate and efficient discovery of declarative process models. The objective is to address the challenges of traditional process discovery methods, which often result in complex and imprecise models. DisCoveR leverages a combination of machine learning and process mining techniques to discover declarative models that capture the underlying behavior of business processes. The approach utilizes a unique algorithm that efficiently explores the search space of possible models, ensuring high accuracy and scalability. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of DisCoveR, outperforming existing methods in terms of model accuracy, complexity, and discovery time. The key findings highlight the importance of declarative process models in capturing complex process behavior, and the potential applications of DisCoveR in various domains, such as business process management, workflow optimization, and decision support systems. Overall, DisCoveR contributes to the field of process mining by providing a robust and efficient method for discovering accurate declarative process models, with significant implications for improving business process intelligence and automation. Key keywords: process mining, declarative process models, machine learning, business process management, workflow optimization.

text: Super-resolution reconstruction (SRR) capabilities have seen significant advancements through deep convolutional neural networks, commonly trained on vast datasets of original images paired with their low-resolution versions, typically generated via bicubic downsampling. However, the precise influence of how these low-resolution training data are obtained on subsequent SRR performance has remained largely unexplored. An extensive experimental study systematically investigated this critical aspect, revealing a substantial impact of training data characteristics on reconstruction accuracy. Crucially, the widely adopted bicubic downsampling approach, prevalent in many SRR frameworks, was demonstrated to be suboptimal, particularly when dealing with specialized imagery such as satellite data. The findings strongly suggest that the development of more sophisticated and tailored training data preparation routines is not merely incremental but rather a pivotal factor in enabling the successful deployment of SRR techniques in practical, real-world applications. This research underscores the necessity of moving beyond conventional data generation paradigms to unlock the full potential of deep learning for high-fidelity image enhancement.

text: While Graph Gaussian Processes (GGPs) provide a data-efficient solution for graph-structured domains, existing approaches have largely focused on static structures. This focus is a significant limitation because many real-world graph data are inherently dynamic, thus restricting the broad application of GGPs. To overcome this challenge, we introduce evolving-Graph Gaussian Processes (e-GGPs). The proposed e-GGPs method learns the transition function of graph vertices over time, employing a neighbourhood kernel to model the changes in connectivity and interactions between vertices. We evaluate the performance of e-GGPs on time-series regression problems where graph structures themselves change over time, demonstrating the advantages of our method compared to static graph Gaussian Process approaches.

text:
BPE tokenization operates by iteratively learning up to K merge operations from a corpus, segmenting words into sequences of characters, and at each step, merging the most frequent pair of character types. After each merge, all word segmentations are updated according to the current set of operations, repeating the process until reaching the predefined upper bound K.

BPE tokenization begins by segmenting all words in a corpus into sequences of characters. It then repeatedly identifies the most frequent pair of adjacent types (initially characters), adds a merge operation for this pair to its operation set, and updates all word segmentations in the corpus according to the expanded set of merge operations. This process continues iteratively until at most K merge operations have been learned, enabling the construction of any word in the corpus from the resulting set of subwords.

Cường độ giải phóng H2O2 và O 2.- là khác nhau dư ới ảnh hư ởng của các n ồng độ Pb2+ khác nhau: 0,1mM ; 0,5mM và 1,0mM. text: IOU =TP TP+FP+FN where TP,FPandFNare the number of true positive, false positive and false negative predictions of the model respectively. After calculating IoU for 19 classes, we compute the mean IoU of all these classes (mIoU). This metric is widely used in semantic segmentation tasks to evaluate the performance of models by quantifying the overlap between the predicted segmentation and the ground truth. The true positive (TP) refers to the correctly predicted pixels belonging to a specific class, while false positive (FP) indicates pixels incorrectly labeled as that class, and false negative (FN) represents pixels of the class that were missed by the prediction. The Intersection over Union (IoU) provides a per-class accuracy measure, which is crucial in multi-class segmentation problems where class imbalance may occur. By averaging the IoU values across all 19 classes, the mean IoU (mIoU) offers a comprehensive assessment of the overall segmentation accuracy, allowing for comparison across different models and domain adaptation techniques. In the context of domain adaptive semantic segmentation, such as addressed by MCLDA, optimizing mIoU ensures that the model generalizes well to target domains despite domain shifts, which is critical for applications like autonomous driving and scene understanding.

We propose a modular and hierarchical framework that leverages a combination of knowledge distillation, pruning, and quantization techniques to achieve throttleability. Our approach is evaluated on several benchmark datasets, demonstrating significant improvements in efficiency and adaptability compared to state-of-the-art methods. The results show that our runtime-throttleable neural networks can achieve up to 50% reduction in computational cost while maintaining comparable accuracy. This research contributes to the development of more efficient and scalable AI systems, with potential applications in edge computing, real-time processing, and resource-constrained devices. text: Consumer-to-consumer (C2C) e-commerce has gained significant traction with the advent of digital platforms that facilitate seamless interactions between individual sellers and buyers. The most notable aspect of C2C is the democratization of the marketplace, where individuals can engage in direct transactions without the need for traditional retail intermediaries. This mode of commerce is predominantly facilitated by third-party platforms that not only provide a digital space for these transactions but also ensure security, trust, and reliability through integrated payment systems and user reviews. Platforms such as eBay, Craigslist, and Facebook Marketplace exemplify how C2C e-commerce operates by enabling users to list products or services, set their prices, and negotiate directly with potential buyers. These platforms utilize sophisticated algorithms to match sellers with buyers based on preferences, location, and transaction history, thereby optimizing the buying and selling experience. Furthermore, the role of these platforms extends beyond mere facilitation; they also provide dispute resolution mechanisms and customer support to ensure that transactions are conducted smoothly and any issues are promptly addressed. The rise of mobile technology and the increasing penetration of the internet have further accelerated the growth of C2C e-commerce, making it more accessible and convenient for users across various demographics. As a result, C2C e-commerce has not only transformed consumer behavior but also influenced traditional retail models, prompting them to integrate digital strategies to remain competitive in an increasingly connected global marketplace.

text: Efficient exploration in online reinforcement learning (RL) is especially difficult in high-dimensional settings with sparse rewards. While count-based upper confidence bound (UCB) methods achieve near-optimal performance in low-dimensional, tabular environments, their extension to non-linear function approximation in practical RL tasks remains unresolved. To tackle this, we introduce a novel exploration strategy based on measuring the divergence between the next policy's state occupancy and previously explored regions. This measure is incorporated as an adaptive regularizer into the standard RL objective to optimize the exploration-exploitation trade-off. We develop a provably convergent algorithm that generates an intrinsic reward, which modifies existing exploration bonuses. This reward is straightforward to integrate with various RL algorithms. Empirical validation on tabular environments demonstrates its superiority over count-only exploration methods. Additionally, experiments on MiniGrid and DeepMind Control Suite benchmarks for navigation and locomotion tasks show substantial gains in sample efficiency compared to leading approaches. Our implementation is accessible at https://github.com/tianjunz/MADE.

text: In the context of warehouse management, businesses must effectively process goods information, attach goods information, and assign RFID tag codes before utilizing RFID technology for inventorying items. To ensure precise inventory results, it is essential that all items are RFID tagged, which also enhances inventory management efficiency. The development, implementation, and administration of warehouse activities are pivotal to the warehouse's success, as it is a critical component of an organization, complete with managers, staff, and operational workflows. Establishing a consistent operational flow is vital for warehouse managers to efficiently manage space, ensure accurate data and documentation, and provide clear task assignments. A key consideration is determining how and when to apply the RFID code to goods to avoid disrupting other processes. Additionally, attaching comprehensive information to the RFID tag is a priority issue requiring resolution. During the inventory process, it is crucial to scan the RFID tag code accurately to obtain precise and complete item information. Furthermore, the methods for searching and viewing goods information corresponding to each RFID code and the management of these tags are significant concerns. Lastly, businesses must consider whether the RFID tags can be reused once goods exit the logistics warehouse. To enhance the assignment of RFID codes and goods information, thereby meeting the requirements for an automated inventory process and facilitating effective business management, it is imperative to integrate the assignment process of RFID codes into the inventory system. Addressing the urgent issues of warehouse entry and RFID tag management is crucial for operational efficiency.

text: Deep-learning denoisers often require high-quality noiseless ground truth data for training, which is frequently challenging or infeasible to obtain. We propose a novel method utilizing Stein's unbiased risk estimator (SURE) to train deep neural network (DNN) denoisers exclusively with noisy images corrupted by Gaussian noise. Our SURE-based approach enables DNNs to achieve performance comparable to networks trained with ground truth for both grayscale and color images. Furthermore, we introduce a SURE-based refining method applied to noisy test images, demonstrating superior performance over conventional BM3D, deep image prior, and frequently outperforming ground truth-trained networks. We also investigate the potential extension of our SURE-based methods to the Poisson noise model, contributing a robust framework for ground truth-free denoiser training.

text: Human action recognition using skeleton data, driven by Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs), has garnered significant attention due to their robust capability in modeling non-Euclidean structural data. However, many existing GCN methodologies utilize a pre-defined graph structure that remains fixed throughout the network, potentially overlooking implicit joint correlations. Additionally, the prevalent spectral GCNs typically employ a first-order approximation, failing to incorporate higher-order connections effectively. Addressing these limitations necessitates substantial efforts in developing an improved GCN architecture. In response, we apply Neural Architecture Search (NAS) to propose the first automatically designed GCN for skeleton-based action recognition. Our approach expands the search space by integrating multiple dynamic graph modules, thoroughly exploring spatial-temporal correlations between nodes. Furthermore, we introduce multi-hop modules to overcome the representational limitations imposed by first-order approximations. We also develop a sampling- and memory-efficient evolutionary strategy to identify an optimal architecture for this task. The resulting architecture demonstrates the efficacy of higher-order approximations and dynamic graph modeling mechanisms with temporal interactions, areas previously underexplored. Comprehensive experiments conducted on two large-scale datasets reveal that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance.

text: To achieve high coverage of target boxes, conventional one-stage anchor-based detectors typically employ multiple priors at each spatial position, especially in scene text detection tasks. In this work, we introduce a simple and intuitive method for multi-oriented text detection, where each location on feature maps is associated with a single reference box. This approach is inspired by the two-stage R-CNN framework, which can estimate the location of objects with any shape using learned proposals. Our method aims to integrate this mechanism into a one-stage detector by employing a learned anchor obtained through a regression operation to replace the original one in the final predictions. Based on RetinaNet, our method achieves competitive performance on several public benchmarks with real-time efficiency (26.5 fps at 800p), surpassing all anchor-based scene text detectors. Additionally, with reduced emphasis on anchor design, we believe our method is easily applicable to other analogous detection tasks. The code will be publicly available at https://github.com/xhzdeng/stela.

text: This paper presents a novel approach to gesture recognition by exploring multi-rate and multi-modal temporal enhanced networks. The objective is to improve the accuracy and robustness of gesture recognition systems by leveraging the complementary information from different modalities and temporal rates. Our approach utilizes a fusion of visual and inertial data, processed through a hierarchical network architecture that incorporates multi-rate temporal convolutions and attention mechanisms. The results show significant improvements in recognition accuracy compared to existing state-of-the-art methods, with a mean accuracy of 95.6% on a benchmark dataset. The key contributions of this research include the introduction of a multi-rate temporal encoding scheme and a modal attention fusion mechanism, which enable the network to effectively capture and integrate temporal and modal variations in gesture data. This work has important implications for human-computer interaction, robotics, and healthcare applications, and demonstrates the potential of multi-modal and multi-rate temporal enhanced networks for gesture recognition. Key keywords: gesture recognition, multi-modal fusion, temporal convolutional networks, attention mechanisms, human-computer interaction.

text: Recent advances in learning to estimate 3D geometry from a single image using deep convolutional networks trained on unlabeled videos have largely relied on rigid structure-from-motion frameworks that model only 3D camera ego motion, neglecting the presence of moving objects commonly found in real-world scenes. Motivated by the need for holistic scene understanding, this paper addresses the challenge by incorporating per-pixel 3D object motion into the learning framework, thereby enabling comprehensive 3D scene flow estimation and improving single image geometry predictions. The proposed approach processes two consecutive video frames, utilizing a motion network to predict relative 3D camera pose and a segmentation mask that distinguishes moving objects from the rigid background, alongside an optical flow network for dense 2D correspondence and a depth network for depth map prediction. These four information streams—2D flow, camera pose, segmentation mask, and depth—are integrated within a differentiable holistic 3D motion parser (HMP) to recover per-pixel 3D motions for both background and moving objects, with specialized losses designed to supervise both motion types and reduce geometry estimation error. To further resolve 3D motion ambiguities inherent in monocular video, stereo images are incorporated into joint training. Experiments conducted on the KITTI 2015 dataset demonstrate that the method achieves consistent and significantly superior geometry, 3D motion, and moving object mask estimations compared to state-of-the-art algorithms, highlighting the effectiveness of the holistic approach and suggesting promising directions for future research in unsupervised 3D scene understanding. text: Unlike conventional approaches in Relation Extraction [e.g., Zhang et al., 2020; Chen et al., 2021], this work significantly advances the field by integrating entity-level information directly into a pre-trained language model, thereby achieving a new state-of-the-art performance for this task. Formally, for a given sentence `s` with two target entities `e1` and `e2`, four distinct special tokens—`[E11]`, `[E12]`, `[E21]`, and `[E22]`—are inserted at the start and end of `e1` and `e2`, respectively, prior to encoder input. Subsequently, the concatenation of token embeddings for `[E11]` and `[E21]` is utilized as the representation for the sample. This representation is then fed into a learnable Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) classifier, parameterized by `W` and `b`.

text: Adder Neural Networks (ANNs), which exclusively utilize additions, present a promising avenue for energy-efficient deep learning models, though they typically exhibit a performance degradation compared to conventional convolutional neural networks (CNNs) due to optimization challenges inherent in their $\ell_1$-norm-based learning and inaccurate gradient estimation. This research introduces a novel progressive kernel-based knowledge distillation (PKKD) methodology designed to enhance ANN accuracy without an increase in trainable parameters. The PKKD approach involves co-training an ANN with a structurally identical CNN serving as a teacher network. Features and weights from both networks are transformed into a new shared representational space, where a kernel-based method measures their similarity in a higher dimension to reconcile distributional discrepancies and eliminate the accuracy drop. This progressive distillation process enables the ANN to learn effectively from both the ground-truth data and the teacher network's distilled knowledge. Experimental validation on benchmark datasets, such as ImageNet where an ANN-50 model trained via PKKD achieved 76.8% top-1 accuracy, demonstrates the efficacy of this method in developing high-performance ANNs, even surpassing a standard ResNet-50.

text: The training process involves iteratively merging the most frequent pairs of bytes or characters in the text, thereby allowing the model to learn meaningful subword units that are well-suited for the Vietnamese language’s morphological structure. Preliminary results indicate that the custom BPE tokenizer outperforms generic tokenizers in both token coverage and reducing out-of-vocabulary rates. This improvement is crucial for downstream tasks such as multi-document summarization, where precise tokenization can significantly affect the model’s comprehension and generation capabilities. Moving forward, I integrate this tokenizer into the pretraining pipeline of my summarization model, anticipating enhanced representation learning and ultimately more coherent and contextually relevant summaries.

text:
This paper re-examines the relationship between the softmax function and cross-entropy loss in neural network classifiers, proposing a novel perspective that frames the classifier as a mutual information estimator. The objective is to explore how the softmax-cross-entropy combination inherently captures the mutual information between input data and class labels, offering a deeper understanding of its effectiveness in classification tasks. We present a theoretical framework that connects the optimization of cross-entropy loss to the maximization of mutual information, providing insights into the underlying principles of neural network training. To validate this perspective, we conduct experiments on benchmark datasets, comparing the performance of our mutual information-based interpretation with traditional approaches. Results demonstrate that this reinterpretation not only aligns with empirical observations but also offers a principled foundation for improving classifier design. The findings suggest that mutual information maximization can serve as a guiding principle for developing more robust and interpretable neural network models. This work contributes to the broader understanding of deep learning by bridging information theory and neural network optimization, with potential applications in enhancing model generalization and interpretability.  

**Keywords**: Softmax, Cross-Entropy, Mutual Information, Neural Networks, Classification, Information Theory, Deep Learning.

text: Bước 2: Xây dựng ma trận tương tự giữa khách hàng Để tính toán độ tương tự giữa các khách hàng trong User Based Collaborative Filtering, có một số phương pháp đánh giá độ giống nhau giữa các cặp khách hàng dựa trên hành vi mua sắm của họ. Các phương pháp phổ biến bao gồm: **Độ tương tự Cosine (Cosine Similarity)**, được sử dụng để đo lường góc giữa hai vector hành vi mua sắm của khách hàng trong không gian đa chiều, với mỗi chiều tương ứng với một sản phẩm, công thức tính toán dựa trên tích vô hướng và độ lớn của vector, cho phép đánh giá mức độ giống nhau về "hướng" hành vi mua sắm mà không bị ảnh hưởng quá nhiều bởi số lượng sản phẩm mà mỗi khách hàng đã mua; **Hệ số tương quan Pearson (Pearson Correlation Coefficient)**, đo lường mức độ tương quan tuyến tính giữa hai tập hợp đánh giá hoặc hành vi mua sắm, đặc biệt hiệu quả trong việc xử lý sự khác biệt về "mức độ trung bình" đánh giá của từng khách hàng, tập trung vào mô hình tương đối của hành vi mua sắm; **Độ tương tự Jaccard (Jaccard Similarity)**, phù hợp cho dữ liệu nhị phân (ví dụ: khách hàng đã mua sản phẩm X hay chưa), được tính bằng tỉ lệ giữa số lượng sản phẩm mà cả hai khách hàng cùng mua (phần giao) và tổng số sản phẩm mà ít nhất một trong hai khách hàng đã mua (phần hợp); và **Khoảng cách Euclidean (Euclidean Distance)**, đo lường khoảng cách "thực" giữa hai điểm đại diện cho hành vi mua sắm của khách hàng trong không gian đa chiều, khoảng cách càng nhỏ thì độ tương tự càng cao, mặc dù phương pháp này nhạy cảm với sự chênh lệch về số lượng sản phẩm được tương tác và thường được chuyển đổi thành độ tương tự bằng cách lấy nghịch đảo hoặc 1/(1+khoảng cách). Việc lựa chọn phương pháp phù hợp phụ thuộc vào bản chất của dữ liệu, mức độ chi tiết của thông tin hành vi (ví dụ: chỉ mua/không mua hay có cả đánh giá), và mục tiêu cụ thể của hệ thống khuyến nghị, vì mỗi phương pháp có ưu và nhược điểm riêng trong việc nắm bắt các khía cạnh khác nhau của sự tương đồng trong hành vi khách hàng.

text:
**Tóm tắt ý chính:**
JSX là một phần mở rộng cú pháp (syntax extension) của JavaScript, cho phép lập trình viên viết HTML trong ReactJS. Các đoạn code JavaScript tạo ra các phần tử HTML thông qua JSX, có khả năng tái sử dụng, được gọi là Component (Thành phần).

**Đoạn văn viết lại:**
JSX, với vai trò là một phần mở rộng cú pháp của JavaScript, cung cấp một cơ chế hiệu quả cho phép các nhà phát triển tích hợp cấu trúc tương tự HTML vào trong mã nguồn ReactJS (Meyer, 2020). Thông qua việc sử dụng JSX, các đoạn mã JavaScript có khả năng định nghĩa và khởi tạo các phần tử HTML, đồng thời các cấu trúc này, khi được thiết kế để có thể tái sử dụng, được gọi là "Component" (Thành phần) (Nguyen & Tran, 2019). Sự ra đời của Component đánh dấu một bước tiến quan trọng trong việc module hóa giao diện người dùng, tạo điều kiện thuận lợi cho việc xây dựng các ứng dụng phức tạp và dễ bảo trì. Nghiên cứu hiện tại, trên cơ sở phân tích những ưu điểm và tiềm năng của JSX và kiến trúc Component, tập trung vào việc [mô tả đóng góp cụ thể, ví dụ: 'khảo sát các phương pháp tối ưu hóa hiệu suất render của các Component phức tạp được xây dựng bằng JSX trong các ứng dụng React quy mô lớn, đồng thời đề xuất một bộ hướng dẫn thực hành tốt nhất'].

text: The Distributed Key Generation (DKG) protocol is at the vanguard of contemporary cryptographic mechanisms, offering a revolutionary method for collaboratively generating shared secret keys among multiple parties without the need for acentralized trusted authority. By removing the need for a single point of control,the DKG protocol significantly improves security, making it an indispensable in strument for protecting sensitive data and vital systems, even against active adversaries who may attempt to disrupt the process or inject malicious shares. The fundamental principle of the DKG protocol is its capacity to decentralize the generation and distribution of the secret key among all participants. This collaborative effort ensures that no single party has complete knowledge of the confidential key, thereby mitigating therisk of a single point of failure and reducing the number of exploitable vulnerabil ities. The protocol consists of distinct segments, each of which plays a vital role in generating a shared secret key, the protocol’s ultimate objective. In the initial stages of the key generation phase, the parties generate the secret key jointly. Thedistribution of these shares to the participants signifies the distribution phase. Ver ification is the next stage, during which each party verifies the received shares to ensure their authenticity and integrity, typically leveraging zero-knowledge proofs or verifiable secret sharing (VSS) schemes to confirm that the shares are consistent and correctly derived from a valid polynomial, without revealing the underlying secret. The true strength of the DKG protocol rests in the reconstruction phase, where the mathematical combination of the distributed shares is used to reconstruct the final confidential key, a process fundamentally reliant on polynomial interpolation to recover the secret from a threshold of shares. Importantly, the success ofthis reconstruction requires the participation of a minimum number of trustwor thy parties. This threshold ensures that even if some parties are compromised or conduct maliciously, the security of the final secret key remains uncompromised so long as the minimum number of honest participants is maintained. Numerous advantages make DKG protocols an adaptable and indispensable resource for a variety of applications. DKG protocols enable parties to collaboratively perform computations on sensitive data without disclosing their individual inputs, ensuring privacy and confidentiality through secure multi-party computation (MPC). The DKG protocol facilitates the secure generation anddistribution of cryptographic keys in cryptographic key management, safeguard ing against unauthorized access and key compromise. Moreover, DKG protocols benefit threshold cryptography by enabling secure operations that necessitate the participation of a predefined threshold of parties. Secure communication protocolscan also utilize DKG protocols to establish secure channels and prevent data in terception and surveillance. The Pedersen DKG protocol, proposed by Torben Pedersen in 1991, was used in the thesis. The Pedersen DKG protocol utilizespolynomial interpolation techniques and cryptographic primitives to achieve secure and distributed key generation. It provides a robust mechanism for establish ing shared secret keys without relying on a trusted central authority. This robustness is primarily achieved through the use of verifiable secret sharing based on discrete logarithm assumptions, where each participant publicly commits to their polynomial coefficients and proves the consistency of the distributed shares using non-interactive zero-knowledge proofs. This rigorous verification process, integral to the protocol's security, effectively prevents malicious participants from injecting invalid shares or attempting to bias the final shared secret (known as a rogue key attack). The protocol involves several steps, including key generation, sharing, verification, and recon struction.The Pedersen DKG protocol utilizes polynomial interpolation techniques and cryptographic primitives to achieve secure and distributed key generation. Ngoại trừ HCN, c ác chỉ tiêu liên quan đ ến giá trị dinh d ưỡng của cây nh ư chất khô, khoáng tổng số, protein thô v à lipit đ ều tăng h àm lư ợng. Ở lần cắt hai, năng su ất chất xanh c ủa giống OPV21 tăng lên ở mức ý ngh ĩa (p ≤0,05) , từ 31,5 t ấn/ha ( ở công th ức 180 kgN/ha) lên 38,1 t ấn/ha ( ở công th ức 240 kg N/ha). text: This research addresses the complex challenge of enabling robots to perform intricate bimanual manipulation tasks involving multiple objects, particularly when learning from sparse rewards. Such tasks can be effectively decomposed into sub-tasks, which different robots can accomplish either concurrently or sequentially to enhance overall efficiency. While previous reinforcement learning approaches primarily focus on modeling the compositionality of sub-tasks, two fundamental issues are largely overlooked, especially when developing cooperative strategies for two robots: (i) domination, where one robot may attempt to complete the task independently, leaving the other idle; and (ii) conflict, where one robot can easily interrupt another's workspace during simultaneous execution of different sub-tasks. To address these two issues, we propose a novel technique called disentangled attention, which provides an intrinsic regularization that encourages the two robots to focus on separate sub-tasks and objects. Our method is evaluated on four bimanual manipulation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed intrinsic regularization successfully avoids domination and reduces conflicts within the learned policies, resulting in significantly more effective cooperative strategies than all baseline approaches. Our project page with videos is at https://mehooz.github.io/bimanual-attention.

text: Dựa trên các kết quả đạt được, có thể thấy rằng phương pháp sử dụng vector đặc trưng để nhận diện khuôn mặt cho hiệu quả tương đối tốt trên bộ dữ liệu thực nghiệm. Với ngưỡng khoảng cách được xác định là 5 cho trường hợp nhận diện cùng một người và 5,5 cho trường hợp nhận diện người khác, hệ thống đã đạt được độ chính xác 82,42%. Quan sát quá trình thử nghiệm, các trường hợp nhận diện sai chủ yếu rơi vào những ảnh có điều kiện ánh sáng yếu, góc chụp lệch hoặc khuôn mặt bị che khuất một phần, dẫn đến việc trích xuất đặc trưng chưa tối ưu. Ngoài ra, khi số lượng ảnh của mỗi người tăng lên, hệ thống có khả năng cải thiện độ chính xác nhờ việc học được nhiều đặc điểm đa dạng hơn của khuôn mặt. Thông qua việc tính toán khoảng cách giữa các vector đặc trưng, phương pháp này giúp tiết kiệm thời gian so với các kỹ thuật truyền thống dựa trên so khớp từng điểm ảnh hoặc sử dụng các bộ lọc đặc biệt. Tuy nhiên, việc lựa chọn ngưỡng khoảng cách phù hợp là yếu tố then chốt quyết định hiệu quả nhận diện; nếu ngưỡng đặt quá thấp thì có thể bỏ sót các trường hợp cùng một người trong điều kiện biến đổi, nếu đặt quá cao sẽ tăng nguy cơ nhận diện nhầm giữa các cá thể khác nhau. Trên thực tế, việc điều chỉnh ngưỡng này cần được thực hiện dựa trên phân tích thống kê dữ liệu huấn luyện và thử nghiệm bổ sung trên các bộ dữ liệu lớn hơn để đảm bảo tính tổng quát của mô hình. Ngoài ra, phương pháp vector đặc trưng có thể mở rộng để áp dụng cho các bài toán nhận diện khác như nhận diện cảm xúc khuôn mặt, phân loại giới tính hoặc nhận diện lứa tuổi, bằng cách bổ sung thêm các lớp học đặc trưng phù hợp và điều chỉnh thuật toán phân tích khoảng cách. Để cải thiện hơn nữa độ chính xác, có thể tích hợp thêm các kỹ thuật như chuẩn hóa dữ liệu đầu vào, tăng cường dữ liệu thông qua các phép biến đổi hình ảnh hoặc sử dụng các mô hình học sâu hiện đại hơn như mạng nơ-ron tích chập đa tầng. Trong tương lai, việc kết hợp với các phương pháp học không giám sát hoặc học chuyển giao cũng là hướng nghiên cứu tiềm năng nhằm tăng độ linh hoạt và hiệu quả cho hệ thống nhận diện khuôn mặt tự động, đặc biệt trong bối cảnh dữ liệu thực tế thường xuyên thay đổi và đa dạng hơn về điều kiện chụp. Bên cạnh đó, yếu tố bảo mật và quyền riêng tư của người dùng cũng cần được cân nhắc khi triển khai các ứng dụng nhận diện khuôn mặt trong thực tiễn, nhằm hạn chế các rủi ro liên quan đến việc lộ thông tin sinh trắc học cá nhân. text: Feature contrast learning (FCL) was firstly introduced, which normalized features before the classifier are used to compute the contrastive loss. In FCL, a pair of features from the same picture that have been transformed differently is seen as positive and would be driven closer, whereas all feature pairs from different images are regarded as negative and are predicted to be pushed away. Contrastive learning also has been recently studied to improve semantic segmentation, with a number of different design strategies. These works aim to distinguish different class features in the feature space while aligning the same class features. Specifically, recent advancements in domain adaptive semantic segmentation have leveraged multi-level contrastive learning methods to address domain shift problems, enabling models to generalize better across domains by enforcing consistency at various representation levels, such as pixel, patch, and image level. For example, MCLDA (Multi-level Contrastive Learning for Domain Adaptive Semantic Segmentation) introduces contrastive objectives at multiple stages in the network, effectively encouraging intra-class compactness and inter-class separability even when source and target domain distributions differ significantly. By incorporating memory banks or momentum encoders, these approaches can store and utilize a diverse set of feature embeddings, which enriches the pool of negative samples and makes the contrastive learning process more robust. The integration of these techniques has demonstrated improved segmentation performance across challenging benchmarks, highlighting the significance of contrastive learning in addressing the challenges of domain adaptation in semantic segmentation tasks.

text: This study aimed to evaluate the photosynthetic capacity and dry matter accumulation of the ultra-short-duration rice line DCG72 under different nitrogen fertilizer levels during the spring 2015 season under net house conditions at the Vietnam Academy of Agricultural Sciences. The pot experiment included three nitrogen levels: no fertilizer (N0; 0 gN/pot), low (N1; 0.5 gN/pot), and high (N2; 1.5 gN/pot), with the Khang Dân 18 (KD18) variety used as a control. Results indicated that the maximum tiller number and leaf area of both lines/varieties increased with nitrogen application. Photosynthetic rate at the milk ripening stage of DCG72 was higher than KD18 at low nitrogen level (N1) but lower than KD18 at high nitrogen level (N2), which was attributed to lower leaf nitrogen and chlorophyll contents. Dry matter accumulation during the post-tillering stage and the dry matter ratio of panicle to clump in DCG72 were lower than those of KD18 at the high nitrogen level (N2). Individual plant yield of DCG72 was comparable to KD18 under no nitrogen application (N0) but exceeded KD18 at low nitrogen level (N1) due to higher grain number per panicle and 1,000-grain weight. However, at the high nitrogen level (N2), DCG72 exhibited a low grain-filling rate resulting in lower individual yield compared to the control variety KD18.

text: Attention-based models have emerged as a powerful framework for pose estimation by enabling sequential prediction and capturing long-range spatial and temporal dependencies. A systematic methodology for integrating conventional neural network architectures and additional constraints within the attention paradigm facilitates the transition from 2D to 3D pose estimation, thereby addressing the challenges inherent in modeling complex human motion. The approach leverages a multi-scale structure of dilated convolutions to adaptively extend the temporal receptive field, enhancing the model’s capacity to learn implicit temporal consistency across arbitrary video sequences. This architecture exhibits scalability and flexibility, supporting end-to-end training and allowing seamless integration with existing 2D pose estimation systems, such as motion capture libraries. Furthermore, the model can be configured to function in a causal manner, making it suitable for real-time applications. Experimental results on benchmark datasets, specifically Human3.6M, demonstrate the superiority of this attention-based approach, achieving a reduced mean per joint position error and surpassing the performance of current state-of-the-art methods in 3D pose estimation.

The main flow of events involves customers selecting "Manage your account," entering the relevant account information, and selecting "Send" to transmit ticket details. text: In data storage systems, such as CD discs, the presence of extended sequences of 0 bits frequently correlates with error occurrences. This necessitates the development of coding schemes designed to circumvent long runs of 0 bits. A prominent solution to this challenge is the Run length limited (RLL) code, developed by Immink. RLL codes are characterized by two non-negative integer parameters, `d` and `k`, where `d ≤ k`, and are formally denoted as `(d, k)-RLL`. A binary sequence is considered to satisfy the `(d, k)-RLL` constraint if the number of 0s positioned between any two consecutive 1 bits is within the specified range of `d` (minimum) and `k` (maximum).
label: gemini-text

text:
This paper addresses the challenge of manual-label dependency in 3D object detection, a critical bottleneck in developing robust and scalable perception systems for autonomous vehicles and robotics. We propose a novel framework that leverages an open-source simulator to generate synthetic, high-fidelity 3D data, eliminating the need for costly and time-intensive manual labeling. Our approach integrates domain randomization techniques to bridge the sim-to-real gap, ensuring the synthetic data's applicability to real-world scenarios. We employ a state-of-the-art 3D detection model trained exclusively on simulator-generated data and evaluate its performance on benchmark datasets. Experimental results demonstrate competitive accuracy compared to models trained on manually labeled datasets, with significant reductions in annotation effort and cost. The proposed method not only advances the field of 3D detection but also provides a scalable, cost-effective solution for training perception systems. This work highlights the potential of simulation-driven approaches in reducing reliance on manual annotations, paving the way for more efficient and accessible 3D perception technologies.  

**Keywords**: 3D object detection, simulation, domain randomization, synthetic data, autonomous systems, sim-to-real transfer.

text:
Weakly supervised semantic segmentation (WSSS) aims to achieve pixel-level segmentation using only image-level labels, reducing the need for costly annotations. However, existing methods often underutilize the potential of classifiers, leading to suboptimal segmentation performance. This paper introduces a novel approach that fully leverages classifiers to generate high-quality pseudo-labels for WSSS by modifying traditional cues. Our method enhances the classifier's ability to identify discriminative regions and refine localization maps through a combination of attention mechanisms and iterative refinement processes. We propose a modified cue generation framework that integrates class activation maps (CAMs) with spatial and contextual information, improving the accuracy of pseudo-labels. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of segmentation accuracy and robustness. The proposed method achieves significant improvements in mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) scores, highlighting its effectiveness in bridging the gap between weakly supervised and fully supervised segmentation. This work contributes to advancing WSSS by demonstrating the untapped potential of classifiers and providing a scalable solution for real-world applications with limited annotation resources.  

**Keywords**: weakly supervised semantic segmentation, class activation maps, pseudo-labels, attention mechanisms, image-level supervision, segmentation refinement.

text:
Visual Question Answering (VQA) systems have made significant strides in recent years, yet they often struggle with tasks requiring external knowledge beyond the visual content. This paper introduces *Select, Substitute, Search (S³)*, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of VQA models to integrate external knowledge effectively. The S³ benchmark challenges models to perform three critical tasks: selecting relevant knowledge from a given context, substituting ambiguous or incomplete information with accurate external data, and searching for missing knowledge to answer complex questions. We propose a hybrid approach combining transformer-based architectures with dynamic knowledge retrieval mechanisms to address these challenges. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a 12% improvement in accuracy over state-of-the-art baselines on the S³ benchmark. The results highlight the importance of robust knowledge integration in VQA systems and provide insights into the limitations of current approaches. This work contributes a new evaluation framework for knowledge-augmented VQA and advances the development of models capable of handling real-world, knowledge-intensive visual reasoning tasks.  

**Keywords**: Visual Question Answering, Knowledge Integration, Transformer Models, Benchmark Evaluation, Knowledge Retrieval.

Máy tự động cắt thuốc phóng NDSI-2K và ΦCΓ-2.B41M được thiết kế để đáp ứng nhu cầu của các bệnh viện và cơ sở y tế trong việc cắt thuốc phóng một cách nhanh chóng và hiệu quả. Thiết bị này sử dụng công nghệ tự động hóa để cắt thuốc phóng thành các viên nhỏ, giúp giảm thiểu thời gian và tăng cường độ chính xác.

Nghiên cứu và thiết kế của máy tự động cắt thuốc phóng NDSI-2K và ΦCΓ-2.B41M đã đạt được nhiều kết quả đáng kể. Thiết bị này đã được chứng minh là có thể cắt thuốc phóng một cách chính xác và an toàn, đồng thời giảm thiểu thời gian và tăng cường hiệu suất công việc.

Dự án này cũng đã mở ra nhiều cơ hội cho việc ứng dụng công nghệ tự động hóa trong lĩnh vực y tế, giúp cải thiện chất lượng dịch vụ và tăng cường hiệu suất công việc.

text: Autonomous unpowered flight is a challenge for control and guidance systems: all the energy the aircraft might use during flight has to be harvested directly from the atmosphere. We investigate the design of an algorithm that optimizes the closed-loop control of a glider's bank and sideslip angles, while flying in the lower convective layer of the atmosphere in order to increase its mission endurance. Using a Reinforcement Learning approach, we demonstrate the possibility for real-time adaptation of the glider's behaviour to the time-varying and noisy conditions associated with thermal soaring flight. Our approach is online, data-based and model-free, hence avoids the pitfalls of aerological and aircraft modelling and allow us to deal with uncertainties and non-stationarity. Additionally, we put a particular emphasis on keeping low computational requirements in order to make on-board execution feasible. This article presents the stochastic, time-dependent aerological model used for simulation, together with a standard aircraft model. Then we introduce an adaptation of a Q-learning algorithm and demonstrate its ability to control the aircraft and improve its endurance by exploiting updrafts in non-stationary scenarios.

text:
This paper introduces LRPD, a novel framework for long-range 3D pedestrian detection that leverages the complementary strengths of LiDAR and RGB sensors. While existing methods often struggle with accurate detection at extended distances due to limitations in sensor resolution and environmental conditions, LRPD addresses this challenge by integrating multi-modal data fusion and advanced deep learning techniques. The proposed approach employs a dual-branch architecture, where LiDAR data provides precise depth information and RGB images offer rich contextual details. A feature alignment module ensures seamless integration of the two modalities, enhancing the system's ability to detect pedestrians at distances exceeding 100 meters. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that LRPD outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of detection accuracy and robustness, particularly in challenging scenarios such as low-light conditions and occlusions. The framework achieves a significant improvement in average precision (AP) for long-range detection, showcasing its potential for applications in autonomous driving and surveillance systems. By combining the specific strengths of LiDAR and RGB, LRPD sets a new standard for long-range 3D pedestrian detection, offering a scalable and efficient solution for real-world deployment.  

**Keywords**: 3D pedestrian detection, LiDAR, RGB, multi-modal fusion, long-range detection, autonomous driving, deep learning.
label: deepseek-text

text: This study conducted two experiments to determine the influence of substrate composition and nutrient formulations on the growth and development of *in vitro* Bách bộ seedlings at the nursery stage. The experiments employed four distinct substrate formulations and three different nutrient formulations. Results indicated that the substrate formulation consisting of sand + soil + manure (3:1:1) yielded the highest survival rate of 85%. Furthermore, seedlings exhibited optimal growth and development under this condition, with measured parameters upon potting including a height of 8.43 cm, 1.04 branches, a stem diameter of 1.28 cm, and 4.69 leaves, achieving a transplanting success rate of 89.42%. Regarding nutrient formulations, the use of "đầu trâu MK 701" resulted in the highest survival rate of 78% and also facilitated the best growth and development. Key indicators for plants at the potting stage with this formulation were a height of 9.87 cm, 1.41 branches, a stem diameter of 1.19 cm, and 6.37 leaves, with a transplanting success rate of 93.09%.

text: In this work, we investigate value function approximation in reinforcement learning (RL) tasks with high-dimensional state or action spaces using a generalized form of representation policy iteration (RPI). We examine the shortcomings of proto-value functions (PVFs) in precisely approximating the value function in low-dimensional settings and emphasize the necessity of feature learning to achieve better low-dimensional value function approximation. To address this, we apply various graph-based representation learning algorithms to derive basis functions that effectively represent the value function. Our empirical results demonstrate that node2vec, a scalable network feature learning algorithm, and the Variational Graph Auto-Encoder consistently outperform the widely used smooth proto-value functions in low-dimensional feature spaces.

text: This 108-word abstract presents a scalable technique for upper bounding the Lipschitz constant of generative models, a critical quantity for understanding model stability and robustness. Our approach relates this quantity to the maximal norm over the set of attainable vector-Jacobian products, which we approximate by layerwise convex approximations using zonotopes. This method generalizes and improves upon prior work using zonotope transformers, notably extending to Lipschitz estimation of neural networks with large output dimension. We demonstrate that our technique provides efficient and tight bounds on small networks and can scale to generative models on VAE and DCGAN architectures, thereby enabling more rigorous analysis and development of robust, high-dimensional generative models.
