text: Humans robustly recognize and localize objects by integrating visual and auditory cues. While machine perception has advanced significantly in visual object recognition and localization, analogous capabilities using auditory information remain less explored. This paper introduces an approach for dense semantic labelling of sound-emitting objects, relying exclusively on binaural audio. A novel sensor configuration is introduced alongside a new audio-visual dataset of street scenes, recorded with eight professional binaural microphones and a 360-degree camera. The co-occurrence of visual and audio cues is leveraged for supervision transfer. Specifically, a cross-modal distillation framework is employed, wherein an auditory 'student' model is trained to replicate the outputs of a visual 'teacher' model. This approach facilitates training the auditory system without requiring manual human annotations. Additionally, two auxiliary tasks are proposed: a) Spatial Sound Super-resolution, a novel task for enhancing audio spatial resolution, and b) dense scene depth prediction. These three tasks are integrated into an end-to-end trainable multi-task network designed to leverage their interdependencies for improved overall performance. Experimental results on this dataset demonstrate that: 1) the proposed method yields promising performance for semantic prediction and both auxiliary tasks; 2) the three tasks are mutually beneficial, as joint training achieves superior performance; and 3) both the quantity and orientation of microphones significantly influence outcomes. The dataset and corresponding code will be publicly released to foster further research in this domain.

text:
**Tóm tắt ý chính:**
Sự phổ biến của Firebase không phải ngẫu nhiên mà là do nền tảng này sở hữu nhiều ưu điểm vượt trội. Các nghiên cứu trước đây (ví dụ: Lee & Kim, 2021; Chen et al., 2022) đã làm nổi bật các tính năng như cơ sở dữ liệu thời gian thực (real-time database), xác thực (authentication) và khả năng mở rộng (scalability). Nghiên cứu hiện tại tận dụng những ưu thế này, đặc biệt là [nêu cụ thể một hoặc hai ưu điểm liên quan trực tiếp đến nghiên cứu], để [nêu mục tiêu/đóng góp của nghiên cứu hiện tại khi sử dụng Firebase].

**Đoạn văn viết lại:**
Sự phổ biến rộng rãi của Firebase trong cộng đồng phát triển ứng dụng không phải là một hiện tượng ngẫu nhiên, mà là kết quả trực tiếp của hàng loạt ưu điểm kỹ thuật và lợi ích thực tiễn mà nền tảng này cung cấp. Nhiều công trình nghiên cứu trước đây đã phân tích và khẳng định giá trị của Firebase; chẳng hạn, Lee & Kim (2021) nhấn mạnh vào hiệu quả của cơ sở dữ liệu thời gian thực (real-time database) và dịch vụ xác thực (authentication) mạnh mẽ, trong khi Chen et al. (2022) tập trung vào khả năng mở rộng (scalability) linh hoạt và sự tích hợp liền mạch với các dịch vụ đám mây khác. Những đặc tính này không chỉ giúp rút ngắn đáng kể chu kỳ phát triển sản phẩm mà còn tối ưu hóa chi phí vận hành cho các dự án ở nhiều quy mô khác nhau. Kế thừa và phát huy những lợi thế đã được ghi nhận, nghiên cứu hiện tại lựa chọn Firebase làm nền tảng backend chủ chốt, đặc biệt tập trung khai thác [ví dụ: khả năng đồng bộ hóa dữ liệu tức thời và hệ thống quản lý người dùng toàn diện của nó], nhằm [ví dụ: xây dựng một nguyên mẫu ứng dụng [tên ứng dụng/lĩnh vực] có khả năng tương tác cao và đảm bảo an toàn dữ liệu người dùng một cách hiệu quả].

text:
Weld quality inspection is a critical process in manufacturing industries, ensuring the structural integrity and safety of welded components. Traditional inspection methods, such as visual checks and manual testing, are often time-consuming, subjective, and prone to human error. With the rapid advancement of image processing and deep learning technologies, there is a growing opportunity to automate and enhance weld quality assessment. This research focuses on developing a software system that leverages image processing and segmentation-based deep learning to accurately and efficiently evaluate weld quality.  

The primary objective of this thesis is to design and implement a robust system capable of detecting weld defects, such as cracks, porosity, and incomplete fusion, using high-resolution images of weld seams. By automating the inspection process, the system aims to reduce reliance on manual labor, improve accuracy, and provide real-time feedback for quality control. The research addresses the challenges of handling diverse weld types, varying lighting conditions, and complex defect patterns.  

The proposed methodology integrates advanced image preprocessing techniques with a deep learning-based segmentation model, such as U-Net, to identify and classify weld defects. The system architecture includes modules for image acquisition, preprocessing, defect detection, and result visualization. A dataset of weld images is curated and annotated to train and validate the model, ensuring its generalizability across different welding scenarios.  

Preliminary results demonstrate the system's ability to achieve high accuracy in defect detection and segmentation, outperforming traditional methods in terms of speed and precision. The expected contributions of this research include a scalable and cost-effective solution for weld quality inspection, which can be integrated into industrial production lines. Additionally, the study provides insights into the application of deep learning for segmentation tasks in manufacturing.  

In conclusion, this thesis highlights the potential of combining image processing and deep learning to revolutionize weld quality inspection. Future work may explore the integration of real-time monitoring systems, enhanced model architectures, and broader applications in other industrial inspection domains.

text: A typical approach in data exploration involves first learning a low-dimensional representation of the data, then grouping points within this space, and finally analyzing the distinctions between these groups to understand their significance. We frame this process as an interpretable machine learning task by utilizing the same model that produces the low-dimensional representation to uncover the main differences between the groups. To address this, we propose a novel explanation method called Global Counterfactual Explanation (GCE), along with our algorithm, Transitive Global Translations (TGT), for generating GCEs. TGT detects differences between each group pair using compressed sensing, while ensuring that these pairwise differences remain consistent across all groups. Our empirical results show that TGT produces explanations that faithfully represent the model, are relatively sparse, and correspond to meaningful patterns in the data.

V ề khả năng ch ống hóa lỏ ng, m ẫu đất cát s ạch (FC = 0%) th ể hiện khả năng kháng hóa l ỏng cao nh ất, yêu c ầu nhiề u chu k ỳ tải nhất để đạt trạng thái hóa l ỏng. text: Content-based video retrieval seeks to identify videos within extensive databases that closely resemble or are near-duplicates of a query video. The effectiveness of such systems heavily depends on video representation and similarity search techniques. However, most existing retrieval methods rely on large-scale, manually annotated datasets for training, resulting in high costs and inefficiency. Additionally, these systems often utilize frame-level features for similarity assessment, which is resource-intensive in terms of both storage and computation. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a new video retrieval framework called SVRTN. This system leverages self-supervised learning to extract video representations directly from unlabeled data, eliminating the need for costly manual annotations. Furthermore, SVRTN incorporates a transformer architecture to consolidate frame-level features into clip-level representations, thereby reducing storage requirements and search complexity. This approach enables the model to capture complementary and distinctive information through frame interactions, and to handle frame permutations and missing frames, facilitating more adaptable retrieval strategies. Extensive evaluations on the FIVR-200K and SVD datasets demonstrate that SVRTN achieves superior results in both accuracy and efficiency for video retrieval tasks.

Các dạng nhược cơ bẩm sinh hay gặp: ● Thiếu thụ thể acetylcholine (AChR) nguyên phát: thường gặp nhất, gây ra bởi đột biến di truyền lặn ở bất kỳ gen mã hoá tiểu đơn vị AChR (CHRNA, CHRNB, CHRND hoặc CHRNE); hầu hết xảy ra trong tiểu đơn vị epsilon (CHRNE) ● Các đột biến gen RAPSN, gây suy giảm khả năng phân cụm AChR ● Các đột biến gen COLQ, dẫn đến thiếu acetylcholinesterase ở màng tận cùng ● Các đột biến gen DOK7, làm bất thường sự trưởng thành và duy trì tại synap ● Các đột biến gen CHAT, gây khiếm khuyết acetyltransferase tiền synap ● Hội chứng kênh nhanh với việc mở nhanh kênh AChR, gây ra do đột biến trong các gen mã hóa tiểu đơn vị AChR (CHRNA, CHRNB, CHRND hoặc CHRNE) ● Hội chứng kênh chậm với thời gian mở kênh AChR kéo dài, cũng do đột biến trong các gen mã hoá tiểu đơn vị AChR (CHRNA, CHRNB, CHRND hoặc CHRNE). Chúng tôi báo cáo trường hợp bệnh nhân nam 11 tuổi, lé mắt lúc nhỏ, khoảng 1 năm mỏi tay tăng lên sau khi viết, yếu 2 chân, té sau khi đi bộ 150m, nuốt khó, khó thở trong đợt bệnh sốt, test kích thích thần kinh lặp lại tần số 2Hz dương tính ở cơ gốc chi và ngọn chi; kháng thể kháng thụ thể acetylcholine và kháng thể kháng MusK âm tính, xét nghiệm gen ghi nhận đột biến gen COLQ. Bệnh nhân uống Salbutamol 3 tuần đáp ứng rõ rệt, viết bài 10 phút không mỏi tay, đi lại trên 150m không mỏi và không yếu. Nhược cơ bẩm sinh là bệnh lý hiếm gặp gây ảnh hưởng nhiều đến chức năng vận động và hô hấp, điều trị dựa trên kết quả xét nghiệm gen giúp cải thiện rõ rệt triệu chứng. Đặc biệt, đối với các đột biến gen COLQ như trường hợp đã báo cáo, sự thiếu hụt acetylcholinesterase tại màng tận cùng dẫn đến tích tụ acetylcholine (ACh) kéo dài tại khe synap, gây khử cực kéo dài và mất nhạy cảm của thụ thể ACh sau synap. Salbutamol, một chất chủ vận beta2-adrenergic, đã chứng minh hiệu quả trong những trường hợp này; cơ chế tác động có thể bao gồm việc tăng cường giải phóng lượng tử ACh từ đầu tận cùng tiền synap, cải thiện sự hình thành và ổn định của cụm AChR, hoặc tăng cường tính dễ kích thích của sợi cơ. Đáp ứng tích cực với Salbutamol, trong khi các thuốc ức chế cholinesterase thường chống chỉ định hoặc làm nặng thêm triệu chứng ở bệnh nhân đột biến COLQ, càng nhấn mạnh vai trò không thể thiếu của xét nghiệm di truyền trong việc cá thể hóa điều trị, đảm bảo lựa chọn can thiệp phù hợp và mang lại lợi ích tối đa cho người bệnh.

text: We introduce a reinforcement learning agent designed to tackle challenging exploration games by learning a variety of directed exploratory policies. To train these policies, we use an episodic memory-based intrinsic reward, calculated through k-nearest neighbors applied to the agent’s recent experiences, which incentivizes the agent to revisit all states within its environment. The embeddings for the nearest neighbor search are trained with a self-supervised inverse dynamics model, directing the novelty signal toward aspects the agent can influence. Utilizing the Universal Value Function Approximators (UVFA) framework, we enable the simultaneous learning of multiple directed exploration policies on a single neural network, each representing different balances between exploration and exploitation. This shared network architecture allows knowledge transfer from highly exploratory policies to those focused on exploitation, resulting in effective exploitative behaviors. Our approach is compatible with modern distributed RL agents, enabling the collection of extensive experience from multiple actors operating in parallel across separate environment instances. The method achieves double the performance of the base agent on all hard exploration tasks in the Atari-57 suite, while also maintaining superior scores on the other games, reaching a median human normalized score of 1344.0%. Remarkably, our approach is the first to obtain non-zero rewards (with a mean score of 8,400) in the game Pitfall! without relying on demonstrations or hand-crafted features.

text: This paper introduces Query Twice, a novel meta-learning approach for video summarization, which leverages dual mixture attention to improve the accuracy and efficiency of summarization models. The objective is to develop a method that can effectively capture the most informative and representative frames from a video, given the complexity and variability of video content. Our approach employs a meta-learning framework that combines two attention mechanisms, allowing the model to query the video data twice and refine its understanding of the key frames. The results show that Query Twice outperforms state-of-the-art video summarization methods, achieving significant improvements in terms of summary quality and computational efficiency. The proposed method has important implications for applications such as video analysis, surveillance, and content creation, where efficient and accurate video summarization is crucial. Key contributions of this research include the introduction of dual mixture attention and a meta-learning framework for video summarization, which enables the model to adapt to new, unseen videos and improve its performance over time. Relevant keywords: video summarization, meta-learning, attention mechanisms, deep learning, computer vision.

text:
Generalized Zero-shot Learning (GZSL) aims to recognize objects from both seen and unseen classes by leveraging semantic representations, such as attributes or textual descriptions. However, existing methods often struggle with the domain shift problem, where the model biases toward seen classes during inference. To address this challenge, we propose a novel Two-Level Adversarial Visual-Semantic Coupling (TAVSC) framework. At the first level, a visual-semantic alignment module ensures that visual features are tightly coupled with their corresponding semantic embeddings. At the second level, an adversarial learning mechanism is introduced to minimize the distribution gap between seen and unseen classes, enabling better generalization. Our approach employs a generative adversarial network (GAN) to synthesize realistic visual features for unseen classes, enhancing the model's ability to handle unseen data. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets, including CUB, SUN, and AWA2, demonstrate that TAVSC achieves state-of-the-art performance in GZSL settings. The results show significant improvements in harmonic mean accuracy, highlighting the effectiveness of the proposed two-level coupling strategy. This work contributes to advancing zero-shot learning by addressing the domain shift problem and providing a robust framework for real-world applications where unseen classes are prevalent.  

**Keywords**: Generalized Zero-shot Learning, Adversarial Learning, Visual-Semantic Coupling, Domain Shift, GAN, Feature Synthesis.

text: Crowdsourcing is extensively employed in supervised settings where acquiring training sets is challenging and limited. Existing crowdsourcing models typically presume that labelers can respond to entire questions. In classification tasks, this necessitates a labeler to distinguish among all potential classes. However, in real-world scenarios, this discernment is often difficult. Labelers may lack expertise in differentiating all classes. In this study, we introduce a comprehensive probabilistic model tailored for a different type of query that requires only "yes" or "no" answers. Our model calculates a joint posterior distribution of matrices associated with labelers' confusions and the posterior probability for the class of each object. We devised an approximate inference method employing Monte Carlo Sampling and Black Box Variational Inference, which facilitates the derivation of essential gradients. We constructed two realistic crowdsourcing scenarios to evaluate our model. The first scenario involves queries related to irregular astronomical time-series, while the second deals with animal image classification. Our results are on par with those obtained from full query crowdsourcing. Additionally, we demonstrate that accounting for labelers' errors is crucial in accurately estimating true classes. Lastly, we provide the community with two real datasets from our crowdsourcing experiments, and all our code is publicly accessible.

text: Container Management: Docker provides a set of commands and APIs to man age containers efficiently. Developers can start, stop, restart, pause, and re- move containers using these commands. Specifically, commands like `docker start <container_id/name>` activate a stopped container, while `docker stop <container_id/name>` gracefully shuts down a running one, allowing for controlled termination by sending a SIGTERM signal before eventually forcing a SIGKILL after a timeout. For situations requiring a quick reinitialization, `docker restart <container_id/name>` combines both stop and start operations, ensuring the application reloads to its initial state without manual intervention. The `docker pause <container_id/name>` command can temporarily suspend all processes within a container, effectively freezing its execution and conserving system resources without stopping the container entirely, which can then be resumed with `docker unpause <container_id/name>`. Finally, `docker rm <container_id/name>` permanently removes a stopped container and its associated file system, ensuring a clean environment by disposing of no longer needed instances, which is crucial for managing disk space and preventing clutter in development and production environments. These precise commands, alongside other utilities like `docker ps` to list active containers and `docker inspect` to view detailed configuration, provide developers with robust, scriptable control over the lifecycle and state of their containerized applications, significantly streamlining deployment, testing, and operational workflows within an OdooErp context by enabling rapid provisioning and de-provisioning of services.

text: We develop a novel approach to conformal prediction when the target task has limited data available for training. Conformal prediction identifies a small set of promising output candidates in place of a single prediction, with guarantees that the set contains the correct answer with high probability. When training data is limited, however, the predicted set can easily become unusably large. In this work, we obtain substantially tighter prediction sets while maintaining desirable marginal guarantees by casting conformal prediction as a meta-learning paradigm over exchangeable collections of auxiliary tasks. Our conformalization algorithm is simple, fast, and agnostic to the choice of underlying model, learning algorithm, or dataset. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach across a number of few-shot classification and regression tasks in natural language processing, computer vision, and computational chemistry for drug discovery.

text:
Reinforcement Learning (RL) has shown remarkable success in solving complex decision-making tasks, yet its ability to generalize across diverse environments remains a significant challenge. This paper addresses the problem of instance-based generalization in RL, where an agent must adapt to unseen environments or tasks that share similarities with its training instances. We propose a novel framework that leverages instance-based learning techniques to enhance the generalization capabilities of RL agents. Our approach integrates memory-augmented neural networks with a dynamic instance retrieval mechanism, enabling the agent to efficiently recall and apply knowledge from past experiences to new scenarios. Through extensive experiments on benchmark environments, we demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms traditional RL algorithms in terms of generalization performance, achieving higher success rates and faster adaptation to novel tasks. The results highlight the importance of instance-based reasoning in RL and provide insights into designing more robust and adaptable learning systems. This work contributes to advancing the field of RL by offering a scalable solution for improving generalization, with potential applications in robotics, autonomous systems, and adaptive AI.  

**Keywords**: Reinforcement Learning, Generalization, Instance-Based Learning, Memory-Augmented Networks, Adaptive Systems.

text: Time series classification models have been garnering significant importance in the research community. However, not much research has been done on generating adversarial samples for these models. These adversarial samples can become a security concern. In this paper, we propose utilizing an adversarial transformation network (ATN) on a distilled model to attack various time series classification models. The proposed attack on the classification model utilizes a distilled model as a surrogate that mimics the behavior of the attacked classical time series classification models. Our proposed methodology is applied onto 1-Nearest Neighbor Dynamic Time Warping (1-NN ) DTW, a Fully Connected Network and a Fully Convolutional Network (FCN), all of which are trained on 42 University of California Riverside (UCR) datasets. In this paper, we show both models were susceptible to attacks on all 42 datasets. To the best of our knowledge, such an attack on time series classification models has never been done before. Finally, we recommend future researchers that develop time series classification models to incorporating adversarial data samples into their training data sets to improve resilience on adversarial samples and to consider model robustness as an evaluative metric.

text:
Salient object detection (SOD) plays a critical role in computer vision applications, enabling systems to identify and prioritize the most visually distinctive regions in an image. Despite significant advancements, existing methods often struggle with complex scenes, varying object scales, and overlapping objects. This paper introduces *DeepSaliency*, a novel multi-task deep neural network model designed to address these challenges. The proposed model integrates a unified architecture that simultaneously learns global context, local details, and boundary information through parallel task-specific branches. By leveraging a combination of attention mechanisms and feature fusion techniques, *DeepSaliency* enhances the model's ability to capture salient objects with high precision. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets, including DUTS, ECSSD, and HKU-IS, demonstrate that *DeepSaliency* outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of accuracy, robustness, and computational efficiency. The model achieves an average F-measure improvement of 3.2% compared to existing approaches. Furthermore, ablation studies validate the effectiveness of the multi-task learning framework and the proposed attention modules. The results highlight the potential of *DeepSaliency* for real-world applications such as image segmentation, video surveillance, and autonomous navigation. This research contributes a scalable and efficient solution to salient object detection, paving the way for future advancements in visual perception systems.  

**Keywords**: Salient object detection, deep learning, multi-task learning, attention mechanisms, feature fusion, computer vision.

Chỉ số MAPE có vai trò phản ánh sai số tương đối trung bình giữa giá trị dự báo và giá trị thực tế, được biểu diễn dưới dạng phần trăm, qua đó cho thấy mức độ chênh lệch của dự báo. Trong khi đó, R² Score, hay còn gọi là hệ số xác định, đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc đánh giá mức độ phù hợp của mô hình, thể hiện tỷ lệ phần trăm biến thiên của biến phụ thuộc được giải thích bởi các biến độc lập trong mô hình (Draper & Smith, 1998). Việc lựa chọn và phân tích các chỉ số này, vốn đã được khẳng định giá trị trong nhiều công trình trước đây (ví dụ, Armstrong & Collopy, 1992; Hyndman & Koehler, 2006), cho phép nghiên cứu hiện tại không chỉ xác thực độ tin cậy của mô hình đã xây dựng mà còn cung cấp một cơ sở định lượng để so sánh hiệu suất với các phương pháp tiếp cận khác, từ đó làm nổi bật những cải tiến và đóng góp của nghiên cứu.

text:
This paper investigates the consistency of semi-supervised learning (SSL) algorithms on graphs, focusing on two prominent methods: the probit and one-hot approaches. The objective is to evaluate the theoretical and practical performance of these methods in achieving consistent predictions across graph-structured data, particularly in scenarios with limited labeled data. We propose a unified framework to analyze the convergence properties of both methods under varying graph topologies and label distributions. Through extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets, we demonstrate that the probit method exhibits superior consistency in low-label regimes, while the one-hot method performs better in scenarios with moderate label availability. Our findings reveal that the choice of SSL algorithm significantly impacts prediction stability and accuracy, with the probit method showing robustness to graph sparsity and noise. The results provide valuable insights for practitioners in selecting appropriate SSL techniques for graph-based applications, such as social network analysis, recommendation systems, and bioinformatics. This study contributes to the growing body of research on SSL by offering a comparative analysis of two widely used methods and highlighting their strengths and limitations in different contexts.  

**Keywords**: semi-supervised learning, graph-based learning, probit method, one-hot method, consistency, graph topology, label distribution.

text: One of the fundamental challenges to scale self-driving is being able to create accurate high definition maps (HD maps) with low cost. Current attempts to automate this process typically focus on simple scenarios, estimate independent maps per frame or do not have the level of precision required by modern self driving vehicles. In contrast, in this paper we focus on drawing the lane boundaries of complex highways with many lanes that contain topology changes due to forks and merges. Towards this goal, we formulate the problem as inference in a directed acyclic graphical model (DAG), where the nodes of the graph encode geometric and topological properties of the local regions of the lane boundaries. Since we do not know a priori the topology of the lanes, we also infer the DAG topology (i.e., nodes and edges) for each region. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on two major North American Highways in two different states and show high precision and recall as well as 89% correct topology. (178 words)

text: The state-of-the-art in semantic segmentation is currently represented by fully convolutional networks (FCNs). However, FCNs use large receptive fields and many pooling layers, both of which cause blurring and low spatial resolution in the deep layers. As a result FCNs tend to produce segmentations that are poorly localized around object boundaries. Prior work has attempted to address this issue in post-processing steps, for example using a color-based CRF on top of the FCN predictions. However, these approaches require additional parameters and low-level features that are difficult to tune and integrate into the original network architecture. Additionally, most CRFs use color-based pixel affinities, which are not well suited for semantic segmentation and lead to spatially disjoint predictions.   To overcome these problems, we introduce a Boundary Neural Field (BNF), which is a global energy model integrating FCN predictions with boundary cues. The boundary information is used to enhance semantic segment coherence and to improve object localization. Specifically, we first show that the convolutional filters of semantic FCNs provide good features for boundary detection. We then employ the predicted boundaries to define pairwise potentials in our energy. Finally, we show that our energy decomposes semantic segmentation into multiple binary problems, which can be relaxed for efficient global optimization. We report extensive experiments demonstrating that minimization of our global boundary-based energy yields results superior to prior globalization methods, both quantitatively as well as qualitatively.

text: Sentiment analysis frequently encounters data scarcity, particularly when datasets rely on manual annotation. Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), a prominent class of generative models, have demonstrated state-of-the-art performance in various domains, such as image and text generation. This study investigates the training of GAN models on low-resource datasets and their subsequent application for data augmentation to enhance sentiment classifier generalization. Addressing limited data constraints, various techniques for GAN model training are explored. Furthermore, an analysis evaluates the quality of GAN-generated data as a function of the increasing training data available to the GANs. This quality assessment involves evaluating the generated data's utility both as a test set, benchmarked against models trained on authentic data, and as a training set for novel classification models. Finally, a visual analysis is conducted by projecting both generated and authentic data into a two-dimensional space using the t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE) method.

text: The experiments observed that HSV color model based approach to Indian sub-continental skin detection is more suitable with considerable success rate of 91.1% true positives and 88.1% true negatives. This superior performance, compared to the less successful RGB and YCbCr color model approaches explored in the study, can be attributed to HSV's intrinsic separation of chrominance (Hue and Saturation) from luminance (Value), making it less susceptible to variations in lighting conditions and shadow effects inherent in real-world images. The findings suggest that a finely tuned HSV model provides a robust and reliable foundation for developing more accurate skin detection algorithms specifically for populations of Indian sub-continental origin, thereby addressing a critical gap in existing research and enabling more equitable performance in downstream applications such as facial recognition and gesture analysis that previously exhibited biases due to inadequate representation.

text: This paper presents an overview of the experimental setup for investigating the structure of unstable nuclear isotopes in the region from 47Cl to 63V within the SEASTAR 3 project, along with the evolution of nuclear shells in neutron-rich isotopes at N=32 and N=34. The first excitation energies of Cl, Ar, and K isotopes around N=32 and N=34, obtained from the SEASTAR 3 project, have been determined. The evolution of nuclear shells in neutron-rich isotopes at N=32 and N=34 is explained by the contribution of the tensor force, in addition to the radial and spin-orbit forces. The emergence of a new neutron magic number N=34 in 54Ca is attributed to the influence of the proton-neutron tensor force, which pulls the 0f5/2 neutron level below the 1p1/2 level, leading not only to an inversion of the 1p1/2 and 0f5/2 neutron levels but also to an increase in the energy gap between these two levels. text:
This paper introduces a novel approach to modeling Bahdanau Attention by leveraging election methods enhanced with Q-Learning. The primary objective is to improve the interpretability and efficiency of attention mechanisms in sequence-to-sequence tasks, such as machine translation and text summarization. Traditional attention mechanisms often face challenges in dynamically allocating focus across input sequences, leading to suboptimal performance in complex tasks. To address this, we propose a hybrid framework that integrates election-based voting systems with Q-Learning, enabling the model to learn optimal attention distributions through reinforcement learning. The election methods provide a structured mechanism for aggregating contextual information, while Q-Learning ensures adaptability and fine-tuning of attention weights. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms conventional Bahdanau Attention in terms of both accuracy and computational efficiency. The proposed model achieves a 12% improvement in BLEU scores for machine translation tasks and reduces training time by 18% compared to baseline methods. This research contributes to the advancement of attention mechanisms by introducing a scalable and interpretable framework, with potential applications in natural language processing, recommendation systems, and other domains requiring dynamic sequence modeling.  

**Keywords**: Bahdanau Attention, Election Methods, Q-Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Sequence-to-Sequence Models, Natural Language Processing.

Nevertheless, the vast amount of fashion-related content and user-generated photos on social media platforms poses a significant challenge for fashion designers seeking to identify and compile current fashion trends, underscoring the need for in-depth analysis of social media photos to detect and categorize multiple fashion items. Although object detection competitions like MSCOCO boast extensive sample collections for various object categories, compiling large labeled datasets for fast fashion items is notoriously difficult. Furthermore, existing state-of-the-art object detectors are unable to leverage the vast amounts of unlabeled social media data to refine their performance using labeled datasets. This study demonstrates the application of a generic object detector that can be pre-trained in an unsupervised manner, utilizing 24 categories from the recently released Open Images V4 dataset. By initially training the detector's base architecture using unsupervised learning on 60K unlabeled social media photos from 24 categories, and subsequently fine-tuning it on 8.2K labeled photos from Open Images V4, we achieve a 72.7% mAP on a test dataset of 2.4K photos with 300 X 300 image inputs, outperforming state-of-the-art object detectors by 11% to 17%. This improvement is attributed to the chosen architecture, which enables unsupervised learning and excels at identifying small objects, as shown in Figure A, B, C (References: [citation]).

text: This paper addresses egocentric action anticipation, predicting future actions and object interactions performed by the camera wearer. We propose Rolling-Unrolling LSTM, a novel architecture for egocentric video action anticipation. This method comprises three key components: an architecture with two LSTMs for past summarization and future inference, a Sequence Completion Pre-Training technique for task focus, and a Modality ATTention (MATT) mechanism for efficient multi-modal fusion of RGB, optical flow, and object-based features. Validated on EPIC-Kitchens, EGTEA Gaze+, and ActivityNet, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance in egocentric videos, including top results in the 2019 EPIC-Kitchens egocentric action anticipation challenge. It also shows competitive performance on ActivityNet with respect to methods not based on unsupervised pre-training and generalizes to early action recognition and action recognition. To foster further research, our code, trained models, and pre-extracted features are publicly available at http://iplab.dmi.unict.it/rulstm.

text: In the contemporary context, addressing and adapting to phenomena such as floods and sea-level rise, stemming from climate change impacts, necessitates the construction of additional hydraulic structures broadly, and pumping stations specifically, to secure water supply and drainage for domestic and production activities; this is particularly evident in the critical requirement for ultra-large capacity pumping stations to serve flood mitigation objectives in major urban centers and coastal regions. The majority of these large-scale pumping stations are equipped with sizeable axial flow pumps that demand an extensive operational range. Two primary methodologies are employed to broaden the operational envelope of axial flow pumps: adjustment of rotational speed and modification of the blade pitch angle. For high-capacity axial flow pumps, alteration of the blade pitch angle (blade rotation) is the prevalent approach, as varying the rotational speed encounters considerable technical impediments and is constrained by power limitations. To effectively expand the operational range through blade rotation, it is imperative to investigate the influence of the blade rotation angle on the pump's working characteristics and cavitation phenomena, thereby facilitating the development of essential recommendations to assist operational management in selecting an appropriate blade rotation angle that ensures optimal pump efficiency.

text: In this work, we study 3D object detection from RGB-D data in both indoor and outdoor scenes. While previous methods focus on images or 3D voxels, often obscuring natural 3D patterns and invariances of 3D data, we directly operate on raw point clouds by popping up RGB-D scans. However, a key challenge of this approach is how to efficiently localize objects in point clouds of large-scale scenes (region proposal). Instead of solely relying on 3D proposals, our method leverages both mature 2D object detectors and advanced 3D deep learning for object localization, achieving efficiency as well as high recall for even small objects. Benefited from learning directly in raw point clouds, our method is also able to precisely estimate 3D bounding boxes even under strong occlusion or with very sparse points. Evaluated on KITTI and SUN RGB-D 3D detection benchmarks, our method outperforms the state of the art by remarkable margins while having real-time capability.

text: Existing object detection methods typically depend on the availability of abundant labeled training data per class and necessitate offline model training in a batch mode. These prerequisites significantly restrict their scalability for open-ended accommodation of novel classes, especially when only limited labeled examples are available. This study aims to overcome these limitations by introducing the Incremental Few-Shot Detection (iFSD) problem, where new classes must be registered incrementally using minimal examples and without revisiting base categories. To address this, we propose OpeN-ended Centre nEt (ONCE), a detector engineered for incrementally learning to identify novel class objects with few examples. This is achieved through a sophisticated adaptation of the CentreNet detector for the few-shot learning scenario, alongside meta-learning a class-specific code generator model to register these new classes. ONCE strictly adheres to the incremental learning paradigm; novel class registration requires only a single forward pass of few-shot training samples and no access to base classes, making it suitable for deployment on embedded devices. Extensive experiments conducted on both standard object detection and fashion landmark detection tasks demonstrate the unprecedented feasibility of iFSD, thereby establishing a promising and highly important new direction for research.

text: Graph-based methodologies have demonstrated considerable success across a range of machine learning and pattern classification applications. These methodologies model semi-structured data as graphs, wherein nodes represent elementary primitives (e.g., parts, interest points, segments) and edges delineate the relationships between them. Nonetheless, such non-vectorial graph representations are not directly amenable to standard machine learning algorithms, necessitating a preliminary graph vectorization and embedding phase, which can be either explicit or implicit. An effective embedding process must exhibit robustness to intra-class graph variations while preserving high discriminative capability. This paper introduces a novel high-order stochastic graphlet embedding (SGE) method designed to map graphs into vector spaces. The primary contribution is a novel stochastic search procedure that efficiently parses a graph to extract and sample graphlets of arbitrarily high order. These graphlets, of progressively increasing order, are employed to model local primitives and their correspondingly complex interactions. To construct the graph representation, the distribution of these graphlets within a given graph is quantified using specialized hash functions that efficiently map sampled graphlets to isomorphic sets with a minimal probability of collision. When integrated with maximum margin classifiers, these SGE-derived representations significantly enhance pattern comparison and recognition performance, a claim substantiated by extensive experimentation on standard benchmark databases.

This paper addresses the challenge of multi-modal affect analysis in real-world scenarios, focusing on the integration of standardized data within subjects to improve emotion recognition accuracy. The objective is to develop a robust framework that leverages diverse data modalities, such as facial expressions, voice, and physiological signals, to analyze human emotions in naturalistic settings. Our methodology involves preprocessing and aligning multi-modal data streams, followed by feature extraction and fusion using advanced neural network architectures. Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in emotion classification accuracy compared to existing methods, with a particular emphasis on cross-subject generalization. The findings highlight the effectiveness of standardized data integration and the potential of our approach for applications in human-computer interaction, mental health monitoring, and personalized user experiences. This research contributes to the field by providing a scalable and adaptable framework for multi-modal affect analysis, paving the way for more accurate and context-aware emotion recognition systems.  

**Keywords**: multi-modal affect analysis, emotion recognition, deep learning, domain adaptation, in-the-wild data, human-computer interaction.

text: This paper addresses the problem of recognizing informative and concise subgraphs within a given input graph, a challenge central to tasks such as interpretable subgraph discovery, graph denoising, and graph compression, by introducing a Graph Information Bottleneck (GIB) framework inspired by the information bottleneck (IB) principle, which has been underexplored for irregular graph data and graph neural networks (GNNs). The proposed GIB framework enables the identification of maximally informative yet compressed subgraphs (IB-subgraphs), but optimizing the GIB objective is difficult due to the intractability of mutual information computation on irregular graphs and unstable optimization. To overcome these issues, the paper presents (i) a GIB objective grounded in a mutual information estimator for irregular graph data, (ii) a bi-level optimization scheme to maximize the GIB objective, and (iii) a connectivity loss to stabilize optimization. Experimental evaluation in three application scenarios—graph classification improvement, graph interpretation, and graph denoising—demonstrates that IB-subgraphs derived from the proposed method possess superior information-theoretic properties. text: This paper addresses the challenge of unsupervised domain adaptation for stereo matching, a crucial task in computer vision. The objective is to develop a geometry-aware approach that enables accurate depth estimation across different domains without requiring labeled target domain data. Our method leverages a novel combination of geometric constraints and adversarial training to align the source and target domains. The approach utilizes a transformer-based architecture to model the spatial relationships between pixels and incorporates a geometry-aware loss function to preserve the structural information. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on benchmark datasets. The key findings show improved depth estimation accuracy and robustness to domain shifts. This research contributes to the field of computer vision by introducing a innovative unsupervised domain adaptation technique, with potential applications in autonomous driving, robotics, and 3D reconstruction. The growing demand for interpretability in machine learning models has led to the development of empirical explainers, which provide insights into model behavior. This paper addresses the challenge of generating efficient and scalable explanations without compromising accuracy. We propose a novel framework that leverages lightweight, model-agnostic techniques to extract meaningful explanations from complex models. Our approach combines feature importance analysis with dynamic sampling strategies to reduce computational overhead while maintaining high fidelity in explanations. Experiments conducted on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method achieves a 30% reduction in explanation generation time compared to state-of-the-art techniques, with minimal loss in explanation quality. Furthermore, the framework is evaluated across diverse domains, including healthcare and finance, showcasing its adaptability and robustness. The results highlight the potential of our approach to enable real-time explainability in resource-constrained environments. This work contributes to the field by offering a scalable solution for deploying explainable AI systems, paving the way for broader adoption in practical applications.  

**Keywords**: Explainable AI, model interpretability, empirical explainers, feature importance, scalable explanations.

text: Semantic Segmentation, a fundamental computer vision task, involves classifying each pixel in an image into a specific class or object. The Intersection over Union (IoU), which serves as the most widely used metric for assessing a model’s performance in such tasks, facilitates rigorous evaluation. Significant advancements in semantic segmentation have been achieved with the advent of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The seminal work of FCN notably spurred interest in applying deep learning to this task, leading to numerous subsequent methodologies aimed at expanding receptive fields to incorporate broader contextual information. Among these, the Deeplab , family of models has garnered substantial attention and widespread adoption, largely owing to its demonstrated utility and architectural simplicity. It is important to note that these techniques typically necessitate extensive datasets of pixel-wise annotations, exemplified by resources such as Cityscapes and PASCAL VOC.

text: Trong bối cảnh phát triển ứng dụng web hiện đại sử dụng Node.js, việc triển khai kiến trúc Model-View-Controller (MVC) đóng vai trò then chốt, đây là một phương pháp luận thiết kế phần mềm đã được công nhận rộng rãi nhằm cấu trúc hóa ứng dụng thành các thành phần riêng biệt với trách nhiệm rõ ràng (Krasner & Pope, 1988; Buschmann et al., 1996). Theo đó, quá trình phát triển ứng dụng sẽ tuân thủ nguyên tắc phân tách các mối quan tâm (separation of concerns), cụ thể là: thành phần Model chịu trách nhiệm quản lý dữ liệu và logic nghiệp vụ; thành phần View đảm nhận việc trình bày dữ liệu và giao diện người dùng; và thành phần Controller đóng vai trò trung gian, tiếp nhận yêu cầu từ người dùng, điều phối tương tác giữa Model và View để xử lý yêu cầu và cập nhật giao diện (Reenskaug, 1979). Việc áp dụng triệt để kiến trúc này trong môi trường Node.js giúp đảm bảo rằng các tác vụ như xử lý yêu cầu (request handling), hiển thị dữ liệu (data presentation), và xử lý logic nghiệp vụ (business logic processing) được phân chia một cách rành mạch, từ đó nâng cao tính module hóa, khả năng bảo trì và mở rộng của hệ thống. text: Lỗ hổng SQL Time Based Injection thường được khai thác thông qua câu lệnh `sleep()` trong SQL, có chức năng gây trễ thời gian thực thi của câu truy vấn SQL. Để kiểm thử sự tồn tại của lỗ hổng này, một thông số thời gian cụ thể cần được thiết lập cho hàm `sleep()`. Nếu thời gian phản hồi của hệ thống bằng hoặc vượt quá thời gian đã định trong câu lệnh `sleep()`, điều này xác nhận sự hiện diện của lỗ hổng SQL Injection. Các câu lệnh `sleep` tương ứng cho một số hệ quản trị cơ sở dữ liệu phổ biến được minh họa chi tiết trong `bảng 6.1`, bao gồm `SLEEP()` cho MySQL, MongoDB, MariaDB và Cassandra; `pg_sleep()` cho PostgreSQL; `WAITFOR DELAY ’00:00:00’` cho Microsoft SQL Server; `dbms_lock.sleep()` hoặc `dbms_pipe.receive_message(('a'),10)` cho Oracle; và `redis.call("TIME")[]` cho Redis. Đối với quá trình kiểm thử, dữ liệu kiểm thử được xây dựng dựa trên biểu thức chính quy (`Regex`) nhằm phân tích các mẫu dữ liệu đầu vào, từ đó xác định khả năng khai thác lỗ hổng.

Vì vậy, phủ lên vải cotton chất chống thấm polysiloxane là một yêu cầu đặc biệt cần thiết trong các ứng dụng cho những sản phẩm quần áo ngoài trời và quần áo bảo vệ. Hình thái của vải cotton đã phủ nhựa được xác định bởi SEM (Scanning electron microscope) và EDX (Energy dispersive X-ray) dùng để xác định sự hiện diện của lớp phủ polysiloxane trên bề mặt vải. So với vải cotton thô, độ bền kéo đứt của vải cotton tẩm dung dịch 20% polysiloxane tăng, tuy nhiên độ giãn dài khi đứt giảm. text: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have been successfully applied in many structured data domains, with applications ranging from molecular property prediction to the analysis of social networks. Motivated by the broad applicability of GNNs, we propose the family of so-called RankGNNs, a combination of neural Learning to Rank (LtR) methods and GNNs. RankGNNs are trained with a set of pair-wise preferences between graphs, suggesting that one of them is preferred over the other. One practical application of this problem is drug screening, where an expert wants to find the most promising molecules in a large collection of drug candidates. We empirically demonstrate that our proposed pair-wise RankGNN approach either significantly outperforms or at least matches the ranking performance of the naive point-wise baseline approach, in which the LtR problem is solved via GNN-based graph regression.

Đánh giá chuyển vị mục tiêu nhà cao tầng chịu động đất là một vấn đề quan trọng trong lĩnh vực xây dựng và công trình. Trong bối cảnh ngày càng nhiều công trình nhà cao tầng được xây dựng ở các khu vực có nguy cơ xảy ra động đất, việc đánh giá chuyển vị mục tiêu trở nên cấp thiết hơn bao giờ hết.

Phương pháp tĩnh là một trong những phương pháp được sử dụng rộng rãi để đánh giá chuyển vị mục tiêu nhà cao tầng chịu động đất. Phương pháp này dựa trên giả định rằng công trình chịu tác động của động đất một cách tĩnh, không có biến dạng nền. Tuy nhiên, trong thực tế, biến dạng nền có thể ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến chuyển vị mục tiêu của công trình.

Để đánh giá chuyển vị mục tiêu nhà cao tầng chịu động đất có xét biến dạng nền, cần sử dụng các phương pháp tính toán phức tạp, bao gồm cả phương pháp động và phương pháp tĩnh. Phương pháp động sẽ tính toán chuyển vị mục tiêu của công trình dựa trên các giả định về động đất và biến dạng nền, trong khi phương pháp tĩnh sẽ sử dụng các giả định về chuyển vị mục tiêu và biến dạng nền để tính toán chuyển vị mục tiêu.

Kết quả đánh giá chuyển vị mục tiêu nhà cao tầng chịu động đất có xét biến dạng nền sẽ cung cấp thông tin quan trọng cho các nhà thiết kế và xây dựng công trình. Thông tin này sẽ giúp họ xác định được mức độ an toàn của công trình và đưa ra các biện pháp cần thiết để đảm bảo an toàn cho người và tài sản.

text: Dimensionality reduction (DR) is widely employed for analyzing and visualizing high-dimensional data, offering an initial overview but often requiring additional analysis, such as cluster identification and characterization, to derive meaningful insights. While existing automatic clustering methods can identify clusters, there remains a lack of effective approaches for understanding the distinctive characteristics of these clusters, especially when dealing with large numbers of features. This paper addresses this challenge by introducing a visual analytics method that highlights the essential features of a cluster within a DR result. The approach is based on an enhanced application of contrastive principal component analysis (cPCA), termed ccPCA (contrasting clusters in PCA), which quantifies each feature's relative contribution to the contrast between a specific cluster and all other clusters. Building on ccPCA, the authors developed an interactive system featuring scalable visualization of feature contributions for clusters. The effectiveness of the proposed method and system is demonstrated through case studies on several publicly available datasets, suggesting that ccPCA supports more accessible and insightful cluster interpretation in high-dimensional data visualizations and offers a foundation for future research on interpretable clustering in visual analytics.

text: This paper proposes a novel forecasting method for grouped time series data, leveraging the k-Means algorithm to enhance prediction accuracy. The objective is to address the challenge of forecasting multiple related time series simultaneously, which is common in various fields such as finance, economics, and logistics. Our approach involves applying the k-Means clustering algorithm to group similar time series together, followed by the implementation of a forecasting model tailored to each cluster. The results show that our method outperforms traditional forecasting techniques, particularly in cases where time series exhibit similar patterns. Key findings include improved forecasting accuracy and reduced computational complexity. The proposed method has significant implications for applications where grouped time series forecasting is crucial, such as demand forecasting and resource allocation. By combining the strengths of clustering analysis and time series forecasting, this research contributes to the development of more accurate and efficient forecasting methods, with potential applications in data-driven decision-making and strategic planning. Keywords: time series forecasting, k-Means algorithm, clustering analysis, demand forecasting, data-driven decision-making.

text: The tracking-by-detection framework usually consist of two stages: drawing samples around the target object in the first stage and classifying each sample as the target object or background in the second stage. Current popular trackers based on tracking-by-detection framework typically draw samples in the raw image as the inputs of deep convolution networks in the first stage, which usually results in high computational burden and low running speed. In this paper, we propose a new visual tracking method using sampling deep convolutional features to address this problem. Only one cropped image around the target object is input into the designed deep convolution network and the samples is sampled on the feature maps of the network by spatial bilinear resampling. In addition, a generative adversarial network is integrated into our network framework to augment positive samples and improve the tracking performance. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a comparable performance to state-of-the-art trackers and accelerates tracking-by-detection trackers based on raw-image samples effectively.

text: While representation learning on static graph-structured data has yielded substantial advancements across diverse real-world applications, the evolving characteristics of temporal networks, where edge configurations change dynamically over time, have received comparatively less attention. Effective embeddings for these temporal networks necessitate the encoding of both inherent graph-structured information and the temporally evolving patterns. Existing approaches for learning temporally evolving network representations often inadequately capture crucial temporal interdependence. This research proposes Toffee, a novel methodology for temporal network representation learning leveraging tensor decomposition. Specifically, Toffee employs the tensor-tensor product operator to comprehensively encode cross-time information, thereby facilitating the identification and modeling of periodic changes within these dynamic networks. Experimental results derived from multiple real-world temporal networks compellingly demonstrate that Toffee outperforms contemporary methods in generating highly effective embeddings for link prediction tasks, underscoring its enhanced capacity to capture and represent complex temporal dynamics.

Một số giải pháp công nghệ xử lý nước thải được đánh giá tiềm năng giảm phát thải khí mê-tan bao gồm:

- Công nghệ xử lý nước thải bằng phương pháp sinh học: Công nghệ này sử dụng vi sinh vật để phân hủy các chất hữu cơ trong nước thải, giảm thiểu lượng khí mê-tan được tạo ra.

- Công nghệ xử lý nước thải bằng phương pháp kết hợp: Công nghệ này kết hợp giữa phương pháp sinh học và hóa học để giảm thiểu lượng khí mê-tan được tạo ra.

text:
This paper addresses the challenge of high-dimensional multivariate forecasting, where traditional methods often struggle with scalability and accuracy due to the curse of dimensionality. We propose a novel approach leveraging low-rank Gaussian copula processes to model complex dependencies across multiple time series efficiently. Our method combines the flexibility of copula-based dependency modeling with the computational efficiency of low-rank approximations, enabling accurate forecasting in high-dimensional settings. The approach is evaluated on synthetic and real-world datasets, demonstrating superior performance in terms of predictive accuracy and computational efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods. Key findings reveal that the proposed model effectively captures both temporal and cross-dimensional dependencies, making it particularly suitable for applications in finance, climate modeling, and large-scale sensor networks. The results highlight the potential of low-rank Gaussian copula processes as a scalable and robust framework for high-dimensional forecasting, offering significant improvements over existing techniques. This research contributes to the advancement of multivariate time series analysis by providing a computationally efficient and theoretically grounded solution for real-world forecasting challenges.  

**Keywords**: multivariate forecasting, Gaussian copula, low-rank approximation, high-dimensional data, time series analysis, scalability.

Nghiên cứu đã tập trung vào việc đánh giá khả năng lên men của loại trái này khi sử dụng chủng nấm men Saccharomyces cerevisiae HG1.3 ở các thể tích khác nhau. Đáng chú ý, khi lên men ở thể tích 2 và 4 lít, rượu vang thu được đạt nồng độ ethanol cao, lần lượt là 12,37% và 12,45% (v/v). Đặc biệt, sản phẩm nhận được đánh giá cảm quan tích cực về độ trong, màu sắc và mùi vị, cùng với giá trị độ truyền quang lý tưởng. Sau lên men, rượu còn được xử lý bổ sung pectinase để tăng độ trong và điều chỉnh bằng acid citric, đảm bảo sản phẩm hoàn thiện đáp ứng mọi chỉ tiêu vi sinh vật và hóa học theo tiêu chuẩn Việt Nam.

text: The problem of topic modeling can be seen as a generalization of the clustering problem, in that it posits that observations are generated due to multiple latent factors (e.g., the words in each document are generated as a mixture of several active topics, as opposed to just one). This increased representational power comes at the cost of a more challenging unsupervised learning problem of estimating the topic probability vectors (the distributions over words for each topic), when only the words are observed and the corresponding topics are hidden.   We provide a simple and efficient learning procedure that is guaranteed to recover the parameters for a wide class of mixture models, including the popular latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA) model. For LDA, the procedure correctly recovers both the topic probability vectors and the prior over the topics, using only trigram statistics (i.e., third order moments, which may be estimated with documents containing just three words). The method, termed Excess Correlation Analysis (ECA), is based on a spectral decomposition of low order moments (third and fourth order) via two singular value decompositions (SVDs). Moreover, the algorithm is scalable since the SVD operations are carried out on k\times k matrices, where k is the number of latent factors (e.g. the number of topics), rather than in the d-dimensional observed space (typically d \gg k).

text:
Temporal decision-making is a critical challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), where agents must learn not only *what* actions to take but also *when* to act. This paper introduces **TempoRL**, a novel framework designed to optimize action timing in dynamic environments. The objective of this research is to address the inefficiencies caused by suboptimal timing in traditional RL approaches, which often lead to increased computational costs and reduced performance. TempoRL integrates a temporal gating mechanism with a deep Q-network (DQN) architecture, enabling the agent to dynamically decide when to execute actions based on environmental states and learned temporal patterns. Experiments were conducted across multiple benchmark environments, including Atari games and robotic control tasks, to evaluate the framework's effectiveness. Results demonstrate that TempoRL significantly reduces the number of actions required while maintaining or improving task performance compared to standard RL methods. Furthermore, the framework exhibits robustness in environments with varying temporal dynamics. The key contribution of this work lies in its ability to enhance RL efficiency by learning optimal action timing, offering potential applications in real-time systems, robotics, and resource-constrained environments. This research advances the field of RL by introducing a scalable and adaptive approach to temporal decision-making, paving the way for more efficient and intelligent autonomous systems.  

**Keywords**: reinforcement learning, temporal decision-making, action timing, deep Q-network, autonomous systems, efficiency optimization.

text: Most video super-resolution techniques aim to enhance high-resolution frames from low-resolution videos without considering the impact of compression. Nevertheless, the majority of videos available online or on mobile devices are subjected to compression, which can be particularly severe under bandwidth constraints. This study introduces a novel compression-informed video super-resolution model designed to restore high-resolution content while avoiding artifacts introduced by compression. The model comprises three modules: bi-directional recurrent warping, detail-preserving flow estimation, and Laplacian enhancement. These modules address compression characteristics, such as intra-frame locations in the input and frame smoothness in the output. Extensive experiments were conducted on standard datasets across various compression rates, encompassing numerous real-world video scenarios. Our findings demonstrate that the proposed method not only recovers high-resolution content from uncompressed frames on widely-used benchmark datasets but also achieves state-of-the-art performance in super-resolving compressed videos, as evidenced by multiple quantitative metrics. Additionally, we assessed the method's effectiveness and robustness by simulating video streaming from YouTube.

text: Over the past five years, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have achieved significant success in semantic segmentation, a fundamental task crucial for many applications like autonomous driving. Consequently, we propose a curriculum-style learning approach to minimize this domain gap, specifically for urban scenery semantic segmentation. Our curriculum domain adaptation strategy begins by solving easier tasks to infer critical properties of the target domain, initially focusing on learning global label distributions across images and local distributions within landmark superpixels. This estimation is simplified by the inherent idiosyncrasies of urban scenes, such as the predictable size and spatial relationships of elements like buildings, streets, and cars. Subsequently, we train a segmentation network, regularizing its predictions within the target domain to conform to these previously inferred properties. Experimental results demonstrate that our method surpasses baseline performance across two datasets and two backbone networks, and we also present comprehensive ablation studies detailing our approach.

Ngược lại, khi các trường thông tin bắt buộc được nhập đầy đủ, hệ thống sẽ xử lý dữ liệu và cập nhật hồ sơ cá nhân cho người dùng, các trường không bắt buộc nếu không được nhập sẽ được gán giá trị mặc định nhằm đảm bảo không phát sinh lỗi trong quá trình lưu trữ dữ liệu. Việc sử dụng phương pháp phân vùng tương đương giúp giảm số lượng trường hợp kiểm thử cần thiết mà vẫn đảm bảo bao phủ đầy đủ các tình huống có thể xảy ra trong thực tế. Ngoài ra, phương pháp kiểm thử này còn giúp phát hiện các lỗi tiềm ẩn liên quan đến việc kiểm soát dữ liệu đầu vào, đặc biệt là đối với các trường hợp người dùng cố tình bỏ trống hoặc nhập không hợp lệ các trường thông tin quan trọng. Để tăng cường chất lượng kiểm thử, quy trình kiểm tra lỗi còn được kết hợp với các kiểm thử biên, chẳng hạn như nhập dữ liệu có độ dài tối thiểu hoặc tối đa, kiểm tra các ký tự đặc biệt, và xác thực định dạng của từng trường thông tin (ví dụ: định dạng email, số điện thoại, ngày tháng năm sinh). Kết quả kiểm thử cho thấy hệ thống đã xử lý đúng các trường hợp hợp lệ và không hợp lệ, đảm bảo người dùng chỉ có thể lưu hồ sơ khi các thông tin yêu cầu được điền đầy đủ. Bên cạnh đó, việc cập nhật hồ sơ cũng được kiểm tra về mặt hiệu năng, đảm bảo tốc độ phản hồi của hệ thống đáp ứng yêu cầu sử dụng thực tế. Sau giai đoạn kiểm thử chức năng quản lý hồ sơ cá nhân, hệ thống đã đạt được độ tin cậy cao, đáp ứng các tiêu chí về kiểm soát dữ liệu đầu vào và bảo vệ thông tin người dùng. Điều này góp phần nâng cao trải nghiệm người dùng, giảm thiểu rủi ro phát sinh lỗi dữ liệu trong quá trình vận hành hệ thống và đảm bảo an toàn thông tin cá nhân của người sử dụng. Nhìn chung, phương pháp kiểm thử phân vùng tương đương được áp dụng cho chức năng này là phù hợp và hiệu quả, có thể mở rộng cho các chức năng khác liên quan đến nhập liệu và xử lý dữ liệu trên hệ thống. Việc kiểm thử kỹ lưỡng chức năng quản lý hồ sơ cá nhân là một bước quan trọng trong quá trình phát triển phần mềm, giúp phát hiện và khắc phục các vấn đề ngay từ giai đoạn đầu, đồng thời tạo nền tảng vững chắc cho việc triển khai và mở rộng các chức năng tiếp theo trong hệ thống.

Cụ thể, Docker được áp dụng điểm thực hiện việc biên dịch (compile) và chạy các ứng dụng được viết bằng nhiều ngôn ngữ lập trình khác nhau, bao gồm Python (đặc biệt với các thư viện xử lý dữ liệu lớn và machine learning), Node.js (cho các dịch vụ microservice backend), và Java (cho các thành phần nghiệp vụ). Ngoài ra, chúng tôi còn sử dụng Docker điểm triển khai và deploy hệ thống dưới dạng các container độc lập, mang lại lợi ích về tính di động, khả năng mở rộng linh hoạt và quy trình triển khai nhất quán từ môi trường phát triển sang môi trường sản phẩm. text: Molecule representation learning (MRL) methods aim to embed molecules into a continuous vector space. Existing approaches based on SMILES (Simplified Molecular-Input Line-Entry System) strings often struggle to effectively capture molecular structural information, while graph neural network (GNN)-based methods tend to prioritize architectural complexity at the expense of generalization. In this work, we propose leveraging chemical reaction information to enhance molecule representation learning. Our key insight is to enforce the equivalence of molecules within the embedding space according to chemical reactions, by constraining the sum of reactant embeddings to equal the sum of product embeddings for each reaction equation. This constraint effectively organizes the embedding space and improves the generalization ability of the learned representations. Furthermore, our model is compatible with any GNN architecture as the molecule encoder, making it architecture-agnostic. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across various downstream tasks, including a 17.4% absolute improvement in Hit@1 for chemical reaction prediction, a 2.3% absolute increase in AUC for molecular property prediction, and an 18.5% relative reduction in RMSE for graph edit distance prediction, compared to the best baseline methods. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/hwwang55/MolR.

text: In this paper, we learn dynamics models for parametrized families of dynamical systems with varying properties. The dynamics models are formulated as stochastic processes conditioned on a latent context variable which is inferred from observed transitions of the respective system. The probabilistic formulation allows us to compute an action sequence which, for a limited number of environment interactions, optimally explores the given system within the parametrized family. This is achieved by steering the system through transitions being most informative for the context variable. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method for exploration on a non-linear toy-problem and two well-known reinforcement learning environments.

text: This paper explores the potential of evolution strategies as a scalable alternative to traditional reinforcement learning methods. The objective is to address the challenges of applying reinforcement learning to complex, high-dimensional problems, where it often suffers from poor sample efficiency and limited scalability. We propose a novel approach that leverages evolution strategies to optimize policies in a parallel and distributed manner, allowing for significant improvements in computational efficiency. Our method utilizes a population-based search algorithm to evolve optimal policies, eliminating the need for gradient-based updates and enabling more efficient exploration of the solution space. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in achieving comparable or superior performance to state-of-the-art reinforcement learning methods on a range of benchmark tasks, while requiring significantly less computational resources. The key findings of this research highlight the potential of evolution strategies as a viable alternative to reinforcement learning, particularly in scenarios where scalability and efficiency are critical. This work contributes to the development of more efficient and scalable optimization methods, with potential applications in areas such as robotics, game playing, and autonomous systems, and is relevant to keywords such as evolution strategies, reinforcement learning, scalable optimization, and parallel computing.

text: Nghiên cứu này nhằm xác định tỷ lệ tuân thủ điều trị và các yếu tố liên quan đến sự tuân thủ điều trị ở thai phụ có thai nhi mắc tim bẩm sinh được phối hợp quản lý bởi Bệnh viện Nhi Đồng Thành Phố và Bệnh viện Hùng Vương. Phương pháp nghiên cứu là cắt ngang mô tả và phân tích các thai phụ có thai nhi mắc tim bẩm sinh được chẩn đoán xác định qua siêu âm tim thai tại Khoa Chẩn đoán Hình ảnh Bệnh viện Hùng Vương, do bác sĩ tim mạch từ Bệnh viện Nhi Đồng Thành Phố thực hiện, trong giai đoạn từ tháng 05/2018 đến tháng 02/2021. Kết quả cho thấy, tổng cộng 399 thai phụ có thai nhi mắc tim bẩm sinh đã được tuyển chọn vào nghiên cứu. Về đặc điểm dân số xã hội, tuổi trung bình của thai phụ là 29,2 ± 5,9 tuổi; đa số (74,9%) sống tại Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh và 75,9% có trình độ học vấn từ cấp 3 trở lên. Công nhân là nghề nghiệp phổ biến nhất (76,4%), và 14% (56 trường hợp) thai phụ có tín ngưỡng tôn giáo. Về đặc điểm thai kỳ, tuổi thai trung bình khi thai nhi được phát hiện mắc bệnh tim bẩm sinh là 27,8 ± 5,6 tuần. Có 30,1% thai nhi được chẩn đoán là tim bẩm sinh phức tạp và 12% (48 trường hợp) có dị tật ngoài tim kèm theo. Trong số các trường hợp, 82 thai nhi (20,6%) tử vong trong giai đoạn bào thai, trong đó 59 trường hợp là do chấm dứt thai kỳ. Đa số thai phụ (88,5%) có kết cục thai kỳ thuận lợi. Về đặc điểm tuân thủ điều trị, tỷ lệ tuân thủ tái khám là 97%, tuân thủ xử lý thai kỳ là 94%, tuân thủ phương thức sinh là 94,3%, tuân thủ nơi sinh là 92,4%, tuân thủ xét nghiệm là 89,7%, và tuân thủ bệnh viện chuyển đến sau sinh là 76,1%. Phân tích mối liên quan giữa tuân thủ điều trị và đặc điểm của đối tượng nghiên cứu cho thấy: Tuân thủ tái khám kém ở nhóm tuổi thai nhỏ (p=0,039) và nhóm tử vong bào thai hoặc chấm dứt thai kỳ (p=0,000). Tuân thủ xét nghiệm kém ở nhóm theo tôn giáo (p=0,000). Tuân thủ xử lý thai kỳ kém ở nhóm theo tôn giáo (p=0,001), tim bẩm sinh nặng và tử vong bào thai (p=0,000). Tuân thủ nơi sinh kém ở nhóm có dị tật kèm theo (p=0,031). Tuân thủ phương thức sinh kém ở nhóm có tật tim bẩm sinh nặng (p=0,001). Cuối cùng, tuân thủ bệnh viện chuyển đến sau sinh kém ở những trường hợp được hội chẩn trong giai đoạn đầu của nghiên cứu (p=0,000). Kết luận, đa số thai phụ mang thai nhi mắc tim bẩm sinh cho thấy tỷ lệ tuân thủ điều trị cao (>90%). Tuy nhiên, tỷ lệ tuân thủ thấp hơn được ghi nhận ở các khía cạnh xét nghiệm và chuyển viện sau sinh. Các yếu tố liên quan đến sự không tuân thủ điều trị bao gồm: tuổi thai nhỏ, tật tim bẩm sinh nặng, có tín ngưỡng tôn giáo, và tử vong bào thai.

text: This paper provides a concise report on our participation in the Recognizing Families In the Wild Data Challenge (4th Edition), held in conjunction with the FG 2020 Forum. The task of automatic kinship recognition has garnered significant interest due to its extensive applications, yet it remains highly complex because of the limited information available to ascertain whether two individuals are biologically related. In this study, we examined previous techniques and introduced our own approach. We experimented with several methods, such as deep metric learning, to extract deep embedding features from each image, subsequently determining kinship through Euclidean distance or class-based methods. Our findings highlight the effectiveness of techniques like sampling more negative samples and using high-resolution images to enhance performance. Furthermore, we developed a symmetric network employing a binary classification method, achieving our highest scores across all tasks.

ODVICE is a novel data augmentation framework that systematically augments records by leveraging medical concept ontologies through an ontologically guided Monte-Carlo graph spanning algorithm. Users control the process via a small set of interactive controls. Evaluated on the MIMIC-III dataset for two learning tasks, ODVICE-augmented cohorts significantly improve predictive performance, yielding a ~30% improvement in Area Under the Curve (AUC) over non-augmented and other augmentation strategies.

text: User data confidentiality protection is increasingly challenging in current deep learning research. In the absence of data, traditional data-driven model compression is more susceptible to performance decline. Some recent studies suggest generating images using a specific pretrained model to act as training data. However, this inversion process only relies on the biased feature statistics stored in a single model and transitions from low to high dimensions, resulting in limited generalizability and inaccurate inversion, which impairs performance. To resolve these issues, we introduce MixMix, which is founded on two straightforward yet powerful techniques: (1) Feature Mixing, which employs multiple models to create a universal feature space for enhanced inversion generality; and (2) Data Mixing, which combines synthesized images and labels to produce precise label information. We demonstrate the effectiveness of MixMix through both theoretical and empirical analysis. Comprehensive experiments indicate that MixMix surpasses existing methods in mainstream compression tasks such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning. Remarkably, MixMix delivers up to 4% and 20% improvements in accuracy for quantization and pruning, respectively, compared to current data-free compression approaches.

text: In Vietnam, research on the application of computer-assisted diagnostic software for ischemic stroke in the middle cerebral artery territory remains limited. Therefore, this study aimed to investigate the concordance of Rapid ASPECTS on computed tomography (CT) with ASPECTS scores assessed by clinicians and radiologists. A retrospective study was conducted at People's Hospital 115 from 01/04/2023 to 31/05/2024, enrolling 188 cases of ischemic stroke in the middle cerebral artery territory admitted within 24 hours who underwent both CT and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). The Rapid software provided ASPECTS scores based on CT images. Using physician-assessed MRI ASPECTS (ASPECTS CHT) as the reference standard, the ASPECTS scores from the automated Rapid software on CT (Rapid ASPECTS) and physician-assessed CT ASPECTS (ASPECTS CLVT) were evaluated using the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC). The median Rapid ASPECTS was 9 (7 - 10), ASPECTS CLVT was 10 (8 - 10), and ASPECTS CHT was 8 (6 - 9). Automated Rapid ASPECTS demonstrated good agreement with ASPECTS CHT (ICC: 0.688, 95% CI: 0.538 - 0.783, p < 0.001), which was higher than the agreement between ASPECTS CLVT and ASPECTS CHT (ICC: 0.561, 95% CI: -0.142 - 0.799, p < 0.001). In the subgroup with an onset-to-CT time of ≤ 6 hours, the agreement of Rapid ASPECTS with ASPECTS CHT (ICC: 0.707) was higher than that of ASPECTS CLVT with ASPECTS CHT (ICC: 0.517). Rapid ASPECTS provides results comparable to radiologist-read CT ASPECTS (ASPECTS CLVT) and radiologist-read MRI ASPECTS (ASPECTS CHT) in evaluating acute ischemic stroke in the middle cerebral artery territory, with superior performance in patients with an onset-to-imaging time of ≤ 6 hours.

text: The BPE tokenization algorithm operates by learning a predefined number of merge operations, up to a specified limit K, from a given corpus, along with a set of subwords that can be combined to form any word within the corpus. Initially, words are broken down into character sequences, and then the algorithm iteratively identifies and merges the most frequently occurring pairs of current types, starting with individual characters. As the algorithm progresses, it updates the segmentation of each word based on the newly added merge operations, repeating this process until the desired number of merge operations is reached, ultimately yielding a set of subwords that can be used to represent the entire corpus.
