text: Most Siamese network-based trackers lack the ability to adaptively learn target-specific variations because they perform tracking without updating their models. Additionally, these trackers typically predict object locations using axis-aligned bounding boxes, which capture unnecessary background and fail to accurately estimate the rotation and scale changes of moving objects, potentially diminishing tracking performance. To address these issues, we introduce the Rotation-Scale Invariant Network (RSINet), which features a target-distractor discrimination branch and a rotation-scale estimation branch. Through a multi-task learning approach, RSINet explicitly learns rotation and scale information in an end-to-end framework. Furthermore, the model adapts and updates itself during tracking via spatio-temporal energy control, ensuring stability, reliability, and high tracking efficiency. Extensive experiments on OTB-100, VOT2018, and LaSOT benchmarks show that RSINet achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to recent trackers and operates in real time at approximately 45 FPS.

text: This paper studies the problem of globally optimizing a variable of interest that is part of a causal model in which a sequence of interventions can be performed. Our approach combines ideas from causal inference, uncertainty quantification and sequential decision making. In particular, it generalizes Bayesian optimization, which treats the input variables of the objective function as independent, to scenarios where causal information is available. We show how knowing the causal graph significantly improves the ability to reason about optimal decision making strategies decreasing the optimization cost while avoiding suboptimal solutions. We propose a new algorithm called Causal Bayesian Optimization (CBO). CBO automatically balances two trade-offs: the classical exploration-exploitation and the new observation-intervention, which emerges when combining real interventional data with the estimated intervention effects computed via do-calculus. We demonstrate the practical benefits of this method in a synthetic setting and in two real-world applications.

text: This paper proposes an innovative approach to skeleton-based action recognition by introducing an Attention Enhanced Graph Convolutional LSTM Network. The objective is to improve the accuracy of action recognition in videos by effectively modeling spatial and temporal relationships between human joints. Our method employs graph convolutional networks to capture spatial dependencies and LSTM to model temporal dynamics, with an attention mechanism that focuses on the most relevant joints and frames. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving significant improvements in recognition accuracy. The key findings highlight the importance of attention in selectively weighting joint importance and the effectiveness of graph convolutional networks in capturing complex spatial relationships. This research contributes to the field of human action recognition, with potential applications in areas such as surveillance, healthcare, and human-computer interaction. The proposed network architecture and attention mechanism provide a novel and effective solution for skeleton-based action recognition, with key keywords including graph convolutional networks, LSTM, attention mechanisms, and action recognition.

text:
WebRTC (Web Real-Time Communication) là một bộ sưu tập các công nghệ tiên tiến được thiết kế để cho phép trình duyệt web và các ứng dụng di động thực hiện giao tiếp âm thanh, video và dữ liệu theo thời gian thực mà không cần đến các plugin hay phần mềm bổ sung. Công nghệ này được phát triển bởi World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) và Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) nhằm mục đích chuẩn hóa giao tiếp thời gian thực cho các ứng dụng web. Một trong những lợi ích chính của WebRTC là khả năng tích hợp dễ dàng với các ứng dụng web nhờ vào các API JavaScript đơn giản, qua đó cho phép các nhà phát triển xây dựng các ứng dụng truyền thông mạnh mẽ và liền mạch mà không cần kiến thức sâu về truyền thông đa phương tiện.

WebRTC hỗ trợ ba thành phần chính: MediaStream, RTCPeerConnection, và RTCDataChannel. MediaStream cho phép truy cập và thao tác với các thiết bị phần cứng như camera và microphone, RTCPeerConnection quản lý kết nối và truyền tải dữ liệu âm thanh/video giữa các điểm kết nối, và RTCDataChannel hỗ trợ truyền tải dữ liệu tùy ý giữa các điểm kết nối. Những thành phần này kết hợp với nhau để tạo ra một nền tảng mạnh mẽ cho các ứng dụng truyền thông đa phương tiện. Hơn nữa, WebRTC tích hợp nhiều tính năng bảo mật như mã hóa dữ liệu và xác thực kết nối nhằm bảo đảm tính an toàn và riêng tư trong giao tiếp.

Sự phát triển của WebRTC đã mở ra nhiều cơ hội mới cho các ngành công nghiệp khác nhau, từ truyền thông, giải trí, đến giáo dục và y tế. Trong giáo dục, WebRTC được sử dụng để tạo ra các phòng học ảo, nơi học sinh và giáo viên có thể tương tác trực tiếp qua video và âm thanh mà không cần đến các phần mềm phức tạp. Ở lĩnh vực y tế, các bác sĩ có thể tiến hành hội chẩn từ xa với bệnh nhân hoặc đồng nghiệp một cách dễ dàng, tiết kiệm thời gian và chi phí.

Một trong những thách thức lớn nhất đối với WebRTC là việc đảm bảo tính tương thích và hiệu suất trên nhiều loại thiết bị và trình duyệt khác nhau. Mặc dù hầu hết các trình duyệt hiện đại đều hỗ trợ WebRTC, nhưng sự khác biệt trong cách triển khai có thể dẫn đến các vấn đề về hiệu suất và khả năng tương thích. Các nhà phát triển cần phải kiểm tra kỹ lưỡng ứng dụng của mình trên nhiều nền tảng khác nhau để đảm bảo hoạt động ổn định và nhất quán.

Bên cạnh đó, sự phát triển nhanh chóng của công nghệ cũng đặt ra yêu cầu cho việc cập nhật và cải tiến liên tục các tiêu chuẩn WebRTC để bắt kịp với nhu cầu ngày càng cao của người dùng. Điều này đòi hỏi sự hợp tác chặt chẽ giữa các nhà phát triển, các tổ chức tiêu chuẩn và cộng đồng mã nguồn mở để đảm bảo rằng WebRTC sẽ không chỉ duy trì vị trí của mình như một công nghệ truyền thông tiên tiến mà còn phát triển mạnh mẽ hơn nữa trong tương lai.

Nhìn chung, WebRTC là một công nghệ đột phá trong lĩnh vực truyền thông thời gian thực, với tiềm năng to lớn để thay đổi cách chúng ta giao tiếp và tương tác trên nền tảng web. Sự linh hoạt và khả năng tích hợp của nó mở ra một tương lai đầy hứa hẹn cho các ứng dụng truyền thông, khuyến khích sự sáng tạo và đổi mới trong nhiều lĩnh vực khác nhau.

text: Deep learning is widely applied in various fields of computer vision, typically necessitating extensive datasets for initial training followed by fine-tuning for smaller-scale tasks. Action recognition is among the many domains benefiting from deep learning techniques. Although Convolutional Neural Networks are commonly used with RGB and optical flow frames, recurrent networks like LSTM are often employed for training on temporal sequences of 3D skeletal joint data. This paper introduces a novel approach that transforms sequences of 3D skeleton joints into texture-like representations using mathematically grounded kernel methods. These representations serve as the initial layer in a conventional CNN, such as ResNet-50, and are integrated into a supervised domain adaptation framework to transfer knowledge from a source to a target dataset. By exploiting Kinect-based data beyond single-dataset training, our method surpasses basic fine-tuning approaches that naively combine datasets. Specifically, we leverage overlapping classes across datasets, linking data points of the same class through supervised domain adaptation principles. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on three publicly available benchmarks.

text: Monocular 3D object detection is a crucial task in autonomous driving due to its cost-effectiveness. It presents greater challenges than traditional 2D detection because of its inherent ill-posed nature, primarily due to the absence of depth information. Advancements in 2D detection provide opportunities to address this challenge more effectively. Nevertheless, adapting a general 2D detector for 3D tasks is not straightforward. In this paper, we explore this issue by utilizing a fully convolutional single-stage detector and introducing a general framework called FCOS3D. Our approach begins by transforming the standard 7-DoF 3D targets into the image domain, separating them into 2D and 3D attributes. We then allocate objects to various feature levels based on their 2D scales and assign them using only the projected 3D-center during training. Additionally, we redefine the center-ness using a 2D Gaussian distribution centered on the 3D-center to align with the 3D target formulation. This framework is straightforward yet effective, eliminating the need for any 2D detection or 2D-3D correspondence priors. Our solution secured 1st place among all vision-only methods in the nuScenes 3D detection challenge at NeurIPS 2020. Code and models are available at https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d.

text: The issue at hand is that overweight and obese patients are at high risk for developing Metabolic Associated Fatty Liver Disease (MAFLD), with odds ratios (OR) of 5.5. MAFLD is the second most common cause of hepatocellular carcinoma. Research by Zysk and Gopalakrishna indicates a linear correlation between liver fat infiltration values, liver stiffness, and body mass index, with corresponding r values of 0.7 and 0.3. In Vietnam, liver cancer ranked second, accounting for 11.7% in 2022. Therefore, this study aims to determine the correlation between the degree of liver steatosis and fibrosis with body mass index and significant risk factors for liver fibrosis in overweight and obese patients with MAFLD, contributing to better management of this patient group. Subjects and methods: A cross-sectional descriptive study was conducted on overweight and obese patients aged 18 and older who visited the outpatient clinic at People's Hospital 115 from March 2024 to June 2024. Results: 140 overweight and obese patients with MAFLD were included in the study. Among these patients, there was a linear correlation between BMI and LSM as well as BMI and CAP, with r values of 0.5 and 0.8, respectively. Multivariate analysis showed that only BMI ≥ 25 kg/m2 (OR: 4.17) and comorbid MAFLD (OR: 4.74) were risk factors for significant fibrosis. Conclusion: In overweight and obese patients with MAFLD, there is a linear correlation between LSM and BMI with r = 0.5, as well as CAP and BMI with r = 0.8. Comorbid MAFLD and BMI ≥ 25 kg/m2 are risk factors for significant liver fibrosis in overweight and obese patients with MAFLD.

text:
Visual tracking is a critical component in the field of robotics, particularly for mobile robots that rely on real-time perception and navigation. This paper provides a comprehensive review of state-of-the-art visual trackers, analyzing their methodologies, strengths, and limitations. We explore various approaches, including traditional feature-based methods and modern deep learning-based techniques, with a focus on their applicability to mobile robot systems. Key performance metrics such as accuracy, robustness, and computational efficiency are evaluated across different environments and use cases. The findings highlight the trade-offs between model complexity and real-time performance, emphasizing the need for lightweight yet effective solutions in resource-constrained mobile platforms. Additionally, we discuss the integration of visual trackers with other sensor modalities to enhance situational awareness and decision-making in dynamic environments. This review contributes to the field by identifying gaps in current technologies and proposing future research directions to improve the reliability and adaptability of visual tracking systems for mobile robotics.  

**Keywords**: visual tracking, mobile robots, deep learning, real-time perception, sensor fusion, robotics navigation.

text: 147-word abstract: To address the challenge of efficiently deploying ML models across diverse systems (MLOps), we introduce CodeReef, an open platform for cross-platform MLOps. CodeReef solutions enable packaging and sharing models as non-virtualized, portable, customizable, and reproducible archive files, including JSON meta descriptions, Python APIs, CLI actions, and portable workflows for automated building, benchmarking, testing, and customization across various platforms, AI frameworks, libraries, compilers, and datasets. We demonstrate CodeReef by automatically building, running, and measuring SSD-Mobilenets object detection using TensorFlow and COCO from MLPerf inference across a wide range of platforms, from Raspberry Pi to data centers. Our long-term goal is to empower researchers to share new techniques as production-ready packages alongside research papers, facilitating collaborative and reproducible benchmarking, comparison of different ML/software/hardware stacks, and selection of the most efficient configurations using online CodeReef dashboards.

text:
Tóm tắt ý chính: Đoạn văn đề cập đến việc phân tích lưu lượng truy cập của báo điện tử, cụ thể là tính toán số lượng người dùng (users) và lượt xem (views) theo ngày, hệ điều hành (os) và các khung giờ trong ngày, dựa trên dữ liệu thời gian (tme) và mã định danh người dùng (gud). Quá trình này được minh họa bằng đoạn mã `Analyst.java` sử dụng các thao tác trên DataFrame như `select`, `split`, `groupBy`, và `agg` để trích xuất ngày, nhóm dữ liệu, và tính toán các chỉ số `vew` (views) và `user` (unique users), nhằm mục tiêu làm rõ biến động truy cập và hỗ trợ quyết định chiến lược.

Phân tích lưu lượng truy cập web là một tác vụ thiết yếu để thấu hiểu hành vi người dùng và tối ưu hóa trải nghiệm trên các nền tảng trực tuyến, đặc biệt là với báo điện tử. Các công trình trước đây thường tập trung vào việc thống kê tổng lượt truy cập theo ngày (ví dụ, Johnson và cộng sự, 2019) hoặc phân loại người dùng dựa trên các đặc điểm chung (Smith & Lee, 2020). Mặc dù hữu ích, những phân tích này thường chưa đi sâu vào việc làm rõ biến động của lưu lượng người dùng và lượt xem theo *các khung giờ cụ thể trong ngày*, cũng như sự khác biệt giữa các hệ điều hành (`os`). Nghiên cứu hiện tại giải quyết khoảng trống này bằng cách đề xuất một quy trình chi tiết để tính toán số lượng người dùng (`user`) và lượt xem (`vew`) theo từng khung giờ trong ngày, đồng thời phân tách theo hệ điều hành. Phương pháp này, được triển khai trong module `Analyst.java` như sau: `return df.select(splt(col("tme")," ").getItem(0).as("date"), col("os"), col("gud")) .groupBy("date", "os") .agg(count("gud").as("vew"), countDstnct("gud").as("user")) .collectAsLst();`, bao gồm các bước tiền xử lý dữ liệu thời gian (`tme`) để trích xuất thông tin ngày (và có thể mở rộng cho khung giờ), sau đó sử dụng mã định danh người dùng (`gud`) để nhóm (`groupBy`) và tổng hợp (`agg`) các chỉ số cần thiết. Đóng góp của nghiên cứu không chỉ nằm ở việc cung cấp một bức tranh chi tiết hơn về động lực học truy cập mà còn hỗ trợ các nhà quản trị nội dung đưa ra quyết định chiến lược về thời điểm xuất bản và phân phối tin tức hiệu quả hơn, đặc biệt khi xem xét bài toán tính số lượng người dùng và lượt xem báo điện tử theo khung giờ trong ngày.

text: Taxonomy construction là quá trình xây dựng hệ thống phân loại cho một lĩnh vực hay một tập hợp dữ liệu nào đó. Trong đó Topic Taxonomy Construction là một nhiệm vụ cụ thể của Taxonomy Construction, ở đó các chủ đề được phân loại theo cấu trúc phân cấp. Đây là một phần của công việc phân tích ngữ nghĩa của dữ liệu văn bản, được ứng dụng nhiều trong các công việc xử lý ngôn ngữ tự nhiên, trích xuất thông tin. Một số ứng dụng có thể kể đến như phân loại và tìm kiếm thông tin giúp người dùng dễ dàng tìm kiếm thông tin cần thiết , phân loại và quản lý các loại kiến thức khác nhau , điều xuất nội dung được cá nhân hóa ,... Như đã đề cập ở phần giới thiệu, có hai hướng xây dựng hệ thống phân cấp là thủ công và tự điộng nhưng kh có nhiều lĩnh vực và ứng dụng khác nhau thì việc xây dựng hệ thống phân loại tự động (Automated Toc Taxonomy) dựa trên các bộ dữ liệu khác nhau của các lĩnh vực khác nhau là phù hợp với yêu cầu bài toán.

The agent requires a good scene representation of the visual observation that discerns essential components and consistently propagates along the time horizon. Our method, GATSBI, utilizes unsupervised object-centric scene representation learning to separate an active agent, static background, and passive objects. GATSBI then models the interactions reflecting the causal relationships among decomposed entities and predicts physically plausible future states. Our model generalizes to a variety of environments where different types of robots and objects dynamically interact with each other. Ensuring accountability in such solutions remains a significant challenge for auditors and the machine learning community. In this work, we propose a wrapper that augments any black-box model’s output with an uncertainty measure. This wrapper enables auditing for accuracy risk—risks arising from low-quality or uncertain predictions—and provides an actionable mitigation mechanism through decision rejection, whereby predictions are withheld when associated uncertainty is high. We advocate for a rejection system that retains only confident predictions, discarding uncertain ones to enhance system trustworthiness. We demonstrate our methodology using a simulated sentiment analysis API based on natural language processing across multiple domains. Experimental results show that the wrapper’s computed uncertainty effectively identifies low-quality predictions and misclassifications, exhibiting strong correlation with prediction errors.

text: Sự phát triển mạnh mẽ của điện toán đám mây đã định hình lại kiến trúc hạ tầng công nghệ thông tin toàn cầu, thúc đẩy một kỷ nguyên mới của chuyển đổi số trong mọi lĩnh vực. Các xu hướng nổi bật cho thấy sự dịch chuyển ngày càng sâu rộng từ các mô hình đám mây công cộng (Public Cloud) truyền thống sang các kiến trúc lai (Hybrid Cloud) và đa đám mây (Multi-Cloud), cho phép các tổ chức tối ưu hóa sự linh hoạt, khả năng phục hồi và hiệu quả chi phí thông qua việc lựa chọn và kết hợp các dịch vụ từ nhiều nhà cung cấp khác nhau. Điều này đặc biệt quan trọng đối với các doanh nghiệp có yêu cầu nghiêm ngặt về quyền riêng tư dữ liệu, tuân thủ quy định hoặc cần duy trì một phần cơ sở hạ tầng tại chỗ. Bên cạnh đó, sự gia tăng ứng dụng của các dịch vụ đám mây không máy chủ (Serverless Computing), như Functions-as-a-Service (FaaS), đã cách mạng hóa quy trình phát triển ứng dụng bằng cách cho phép các nhà phát triển tập trung hoàn toàn vào logic kinh doanh mà không cần quản lý cơ sở hạ tầng bên dưới, từ đó giảm thiểu chi phí vận hành và tăng tốc độ triển khai sản phẩm. Điện toán đám mây không chỉ là nền tảng cho việc lưu trữ và xử lý dữ liệu mà còn là bệ phóng cho các công nghệ tiên tiến như Trí tuệ Nhân tạo (AI), Học máy (ML), và Internet Vạn vật (IoT). Các nền tảng đám mây cung cấp sức mạnh tính toán và khả năng lưu trữ khổng lồ cần thiết để huấn luyện các mô hình AI phức tạp, xử lý dữ liệu IoT theo thời gian thực và triển khai các ứng dụng học sâu quy mô lớn. Sự hội tụ giữa đám mây và điện toán biên (Edge Computing) cũng đang trở thành một xu hướng quan trọng, giải quyết các thách thức về độ trễ và băng thông bằng cách xử lý dữ liệu gần nguồn phát sinh hơn, đồng thời tận dụng lợi thế của đám mây để tổng hợp và phân tích dữ liệu quy mô lớn. Thách thức về bảo mật và quản lý dữ liệu vẫn là trọng tâm trong việc triển khai đám mây. Các giải pháp bảo mật đám mây hiện đại tập trung vào mô hình trách nhiệm chia sẻ, nơi nhà cung cấp đám mây chịu trách nhiệm bảo mật cơ sở hạ tầng, còn người dùng chịu trách nhiệm bảo mật dữ liệu và cấu hình ứng dụng. Việc áp dụng các phương pháp Zero Trust, mã hóa dữ liệu đầu cuối, quản lý danh tính và truy cập (IAM), cùng với các công cụ tuân thủ tự động, là không thể thiếu để đảm bảo an toàn cho dữ liệu và ứng dụng trên đám mây. Hơn nữa, việc tối ưu hóa chi phí (FinOps) đang trở thành một lĩnh vực chuyên môn quan trọng, giúp các tổ chức quản lý và tối đa hóa giá trị từ các khoản đầu tư đám mây thông qua việc theo dõi, phân tích và tối ưu hóa việc sử dụng tài nguyên. Trong tương lai, điện toán đám mây dự kiến sẽ tiếp tục phát triển với sự xuất hiện của các dịch vụ chuyên biệt hóa theo ngành (Industry-specific Clouds), cung cấp các giải pháp được tùy chỉnh sâu sắc để đáp ứng các yêu cầu đặc thù của từng ngành như y tế, tài chính hay sản xuất. Sự chú trọng vào tính bền vững và hiệu quả năng lượng cũng sẽ định hình các trung tâm dữ liệu đám mây, thúc đẩy việc sử dụng năng lượng tái tạo và tối ưu hóa hiệu suất tài nguyên. text: Trong lĩnh vực chăn nuôi gà đẻ trứng, việc loại thải gà trống ngay sau khi nở là một thực tế phổ biến. Tuy nhiên, nhằm đáp ứng xu hướng tiêu dùng các sản phẩm sạch, một giải pháp thay thế là đưa gà trống mới nở vào quy trình nuôi chăn thả. Xuất phát từ ý tưởng này, nghiên cứu được tiến hành để nuôi gà trống hướng trứng Sasso (dòng tăng trưởng chậm) và gà hướng thịt Ross 308 (dòng tăng trưởng nhanh) trong điều kiện thả vườn, đồng thời so sánh chất lượng thịt của chúng. Sáu mươi cá thể gà từ mỗi giống được nuôi nhốt đến 21 ngày tuổi với mật độ 6 con/m², sau đó được chuyển sang nuôi chăn thả với mật độ 5 con/m². Quy trình chăn nuôi thí nghiệm tuân thủ theo hướng dẫn của Bộ NN & PTNT (2010). Vào các thời điểm 49 và 90 ngày tuổi, gà được mổ khảo sát nhằm phân tích và so sánh chất lượng thịt giữa hai lô thí nghiệm. Đánh giá chất lượng cảm quan thịt gà sau chế biến được thực hiện bằng phương pháp cho điểm dựa trên sáu tiêu chí: màu sắc, mùi, độ mịn của thớ thịt, khả năng giữ nước, vị và sự chấp nhận tổng thể từ người thử nếm. Độ pH của thịt gà Ross 308 tại thời điểm 24 giờ sau giết mổ cũng cao hơn so với pH thịt gà Sasso. Về màu sắc, thịt gà Sasso được đánh giá có màu sẫm hơn thịt gà Ross 308 (P < 0,001). Đáng chú ý, kết quả đánh giá cảm quan cho thấy thịt gà trống Sasso có vị ngon vượt trội hơn thịt gà Ross 308 (P < 0,01) tại thời điểm 90 ngày tuổi.

Những công nghệ này cho phép phát triển các giao diện người dùng phong phú, đáp ứng, và tương tác cao. Một trong những thách thức lớn của tầng View là đảm bảo tính nhất quán và khả năng mở rộng của giao diện trong khi vẫn duy trì hiệu suất hoạt động tốt. Điều này đòi hỏi sự kết hợp chặt chẽ giữa thiết kế giao diện và lập trình, cùng với việc sử dụng các công cụ tối ưu hóa và kiểm tra hiệu suất như Lighthouse hay WebPageTest. text: Pedestrian trajectory representation learning, a crucial technique for connecting feature-based data mining with trajectory data, transforms variable-length timestamp-coordinate tuples of a trajectory into a fixed-length vector summarizing its spatiotemporal characteristics. This representation is challenging because both environmental constraints (e.g., wall partitions) and temporal user dynamics must be meticulously considered. Moreover, traditional sequence-to-sequence autoencoders employing maximum log-likelihood often demand datasets that cover all possible spatiotemporal characteristics to perform effectively, a requirement that is infeasible or impractical in real-world applications. To address this, we propose TREP, a practical pedestrian trajectory representation learning algorithm that captures environmental constraints and pedestrian dynamics without requiring any training dataset. TREP utilizes a sequence-to-sequence autoencoder formulated with a spatial-aware objective function within the actor-critic reinforcement learning paradigm, enabling it to intelligently encode spatiotemporal characteristics of trajectories and handle diverse trajectory patterns. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real datasets validate the high fidelity of TREP to represent trajectories.

text: Molecule generation is a challenging open problem in cheminformatics. Currently, deep generative approaches addressing the challenge belong to two broad categories, differing in how molecules are represented. One approach encodes molecular graphs as strings of text, and learns their corresponding character-based language model. Another, more expressive, approach operates directly on the molecular graph. In this work, we address two limitations of the former: generation of invalid and duplicate molecules. To improve validity rates, we develop a language model for small molecular substructures called fragments, loosely inspired by the well-known paradigm of Fragment-Based Drug Design. In other words, we generate molecules fragment by fragment, instead of atom by atom. To improve uniqueness rates, we present a frequency-based masking strategy that helps generate molecules with infrequent fragments. We show experimentally that our model largely outperforms other language model-based competitors, reaching state-of-the-art performances typical of graph-based approaches. Moreover, generated molecules display molecular properties similar to those in the training sample, even in absence of explicit task-specific supervision.

text: We propose Probabilistic Object Detection, which involves identifying objects in images while precisely measuring both spatial and semantic uncertainties in the detections. Due to the absence of existing methods for evaluating such probabilistic detections, we introduce the Probability-based Detection Quality (PDQ) metric. Unlike AP-based metrics, PDQ eliminates arbitrary thresholds, rewards accurate spatial and label predictions, and evaluates foreground/background separation while penalizing false positives and false negatives. We compare PDQ with mAP and moLRP by testing leading detectors and a Bayesian detector using Monte Carlo Dropout. Results show that standard detectors often exhibit excessive spatial confidence, leading to subpar performance in probabilistic detection. This work seeks to advance the creation of object detection methods that deliver reliable spatial and label uncertainty estimates, crucial for real-world applications in robotics and embodied AI systems.

text: Imitation Learning describes the problem of recovering an expert policy from demonstrations. While inverse reinforcement learning approaches are known to be very sample-efficient in terms of expert demonstrations, they usually require problem-dependent reward functions or a (task-)specific reward-function regularization. In this paper, we show a natural connection between inverse reinforcement learning approaches and Optimal Transport, that enables more general reward functions with desirable properties (e.g., smoothness). Based on our observation, we propose a novel approach called Wasserstein Adversarial Imitation Learning. Our approach considers the Kantorovich potentials as a reward function and further leverages regularized optimal transport to enable large-scale applications. In several robotic experiments, our approach outperforms the baselines in terms of average cumulative rewards and shows a significant improvement in sample-efficiency, by requiring just one expert demonstration.

text: Machine learning models are frequently trained on data from one distribution but deployed on others, making it crucial to design models that are robust to distribution shifts. Most existing work optimizes for either adversarial shifts or interventional shifts. Adversarial methods are limited in expressivity, as they represent shifts as changes to the joint distributions in the data, often failing to capture plausible real-world variations. Interventional methods permit greater expressivity but tend to provide robustness to unbounded shifts, which can result in models that are overly conservative. In this work, we leverage the complementary strengths of both approaches and introduce a new formulation, RISe, to design robust models against a set of distribution shifts lying at the intersection of adversarial and interventional shifts. We utilize the distributionally robust optimization framework to optimize this objective in both supervised and reinforcement learning settings. Extensive experiments with synthetic and real-world healthcare datasets demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed approach.

text: A formal and general definition of property inference attacks offers a new framework for understanding how these attacks can distinguish between possible training distributions, moving beyond prior work focused on inferring simple ratios of data types. A key theoretical result establishes a connection between the maximum accuracy of such inference attacks and the effective size of the dataset leaked by the model. Experimental investigations across various distributions, using both black-box and white-box approaches, reveal that inexpensive attacks frequently match the efficacy of more costly meta-classifier attacks, and highlight unexpected asymmetries in attack effectiveness. text: Clean ArchitectureClean Architecture is a software architecture designed to keep code under con trol while avoiding the tidiness that prevents anybody from modifying code once it has been released. The basic idea behind Clean Architecture is that applicationcode/logic that is unlikely to change should be developed without any direct de pendencies. So if we alter our framework, database, or user interface, the core of the system (Business Rules/ Domain) should not change. It means that external dependencies can be fully replaced.Figure 3.1: Clean architecture The Domain and Application layers remain in the base of the design, known as the Core of the system, in Clean architecture. Enterprise logic is contained in thedomain layer, whereas business logic is included in the application layer. Enter prise logic can be shared across several systems, however business logic is often employed just within the system. The core will be unaffected by data access or other infrastructure issues. And we can accomplish this by utilizing interfaces and abstraction within the Core and having other layers outside of the Core implement them.

text: Effectively extracting discriminative spatial and temporal features from skeleton sequences for action recognition remains a challenge. We introduce the Attention Enhanced Graph Convolutional LSTM Network (AGC-LSTM), which captures discriminative features in spatial configuration and temporal dynamics, and explores their co-occurrence relationships. A temporal hierarchical architecture expands the top AGC-LSTM layer's temporal receptive fields, enhancing high-level semantic representation learning while significantly reducing computational cost. text: Unlabelled data appear in many domains and are particularly relevant to streaming applications, where even though data is abundant, labelled data is rare. To address the learning problems associated with such data, one can ignore the unlabelled data and focus only on the labelled data (supervised learning); use the labelled data and attempt to leverage the unlabelled data (semi-supervised learning); or assume some labels will be available on request (active learning). The first approach is the simplest, yet the amount of labelled data available will limit the predictive performance. The second relies on finding and exploiting the underlying characteristics of the data distribution. The third depends on an external agent to provide the required labels in a timely fashion. This survey pays special attention to methods that leverage unlabelled data in a semi-supervised setting. We also discuss the delayed labelling issue, which impacts both fully supervised and semi-supervised methods. We propose a unified problem setting, discuss the learning guarantees and existing methods, explain the differences between related problem settings. Finally, we review the current benchmarking practices and propose adaptations to enhance them.

text:
**Tóm tắt ý chính:**
Đoạn văn nhấn mạnh tính an toàn của phương thức đăng nhập OAuth cho người dùng cuối. Cơ chế hoạt động cốt lõi là các ứng dụng (client applications) yêu cầu sự ủy quyền (authorization) từ người dùng để truy cập vào các Resource Server (ví dụ: Gmail, Facebook, Github) mà không cần chia sẻ trực tiếp thông tin đăng nhập. Nghiên cứu hiện tại vận dụng OAuth làm nền tảng xác thực.

**Đoạn văn viết lại:**
Phương thức ủy quyền OAuth (Open Authorization), được chuẩn hóa trong [RFC 6749], đã trở thành một tiêu chuẩn công nghiệp quan trọng, cung cấp một cơ chế an toàn và linh hoạt cho việc cấp quyền truy cập tài nguyên cho người dùng cuối. Thay vì yêu cầu người dùng chia sẻ trực tiếp thông tin xác thực nhạy cảm với các ứng dụng khách (client applications) – ví dụ như các trang web hoặc ứng dụng di động – OAuth cho phép người dùng (Resource Owner) cấp quyền có giới hạn cho các ứng dụng này để truy cập vào tài nguyên của họ được lưu trữ trên một Resource Server (ví dụ: Gmail, Facebook, Github) mà không tiết lộ thông tin đăng nhập. Quá trình này thường liên quan đến việc người dùng được chuyển hướng đến một Authorization Server, nơi họ xác thực và chấp thuận yêu cầu truy cập, sau đó ứng dụng khách sẽ nhận được một access token để tương tác với Resource Server. Tính ưu việt về bảo mật của OAuth đã được nhiều nghiên cứu khẳng định [Hardt, 2012; Fett et al., 2016]. Trên cơ sở đó, nghiên cứu hiện tại kế thừa và áp dụng OAuth 2.0 làm cơ chế xác thực và ủy quyền cốt lõi cho hệ thống [Tên hệ thống/Dự án của luận văn], nhằm đảm bảo an toàn cho dữ liệu người dùng trong khi vẫn duy trì trải nghiệm truy cập liền mạch và tiện lợi.

text: This correspondence arises because the states in such a graph, often termed a state diagram or trellis, are typically constructed to represent the history of consecutive zeros encountered since the last '1' (or from the beginning of the sequence). Furthermore, the 'k' constraint is enforced by ensuring that states representing 'k' consecutive zeros (where k is finite) do not possess outgoing transitions labeled '0'; any valid continuation from such a state must therefore be labeled '1'. text: Wireframes, or line-based models, are commonly employed in architecture and computer-aided design as foundational 3D representations for rapid design iterations and evaluations. Unlike complete design files, wireframes omit key details such as textures, materials, and precise shapes, which traditional renderers require to produce 2D visualizations. This paper addresses this limitation by introducing a method to synthesize photorealistic indoor scene renderings from wireframe models using an image translation framework. Current image synthesis techniques, while effective for objects like faces or birds, often fail to maintain structural elements inherent to wireframes, such as junctions, parallel lines, and planar surfaces. To overcome this, we present a novel approach that leverages a joint structure-appearance representation, trained on both images and wireframes, ensuring structural constraints are preserved through a shared encoder network. Evaluations on a wireframe-scene dataset demonstrate that our model surpasses existing methods in both visual fidelity and structural accuracy of the generated images.

text: We propose an efficient algorithm for the generalized sparse coding (SC) inference problem. The proposed framework applies to both the single dictionary setting, where each data point is represented as a sparse combination of the columns of one dictionary matrix, as well as the multiple dictionary setting as given in morphological component analysis (MCA), where the goal is to separate a signal into additive parts such that each part has distinct sparse representation within a corresponding dictionary. Both the SC task and its generalization via MCA have been cast as \ell_1-regularized least-squares optimization problems. To accelerate traditional acquisition of sparse codes, we propose a deep learning architecture that constitutes a trainable time-unfolded version of the Split Augmented Lagrangian Shrinkage Algorithm (SALSA), a special case of the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM). We empirically validate both variants of the algorithm, that we refer to as LSALSA (learned-SALSA), on image vision tasks and demonstrate that at inference our networks achieve vast improvements in terms of the running time, the quality of estimated sparse codes, and visual clarity on both classic SC and MCA problems. Finally, we present a theoretical framework for analyzing LSALSA network: we show that the proposed approach exactly implements a truncated ADMM applied to a new, learned cost function with curvature modified by one of the learned parameterized matrices. We extend a very recent Stochastic Alternating Optimization analysis framework to show that a gradient descent step along this learned loss landscape is equivalent to a modified gradient descent step along the original loss landscape. In this framework, the acceleration achieved by LSALSA could potentially be explained by the network's ability to learn a correction to the gradient direction of steeper descent. Future work should further explore the mechanisms of this learned gradient correction and the characteristics of the induced learned cost function. Investigating the broader applicability of LSALSA to diverse optimization problems and its scalability, along with establishing more rigorous theoretical guarantees for its performance, will pave the way for new advancements in learned optimization.

text: This paper addresses the limited interpretability of spatial dependencies captured by CNN-based models in human pose estimation and introduces TransPose, a Transformer-based architecture for this task. TransPose leverages the attention mechanisms of Transformers to efficiently capture long-range relationships and reveal the specific dependencies underlying keypoint localization. The model predicts keypoint heatmaps by employing the final attention layer as an aggregator, conforming to the principle of Activation Maximization~\cite, and thus highlights image-specific, fine-grained dependencies—providing insights into model behavior in challenging cases such as occlusions. Experimental results demonstrate that TransPose achieves 75.8 AP and 75.0 AP on the COCO validation and test-dev sets respectively, outperforming mainstream CNN counterparts in both speed and model size. Furthermore, TransPose exhibits strong transferability to the MPII benchmark, achieving state-of-the-art results with minimal additional training. Conditional image generation has emerged as a critical area in computer vision, enabling the synthesis of realistic images based on specific input conditions. However, evaluating the quality and relevance of generated images remains a significant challenge due to the lack of standardized metrics. This paper addresses this gap by proposing a comprehensive framework for evaluating conditional image generation models. We introduce a set of novel metrics that assess both the fidelity of generated images to the input conditions and their perceptual quality. Our approach combines quantitative measures, such as conditional consistency and diversity, with human perceptual studies to ensure a robust evaluation. Experiments conducted on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed metrics in distinguishing between state-of-the-art models and providing actionable insights for model improvement. The results highlight the importance of aligning evaluation metrics with the specific goals of conditional image generation tasks. This work contributes to the field by offering a standardized evaluation toolkit, facilitating fair comparisons, and guiding future advancements in conditional image synthesis.  

**Keywords**: conditional image generation, evaluation metrics, perceptual quality, image fidelity, computer vision, generative models.

text: In this paper, we propose a residual non-local attention network for high-quality image restoration. Previous methods, which do not account for the uneven distribution of information in corrupted images, are limited by local convolutional operations and uniform treatment of spatial- and channel-wise features. To address these limitations, we design local and non-local attention blocks that extract features capable of capturing long-range dependencies between pixels and focusing on the most challenging regions. Specifically, each (non-)local attention block comprises a trunk branch and a (non-)local mask branch. The trunk branch is responsible for extracting hierarchical features, while the local and non-local mask branches adaptively rescale these features using mixed attention mechanisms. The local mask branch focuses on local structures through convolutional operations, whereas the non-local attention branch captures long-range dependencies across the entire feature map. Additionally, we introduce residual local and non-local attention learning to facilitate the training of very deep networks, thereby further enhancing the network's representational capacity. Our proposed method is generalizable to various image restoration tasks, including image denoising, demosaicing, compression artifacts reduction, and super-resolution. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves quantitatively and visually comparable or superior performance to recently leading methods.

text: Coroutines cho phép tạm dừng một tác vụ tính toán mà không gây 'blocking' (ngăn chặn) luồng (thread). Về bản chất, chúng có thể được xem như các 'lightweight' thread, dù chúng không phải là thread thực sự mà chỉ mô phỏng hành vi của chúng. Một điểm khác biệt quan trọng là số lượng thread tại một thời điểm thường bị giới hạn do chi phí duy trì cao và việc quản lý bởi hệ thống; trong khi đó, số lượng coroutines có thể coi là gần như vô hạn, cho phép hàng nghìn coroutines được khởi chạy đồng thời. Mặc dù dễ sử dụng hơn, coroutines vẫn đi kèm với một số quy tắc nhất định cần tuân thủ. Cơ chế hoạt động của coroutines dựa trên khả năng hoãn (suspend) một đoạn mã mà không làm 'chặn' (blocking) luồng. Sự khác biệt cốt lõi với việc 'chặn' một luồng là ở chỗ khi bị chặn, luồng đó sẽ ngừng trệ hoàn toàn và không thể thực hiện bất kỳ hoạt động nào khác. Ngược lại, khi một coroutine bị 'hoãn', luồng vẫn có thể tiếp tục thực hiện các tác vụ khác trong thời gian chờ đợi coroutine đó hoàn tất. Việc triển khai coroutines được thực hiện ở cấp độ nền tảng nhất có thể. Đồng thời, một cấu trúc hỗ trợ coroutines cấp cao hơn cũng được cung cấp trong thư viện Kotlin Coroutines.

text: Drawing from the observation that human visual tracking skills develop during early and middle childhood, we introduce tracking as a surrogate task for training visual representations in a computer vision system. Mimicking the children's game of Catch, we create a Catch-the-Patch (CtP) game where a 3D-CNN model learns visual representations beneficial for video-based tasks. In our pretraining approach, an image patch extracted from a video is scaled and moved along a predefined path, with the model tasked to predict its position and size across subsequent frames using only the initial bounding box. Incorporating multiple patches enhances performance, while randomly hiding patches increases task complexity. Evaluations on standard benchmarks show CtP outperforming other video pretraining techniques. Moreover, CtP-learned features exhibit greater resilience to domain shifts compared to those from supervised action recognition training. Notably, when pretrained on Kinetics-400, CtP achieves significantly higher action classification accuracy on the Something-Something dataset than its fully supervised counterpart. Code is available at: github.com/microsoft/CtP.

text: The increasing availability of unlabeled data has made Positive Unlabeled (PU) learning a significant challenge. Recent GAN-based PU methods have shown potential in addressing this task, as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) avoid deterministic bias and dimensionality constraints. However, current GAN-based PU approaches face limitations, including sensitivity to prior knowledge, complex architectures, and initial overfitting. To address these challenges, we integrate a biased PU risk into the standard GAN discriminator loss function, guiding the discriminator to push the generator toward the unlabeled data distribution while diverging from the positive samples. Our proposed model, D-GAN, learns the negative examples distribution without requiring prior knowledge. Experimental results show that D-GAN surpasses existing PU methods without prior knowledge, effectively resolving their shortcomings.

text: *Vaccinium angustifolium* (lowbush blueberry), a member of the Ericaceae family and native to North America, is characterized by its primary constituents, anthocyanins. These flavonoids possess numerous biological activities, including antioxidant, anticancer, and anti-inflammatory properties. Delphinidin, an active compound within the anthocyanin group, is abundant in various berries such as strawberries, blueberries, and grapes. The objective of this study was to investigate and establish a quantitative procedure for delphinidin chloride in *V. angustifolium* using HPLC-PDA. For the methodology, delphinidin chloride standard (≥ 98.0% HPLC) was sourced from Xian Plant Bio - Engineering Co., Ltd, and *Vaccinium angustifolium* dry extract was obtained from Changsha Vigorous-tech Co., Ltd. Chromatographic conditions investigated included the mobile phase system (5% formic acid in water - acetonitrile gradient mode), an injection volume of 10 µL, a flow rate of 1.0 mL/min, and a column temperature of 25°C. Extraction conditions examined encompassed the extraction solvent ratio (methanol:HCl) at four ratios (6:4, 7:3, 8:2, 9:1), hydrolysis times of 30, 60, 90, 120, and 150 minutes, and centrifugation speeds of 6,000, 10,000, and 12,000 rpm. The optimal extraction conditions were determined to be a methanol:HCl solvent ratio of 9:1, a hydrolysis time of 150 minutes, and a centrifugation speed of 6,000 rpm. The analytical procedure was validated and met the requirements stipulated by AOAC. In conclusion, a successful extraction and quantification procedure for delphinidin chloride in *V. angustifolium* dry extract using HPLC-PDA has been established.

text: Document layout analysis (DLA) involves segmenting a document image into distinct regions, serving as a critical component in systems for document comprehension and data extraction. Developing techniques that require minimal training data while maintaining effectiveness can advance DLA progress. We introduce a Human-in-the-loop (HITL) collaborative intelligence framework for DLA, motivated by the idea that HITL enhances model learning by incorporating limited data informed by domain expertise. While HITL typically identifies key samples using confidence metrics, this approach proves inadequate for DLA tasks. To address this, we present the Key Samples Selection (KSS) method, which improves sample selection accuracy in high-level tasks like semantic segmentation through agent collaboration, thereby lowering operational expenses. Selected samples undergo human annotation before being used to refine the model. Drawing inspiration from reinforcement learning, we redesign the learning system with a sample-based agent update strategy, enhancing the agent’s adaptability to new data. This approach yields notable performance gains on two benchmarks (DSSE-200 (from 77.1% to 86.3%) and CS-150 (from 88.0% to 95.6%)) while utilizing only 10% of labeled data.

text: We propose to tackle the mode collapse problem in generative adversarial networks (GANs) by using multiple discriminators and assigning a different portion of each minibatch, called microbatch, to each discriminator. We gradually change each discriminator's task from distinguishing between real and fake samples to discriminating samples coming from inside or outside its assigned microbatch by using a diversity parameter \alpha. The generator is then forced to promote variety in each minibatch to make the microbatch discrimination harder to achieve by each discriminator. Thus, all models in our framework benefit from having variety in the generated set to reduce their respective losses. We show evidence that our solution promotes sample diversity since early training stages on multiple datasets.

text: This paper introduces SLIDE, a novel approach to single image 3D photography that leverages soft layering and depth-aware inpainting to generate high-quality 3D representations from 2D images. Our method employs a deep learning-based framework that combines a soft layering technique to separate objects in the scene and a depth-aware inpainting algorithm to fill in missing regions. The results demonstrate significant improvements in 3D reconstruction accuracy and visual coherence compared to existing methods. Key findings include the ability to handle complex scenes with multiple objects and varying depths, as well as robustness to occlusions and missing data. The implications of this research are substantial, enabling applications in fields such as computer vision, robotics, and virtual reality. By advancing the state-of-the-art in single image 3D photography, SLIDE contributes to the development of more sophisticated and realistic 3D modeling and reconstruction techniques, with potential applications in areas like 3D printing, gaming, and cinematic production, leveraging technologies such as deep learning, computer vision, and 3D reconstruction.

This letter investigates these vulnerabilities and introduces AutoHR, a strong end-to-end baseline for remote HR measurement developed via neural architecture search (NAS). AutoHR's methodology integrates a powerful searched backbone with novel Temporal Difference Convolution (TDC) for capturing rPPG-aware inter-frame clues, a hybrid loss function leveraging time and frequency domain constraints, and spatio-temporal data augmentation for robust representation learning. Comprehensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate AutoHR's superior performance on both intra- and cross-dataset testing, establishing its contribution as a robust solution for challenging rPPG applications.

text: DDD primarily emphasizes the Domain and Application layers, placing less focus on the Infrastructure and Presentation layers. In implementing the architecture, the project underwent minor modifications to align with the abp framework. The domain layer in this study comprises Domain, Domain.Shared, DbMigrator, and the MongoDB project. The DbMigrator component is responsible for database migration and seeding data as necessary. The MongoDB project provides the context for database connectivity and defines the repository interface. Serving as an intermediary, the repository layer facilitates access to entities and minimizes the business model’s dependence on specific storage technologies, thereby improving the system’s capacity for technological upgrades and replacements. The Domain project contains entities and the implementation of the repository interface specified in the MongoDB project. Domain.Shared encompasses constants, enumerations, and other shared resources accessible to all layers. The Application layer includes both Application and Application.Contract, while the HTTP layer comprises Http.Api, Http.Client, and Http.Host, which collectively establish the environment through which clients can invoke remote HTTP services.

text: Disease-oriented image embedding with pseudo-scanner standardization (DI-PSS) presents a novel framework for enhancing content-based image retrieval (CBIR) in clinical brain MRI databases by addressing inter-scanner variability and improving disease-specific representation. The DI-PSS approach incorporates robust data harmonization via skull stripping and CycleGAN-based image transformations, aligning images to a standardized brain model and subsequently to a reference scanner domain. This harmonized output is then processed using 3D convolutional autoencoders integrated with deep metric learning to generate low-dimensional embeddings that more accurately capture disease-related features. Evaluation on T1-weighted MRIs from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative and the Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative demonstrated that DI-PSS significantly reduces embedding variability attributable to differences in scanner hardware and datasets. Notably, the system decreased the variability in disease-to-control distances by 15.8-22.6% for Alzheimer's disease and 18.0-29.9% for Parkinson's disease compared to baseline methods. Furthermore, spectral clustering-based classification showed that DI-PSS improved average accuracy and macro-F1 scores by 6.2% and 10.7%, respectively. These findings indicate that DI-PSS is highly effective for harmonizing heterogeneous MRI data, enabling more reliable disease classification and supporting its application to diverse and legacy brain MRI datasets.

text: This study aims to investigate the application of Graph Isomorphism Networks (GINs) in analyzing functional connectivity from resting-state functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (rs-fMRI) data. To address the complexity of brain network analysis, we employ a novel approach using GINs, which learn to identify and classify graph-structured data. Our method involves constructing brain networks from rs-fMRI data and applying GINs to analyze functional connectivity patterns. The results show that GINs can effectively capture subtle differences in brain network topology, outperforming traditional methods in identifying distinct functional connectivity patterns. Our findings have significant implications for the diagnosis and treatment of neurological disorders, highlighting the potential of GINs in rs-fMRI analysis. The key contributions of this research include the introduction of GINs to rs-fMRI analysis, demonstrating improved performance over existing methods, and providing new insights into the application of graph neural networks in neuroimaging. Relevant keywords: Graph Isomorphism Networks, rs-fMRI, functional connectivity, brain network analysis, graph neural networks, neuroimaging.

text: Shamir's secret sharing (SSS), introduced by Shamir (1979), represents a foundational cryptographic primitive essential for ensuring the secure distribution and robust storage of sensitive data across diverse applications. This sophisticated algorithm leverages polynomial interpolation to partition a confidential secret into multiple discrete shares, which are subsequently distributed among various participants, each retaining a unique component of the overall secret. A key aspect of SSS is its ability to reconstruct the original secret only when a minimum predetermined number of shares are combined. The implementation process initiates by designating the secret as the constant term within a polynomial of a specified degree, with the evaluation of this polynomial at distinct points yielding the individual shares allocated to each participant. The adaptability of SSS is a significant advantage, allowing the threshold 'k' for secret reconstruction to be configured according to specific system requirements; for instance, setting the threshold to 'k' mandates the combination of 'k' or more shares for recovery. This threshold-based mechanism provides robust resilience against the accidental loss or malicious larceny of shares, thereby enhancing data integrity and availability. Shamir's secret sharing has broad applicability across numerous disciplines, frequently employed in cryptographic key management where critical cryptographic keys are fragmented and dispersed among key holders. This methodology significantly augments the security posture of vital systems by preventing any single entity from accessing the key without the collaborative effort of multiple parties. For illustrative purposes, consider dividing a secret value of 42 into five shares with a threshold of three. By evaluating a polynomial at various points, the shares generated are: Share 1: (1, 17), Share 2: (2, 23), Share 3: (3, 38), Share 4: (4, 14), Share 5: (5, 7), where 'x' denotes the point on the polynomial curve and 'y' its corresponding value. Reconstruction necessitates a minimum of three shares; for example, utilizing shares 2, 3, and 4 allows for the interpolation of the polynomial and determination of the value at x = 0, corresponding to the confidential value of 42, typically achieved by employing the Lagrange interpolation formula.

text: Traditional neural networks assume vectorial inputs as the network is arranged as layers of single line of computing units called neurons. This special structure requires the non-vectorial inputs such as matrices to be converted into vectors. This process can be problematic. Firstly, the spatial information among elements of the data may be lost during vectorisation. Secondly, the solution space becomes very large which demands very special treatments to the network parameters and high computational cost. To address these issues, we propose matrix neural networks (MatNet), which takes matrices directly as inputs. text: Hashing method maps similar high-dimensional data to binary hashcodes with smaller hamming distance, and it has received broad attention due to its low storage cost and fast retrieval speed. As labeling all data pairs is difficult, semi-supervised hashing is proposed which aims at learning efficient codes with limited labeled pairs and abundant unlabeled ones. Existing methods build graphs to capture the structure of dataset, but they are not working well for complex data as the graph is built based on the data representations and determining the representations of complex data is difficult. In this paper, we propose a novel teacher-student semi-supervised hashing framework in which the student is trained with the pairwise information produced by the teacher network. The network follows the smoothness assumption, which achieves consistent distances for similar data pairs so that the retrieval results are similar for neighborhood queries. Experiments on large-scale datasets show that the proposed method reaches impressive gain over the supervised baselines and is superior to state-of-the-art semi-supervised hashing methods.

text: This paper introduces a novel video super-resolution reconstruction (SRR) method that enhances robustness to outliers, motivated by the need to address the performance degradation of the R-LMS algorithm in the presence of innovation outliers despite its otherwise strong reconstruction quality and resilience to registration inaccuracies. The approach involves analyzing the proximal point cost function underlying the R-LMS iterative equation to gain deeper insight into the algorithm’s behavior under various conditions. Leveraging the statistical characteristics of typical innovation outliers, the authors propose a new cost function and derive two algorithms that preserve the computational efficiency of R-LMS while significantly improving outlier robustness. Monte Carlo simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method not only surpasses the traditional and regularized LMS algorithms but also competes effectively with other state-of-the-art SRR methods at a fraction of the computational expense. These findings suggest promising directions for future research in developing efficient and robust SRR algorithms for practical video enhancement applications.

To address this, we propose DesnowNet, a multistage network that sequentially removes translucent and opaque snow particles, explicitly modeling snow attributes such as translucency and chromatic aberration for precise estimation. Our method separately estimates residual complements of the snow-free image to recover details hidden by opaque snow and incorporates a multi-scale network design to capture snow diversity. Experimental evaluation on the Snow100K dataset shows that DesnowNet surpasses state-of-the-art learning-based atmospheric phenomena removal techniques and a semantic segmentation baseline in both qualitative and quantitative metrics, demonstrating potential benefits for computer vision and graphics applications. text: Multi-scale approach has been used for blind image / video deblurring problems to yield excellent performance for both conventional and recent deep-learning-based state-of-the-art methods. Bicubic down-sampling is a typical choice for multi-scale approach to reduce spatial dimension after filtering with a fixed kernel. However, this fixed kernel may be sub-optimal since it may destroy important information for reliable deblurring such as strong edges. We propose convolutional neural network (CNN)-based down-scale methods for multi-scale deep-learning-based non-uniform single image deblurring. We argue that our CNN-based down-scaling effectively reduces the spatial dimension of the original image, while learned kernels with multiple channels may well-preserve necessary details for deblurring tasks. For each scale, we adopt to use RCAN (Residual Channel Attention Networks) as a backbone network to further improve performance. Our proposed method yielded state-of-the-art performance on GoPro dataset by large margin. Our proposed method was able to achieve 2.59dB higher PSNR than the current state-of-the-art method by Tao. Our proposed CNN-based down-scaling was the key factor for this excellent performance since the performance of our network without it was decreased by 1.98dB. The same networks trained with GoPro set were also evaluated on large-scale Su dataset and our proposed method yielded 1.15dB better PSNR than the Tao's method. Qualitative comparisons on Lai dataset also confirmed the superior performance of our proposed method over other state-of-the-art methods.

text: Image representations are commonly learned from class labels, which are a simplistic approximation of human image understanding. In this paper we demonstrate that transferable representations of images can be learned without manual annotations by modeling human visual attention. The basis of our analyses is a unique gaze tracking dataset of sonographers performing routine clinical fetal anomaly screenings. Models of sonographer visual attention are learned by training a convolutional neural network (CNN) to predict gaze on ultrasound video frames through visual saliency prediction or gaze-point regression. We evaluate the transferability of the learned representations to the task of ultrasound standard plane detection in two contexts. Firstly, we perform transfer learning by fine-tuning the CNN with a limited number of labeled standard plane images. We find that fine-tuning the saliency predictor is superior to training from random initialization, with an average F1-score improvement of 9.6% overall and 15.3% for the cardiac planes. Secondly, we train a simple softmax regression on the feature activations of each CNN layer in order to evaluate the representations independently of transfer learning hyper-parameters. We find that the attention models derive strong representations, approaching the precision of a fully-supervised baseline model for all but the last layer.

This paper addresses the challenge of estimating light direction and color from a single image, a critical task in computer vision with applications in augmented reality, 3D reconstruction, and image editing. Traditional methods often rely on complex setups or multiple images, limiting their practicality. To overcome these limitations, we propose a deep regression-based approach that leverages convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to directly predict light direction and color from a single input image. Our method employs a carefully designed network architecture trained on a diverse dataset of synthetic and real-world images, ensuring robustness across varying lighting conditions and scene complexities. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing methods in terms of accuracy and computational efficiency. Vi khuẩn hiếm khí là một nhóm vi khuẩn không thể sống trong điều kiện oxy hóa cao. Chúng được phân lập từ nhiều nguồn khác nhau, bao gồm đất, nước và các môi trường tự nhiên khác. Dưới đây là một số thành phần, số lượng và tính mẫn cảm với kháng sinh của một số vi khuẩn hiếm khí được phân lập:

- Clostridium difficile: Đây là một loại vi khuẩn hiếm khí gây bệnh thường gặp ở người. Chúng có thể sống trong ruột và gây ra các triệu chứng như tiêu chảy, nôn mửa và đau bụng. C. difficile cũng có thể gây ra các biến chứng nghiêm trọng như viêm đại tràng và suy thận.

text: 3D perception using sensors that meet vehicle industrial standards is a critical requirement for autonomous driving. MEMS LiDAR is becoming increasingly prominent, offering advantages such as lower cost, greater robustness, and compliance with mass-production standards. However, its small field of view (FoV) currently limits widespread adoption. This paper proposes LEAD, i.e., LiDAR Extender for Autonomous Driving, to extend the MEMS LiDAR by coupled image w.r.t both FoV and range. We introduce a multi-stage propagation strategy based on depth distributions and an uncertainty map, which demonstrates effective propagation ability. Furthermore, our depth outpainting/propagation network utilizes a teacher-student training fashion, transferring depth estimation ability to the depth completion network without introducing scale error. To validate the LiDAR extension quality, we generated a ground-truth dataset using a high-precise laser scanner. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that our scheme significantly outperforms SOTAs. We believe the proposed LEAD, along with the dataset, will benefit the community w.r.t depth research.

text: Early detection of lung cancer has been shown to significantly reduce mortality. Spectral CT, a recent advancement in computed tomography, holds promise for improving diagnostic accuracy by providing more information per scan than standard CT. However, the considerable workload involved in analyzing numerous scans necessitates automated diagnostic methods. Therefore, we propose a system for detecting and classifying lung nodules in CT scans, also exploring whether spectral images can enhance classifier performance. We trained a VGG-like 3D convolutional neural network (CNN) for nodule detection. To establish a primary tumor classifier for our dataset, we pre-trained a 3D CNN of similar architecture on nodule malignancies from the large, publicly available LIDC-IDRI dataset. This pre-trained network was then used as a feature extractor for the nodules in our dataset. The resulting feature vectors were categorized into two (benign/malignant) and three (benign/primary lung cancer/metastases) classes using a support vector machine (SVM), with classification performed at both nodule and scan levels. We achieved state-of-the-art performance for detection and malignancy regression on the LIDC-IDRI database. Classification performance on our own dataset was higher for scan-level predictions than for nodule-level predictions; specifically, we attained an accuracy of 78% for the three-class scan-level classification. While spectral features did enhance classifier performance, the improvement was not statistically significant. Our work indicates that a pre-trained feature extractor can serve as an effective primary tumor origin classifier for lung nodules, thereby negating the need for extensive fine-tuning of new networks and large datasets. text: This paper explores the equivalence between Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) time series models and Variational Bayesian (VB) models, shedding light on the connections between these two seemingly disparate approaches. Our objective is to investigate the relationship between RNNs, commonly used for time series forecasting, and VB models, which provide a probabilistic framework for modeling complex data. We employ a combination of theoretical analysis and empirical experiments to demonstrate the equivalence between these two models. Our results show that RNN time series models can be reformulated as VB models, and vice versa, under certain conditions. This equivalence has significant implications for the development of more accurate and efficient time series forecasting models. Our findings contribute to a deeper understanding of the underlying mechanisms of RNNs and VB models, and highlight the potential for hybrid models that leverage the strengths of both approaches. Key contributions include the derivation of a theoretical framework for establishing the equivalence between RNNs and VB models, and the demonstration of improved forecasting performance using hybrid models. Relevant keywords: Recurrent Neural Networks, Variational Bayesian Models, Time Series Forecasting, Deep Learning, Probabilistic Modeling.

text: Learning the network structure underlying data is an important problem in machine learning. This paper introduces a novel prior to study the inference of scale-free networks, which are widely used to model social and biological networks. The prior not only favors a desirable global node degree distribution, but also takes into consideration the relative strength of all the possible edges adjacent to the same node and the estimated degree of each individual node. To fulfill this, ranking is incorporated into the prior, which makes the problem challenging to solve. We employ an ADMM (alternating direction method of multipliers) framework to solve the Gaussian Graphical model regularized by this prior. Our experiments on both synthetic and real data show that our prior not only yields a scale-free network, but also produces many more correctly predicted edges than the others such as the scale-free inducing prior, the hub-inducing prior and the l_1 norm. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach and suggest that incorporating ranking into the prior can significantly enhance network inference, motivating further research into structured priors for complex network models. text: Moving towards autonomy, unmanned vehicles rely heavily on state-of-the-art collision avoidance systems (CAS). However, the detection of obstacles especially during night-time is still a challenging task since the lighting conditions are not sufficient for traditional cameras to function properly. Therefore, we exploit the powerful attributes of event-based cameras to perform obstacle detection in low lighting conditions. Event cameras trigger events asynchronously at high output temporal rate with high dynamic range of up to 120 dB. The algorithm filters background activity noise and extracts objects using robust Hough transform technique. The depth of each detected object is computed by triangulating 2D features extracted utilising LC-Harris. Finally, asynchronous adaptive collision avoidance (AACA) algorithm is applied for effective avoidance. Qualitative evaluation is compared using event-camera and traditional camera.

text: The fundamental goal of contrastive learning is to build an embedding space where similar samples stay close together while dissimilar ones are further away. This objective is typically realized through carefully designed loss functions, such as the InfoNCE loss or various margin-based losses (e.g., triplet loss, N-pair loss), which actively pull representations of positive pairs closer while simultaneously pushing representations of negative pairs further apart within the high-dimensional vector space. In the domain of relation extraction, 'similar samples' would typically correspond to different textual instances expressing the identical semantic relation between entities (e.g., "Paris is the capital of France" and "France's capital is Paris" both expressing `located_in`), ensuring that varying surface forms map to a unified relational concept. Conversely, 'dissimilar samples' encompass instances expressing different relation types (e.g., `located_in` vs. `part_of`) or even non-relational sentence pairs, necessitating their distinct separation to prevent ambiguity and misclassification. This structured separation is paramount for developing robust and discriminative relational representations, enabling models to accurately classify fine-grained relation types, improve generalization to unseen instances, and mitigate semantic drift, which is particularly advantageous for managing the evolving nature of relations and mitigating catastrophic forgetting in continual learning paradigms.

text:
Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) is a critical task in robotics and artificial intelligence, requiring agents to interpret natural language instructions and navigate through complex environments. However, existing methods often struggle with generalization due to limited environmental diversity in training datasets. This paper introduces a novel approach, *Random Environmental Mixup* (REM), to enhance the robustness and adaptability of VLN agents. REM dynamically generates diverse training scenarios by combining elements from multiple environments, thereby simulating a broader range of real-world conditions. We evaluate our approach on benchmark datasets, including R2R and REVERIE, using state-of-the-art transformer-based models. Experimental results demonstrate that REM significantly improves navigation success rates and reduces errors, particularly in unseen environments. Our findings highlight the importance of environmental diversity in training and provide a scalable solution for improving VLN systems. This work contributes to advancing the field of embodied AI by offering a practical method to enhance generalization and performance in vision-language navigation tasks.  

**Keywords**: Vision-Language Navigation, Environmental Diversity, Random Environmental Mixup, Transformer Models, Embodied AI, Generalization.

text: Giao diện người dùng (UI) là một thành phần thiết yếu trong mọi ứng dụng; tuy nhiên, đối với các tựa game thể loại Role-Playing Game (RPG), vai trò của nó càng trở nên tối quan trọng. Trong RPG, UI không chỉ đơn thuần là công cụ tương tác trực quan mà còn là yếu tố cốt lõi định hình *gameplay* và trải nghiệm người chơi. Cụ thể, giao diện cần cung cấp khả năng quản lý hiệu quả *inventory*, cho phép người chơi dễ dàng kiểm tra các *chỉ số* của vật phẩm để đưa ra quyết định chiến thuật hợp lý về việc sử dụng hay bỏ qua vật phẩm. Hơn nữa, nó phải thể hiện rõ ràng sự tăng trưởng *chỉ số cơ bản* khi lên cấp và minh họa lợi ích trực tiếp khi người chơi phân bổ điểm, một khía cạnh thiết yếu trong hệ thống phát triển nhân vật của game RPG. Bên cạnh các chức năng liên quan đến *gameplay*, khả năng lưu trữ tiến độ chơi là đặc trưng không thể thiếu của một game RPG. Do đó, một *menu* khi người chơi *pause game* cần tích hợp đầy đủ các chức năng cơ bản như *save*, *load* và *restart*, nhằm đảm bảo tính liên tục và kiểm soát cho quá trình chơi. Sự thiết kế UI tối ưu trong game RPG không chỉ cải thiện khả năng tương tác mà còn trực tiếp nâng cao chiều sâu chiến thuật và sự gắn kết của người chơi với thế giới game.

4.3.3 The optimality of our construction

text:
This study investigates the robustness and performance of keypoint detectors and binary descriptors under varying degrees of photometric and geometric transformations, a critical challenge in computer vision applications such as object recognition, image stitching, and 3D reconstruction. The objective is to evaluate and compare the effectiveness of state-of-the-art keypoint detection algorithms (e.g., SIFT, ORB, and AKAZE) and binary descriptors (e.g., BRIEF, FREAK, and ORB) in handling transformations such as scaling, rotation, illumination changes, and noise. A comprehensive experimental framework is designed, utilizing benchmark datasets with controlled transformations to systematically assess detection accuracy, descriptor matching performance, and computational efficiency. Results indicate that while certain detectors excel under geometric transformations, others demonstrate superior resilience to photometric variations. Binary descriptors, known for their efficiency, exhibit varying trade-offs between matching accuracy and computational speed. The findings provide valuable insights into selecting optimal combinations of detectors and descriptors for specific application scenarios. This research contributes to advancing the understanding of feature extraction techniques and offers practical guidelines for improving the robustness of vision-based systems under real-world conditions.  

**Keywords**: Keypoint detection, binary descriptors, photometric transformations, geometric transformations, computer vision, feature matching.

text: Trong bối cảnh đánh giá hiệu suất của các mô hình phân loại hoặc phân vùng, các chỉ số True Positive (TP), True Negative (TN), False Positive (FP) và False Negative (FN) đóng vai trò then chốt. Cụ thể, đối với bài toán phân vùng có hai nhãn lớp, bao gồm lớp nền (0) và lớp vật thể (1), các thuật ngữ này được định nghĩa như sau: TP đại diện cho số lượng pixel/vùng mà mô hình dự đoán là vật thể (1) và thực tế cũng là vật thể (1); TN là số lượng pixel/vùng được dự đoán là nền (0) và thực tế là nền (0); FP là số lượng pixel/vùng bị dự đoán sai là vật thể (1) trong khi thực tế là nền (0); và FN là số lượng pixel/vùng bị dự đoán sai là nền (0) trong khi thực tế là vật thể (1). Ma trận nhầm lẫn (confusion matrix), tổng hợp các giá trị TP, TN, FP, và FN, cung cấp cái nhìn toàn diện về hiệu suất của mô hình và có thể được minh họa chi tiết như trong Hình 4.3.

Upon successful validation, the system automatically updates the central inventory database, reflecting the real-time status and precise location of each item within the warehouse. This continuous, automated data refresh is fundamental to enabling effective inventory rotation, as it allows the system to accurately track products based on criteria such as their receipt date, expiry date, or other predefined rotation parameters (e.g., First-In, First-Out (FIFO) or Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) policies). Consequently, the system can autonomously identify stock that requires movement, generate immediate alerts, or create prioritized pick lists for warehouse personnel, guiding them to retrieve older stock or items nearing their obsolescence threshold. This proactive and data-driven approach ensures optimal stock freshness, minimizes spoilage and write-offs, and significantly enhances overall warehouse space utilization and operational efficiency by maintaining a dynamic and accurate inventory overview.
